characters.name: Rukia Kuchiki
characters.description: Sarcastic, aggressive, and convinced of her own artistic merit, Rukia is proficient at kidou and a powerful fighter. Far too talented for her low military rank, she's eventually promoted to 13th Division lieutenant. Her snow-white zanpakuto,Sode no Shirayuki, is the most beautiful in the whole of Soul Society. It lowers the temperature of her body at will, even to absolute zero, allowing her to freeze everything she touches or fight with waves and pillars of ice. Her Bankai,Hakka no Togame, turns her to solid ice and unleashes a powerful, blinding white explosion that instantly freezes everything within the blast radius. Rukia plays a special role in the thirdBleachmovie,Bleach: Fade to Black, in which she is rendered amnesic by the antagonists andgains a Hollowfied form called Dark Rukia. Accidental Hero: Rukia's choice to break the profound taboo of turning Ichigo into a Soul Reaper became the catalyst for many of the series' conflicts and story arcs, while also ironically setting the stage for their eventual downfall. Action Girl: Rukia's an effective hand-to-hand fighter and kido user, as well as highly self-reliant, even without her Soul Reaper powers. Action Mom: Rukia is still very much an active Soul Reaper and captain of Squad 13 even while being the mother of Ichika. She also jokingly chides Ichigo for letting Orihime be a traditional housewife instead of his equal.

characters.name: Orihime Inoue
characters.description: "There are so many things I wanted to do with my life! I wanted to become a teacher! I wanted to become an astronaut! I wanted to own my own bakery, and I wanted to go into Mr. Doughnut's and say, "I'll have them all!" And I wanted to go into Thirty-One and say "I'll have them all!" Ohhhh... I wish I could live life five times over. Then I'd be born in five different cities, I'd stuff myself full with different delicious things five times each, and I'd have five different jobs.... And then for those five times... I'd still fall in love with the same person... Thank you, Kurosaki-kun.... Goodbye." During the Hollow attack instigated by Uryuu, she develops an unusual and unclassifiable ability calledShun Shun Rikka: by manifesting six spiritual beings, she can create barriers that perform different tasks, including shielding, undoing injuries and cutting things in half, in which requiresKilling Intentwhich she struggles to harness until late in the story, whereas her healing and shielding are almost unparalleled. This power was eventually revealed to be awakened by the Hōgyoku influence. Action Survivor: While she does participate in the initial invasion of the Soul Society alongside Ichigo, Chad, Uryu, and Yoruichi, she's the least capable in a straight fight and largely stays on the sidelines unless pushed - and even then, her lack of willingness to cause harm makes her vulnerable. Much, much later, she graduates to a competentAction Girlby becoming anAttack Reflectorand a proactiveBarrier Warriorwho's good enough that she can confront Yhwach alongside Ichigo in the final battle. Adaptation Dye-Job:The color of Orihime's eyes vary between the manga and theanime. They are shown as brown in the manga while the anime depicts them as silver or gray;The Thousand Year Blood Waranime fixes this back to brown.This goes for her hair too, as it's orange in the anime, but in themangait's slightly inconsistent. Characters remark that she has brown or chestnut hair, but manga co

characters.name: Uryu Ishida
characters.description: Stoic and analytical, Uryu is a nicer person than he likes to admit. He has a natural flair for sewing, but his fashion sense appeals more to women than to men. His vitriolic friendship with Ichigo amuses their mutual friends because of how similar the pair really are. He is the only main character that specialises in long-ranged combat, but he can fight close-quarters when forced to and displays a level of versatility that is not found within the rest of his group. His Quincy cross manifests a bow calledKokajuinitially, changing them throughout the manga. After he drinks the blood of Yhwach, he gains theSchrift A - "The Antithesis."The Antithesis allows him to switch anything that has happened between two designated targets; for example, if he was grievously wounded in battle, at any time he can transfer those wounds to his enemy while simultaneously taking ontheircondition beforehand for himself, essentially healing himself. The ability can be activated at will with no necessary medium, and also applies to inanimate objects as well. Acquired Poison Immunity: Subverted. He survives the poison from Mayuri's Bankai thanks to Nemu providing the antidote. When Mayuri uses his Bankai against Szayelaporro while Uryu and Renji are too injured to get out of range, Renji starts to succumb to the poison while Uryu assumes that he'll be safe... and then he starts getting poisoned, too. Mayuri mocks him for assuming that he'd keep using the same poison. Actor Allusion: This isn't thefirst timeNoriaki Sugiyamaplayed aStock Shōnen Rivalwith a grudge, or ahigh schoolerwith amazing archery skills. Adaptational Badass: The anime adaptation of the final arc gives Uryu a much more active role compared to the manga.In the manga, Uryu did not participate much in the Wandenreich's affairs; the anime gives him a few scenes of him retrieving the defeated Cang Du andBG9, and as both of them were recovering from their prior defeats to fight again, it's implied that he took them out before t

characters.name: Yasutora "Chad" Sado
characters.description: Chad began to develop spiritual awareness while helping Rukia fight Shrieker, a Hollow that had killed a young boy whose spirit Chad was trying to help. This didn't properly manifest into usable power until he saved Ichigo's sister Karin from the Hollow attacks that had been instigated by Uryu's conflict with Ichigo. His power manifested as a Fullbring,Brazo Derecha de Gigante("Right Arm of the Giant"), encasing his right arm in armor, vastly increasing his fighting strength and granting him the ability to fire energy blasts. He later improved his Fullbring, unlockingBrazo Izquierda del Diablo("Left Arm of the Devil"), encasing his left arm in armor capable of delivering a powerful energy-infused punch. All of the Other Reindeer: Chad was the subject of jokes or bullies because of his mixed racial appearance and that he never fought back. Animal Motifs: His given name 'Yasutora' means "Calm Tiger" and the cover for chapter 39 depicts chad standing behind a tiger very much akin to ananimal battle aura. Hiyori catches on the "tiger" part when she first meets him. Badass Normal: Before his powers manifested, he beat up a Hollow by tearing a telephone pole out of the ground and beating it senseless. He gets bonus points becausehe couldn't even see it; Rukia was telling him where to aim. Because You Were Nice to Me: The simple, yet complex reason why he and Ichigo are friends. Specifically, Chad took a beating for Ichigo when the latter was getting beaten up by a gang. Later on, Ichigo rescued Chad from the same gang and saved thecoingiven to Chad by his grandfather. After the latter incident, they both made a vow to fight for and to protect each other.

characters.name: Renji Abarai
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isZabimaru, a large sword that can stretch and flail like a whip. When first introduced, his Bankai is calledHihio Zabimaru, a massive skeletal snake that fires energy blasts. Damaged in its very first battle, it is later reforged intoSōō Zabimaru, which manifests as a sword and gives him a mantle that is adorned with bones. The Ace: By lieutenant standards, Renji is this. He's mastered three of the four fighting styles of the Soul Reaper (only lacking in Kido), is one of the strongest fighters of his rank, has learned Bankai where most haven't, and he's well liked by the other squad captains as well, which is why Byakuya couldn't demote/discharge and possibly execute Renji after the latter's loss to Ichigo. After his training at the Soul Palace, Renji has become without a doubt the strongest lieutenant of the Thirteen Court Guards, to the point of being anAlmighty Janitorwho is arguably stronger than several of the Captains added in the epilogue. Adaptational Badass: InThe Blade of Fate,Shattered Blade,andDark Souls;he's able to useHiga Zekkouwithout any of the drawbacks of the manga or the anime. Adaptation Expansion: In theThousand Year Blood Waranime, he gets into a fight with Ishida after arriving in Wahrwelt, showcasing more of his completed Bankai's abilities in the process, such as the blade that projects from its mouth being able to extend as an enhanced version of its Shikai,Orochiobeing able to extend and grow to behave similarly to its incomplete Bankai, andHihiobeing able to grow new arms from its scattered fur, or even from Renji's own skeleton. Adaptational Ugliness: Downplayed. InFiller, whenever he accompanies Rukia in the Human World, Renji's casual outfit is usually outdated street hippie clothes with cargo pants and a simple shirt. In the manga, Tite Kubo usually gives Renji a stylish punk-rock outfit or stylish street clothes in some color spread.

characters.name: Epilogue Characters
characters.description: Alliterative Name:KazuiKurosaki. Ambiguous Innocence:The fact he cheerfully opened a Gate to Hell brings some suspicion to his innocence. Call-Back: His Zanpakuto's sealed form heavily resembles Tensa Zangetsu's original form, being a katana with a manji-shaped hilt. Also, his meeting with Ichika Abarai, Rukia and Renji's daughter, mirrors how Ichigo met Rukia in the first place: with her coming out of nowhere into Ichigo's room, introducing herself as a Soul Reaper before being shocked by his spiritual power. Cheerful Child: Is never seen showing anything but delight or surprise all throughout the one chapter he appears in. When Ichika points a sword at him and tries to bully him, his response to smile and show off his own Soul Reaper abilities. A page of Kubo's artbook that depicts Kazui as a middle school student shows him beaming while looking at the viewer, in contrast to a frowning and stern Ichika. Creepy Child: Kazui treats theGate to Hellas a plaything, something that freaks out Kon. The opening narration of the Bleach Special chapter implies that Kazui is the narrator. Just see the opening lines below and judge whether this is coming from the mind of a healthy person:When I was little, I owned two goldfish. They were cute and I loved them a lot. But at some point, the larger one died. The remaining goldfish seemed to feel lonely and so did I while observing it. But from that day...the little goldfish I thought had stopped growing, began to grow bigger and bigger...and continue to grow healthier. Seeing that made me relieved. Ahh, I'm glad.It was a good thing that the larger one died.

characters.name: Soul King Adnyeus
characters.description: Adaptation Expansion: Possibly the biggest example inBleach.In the original manga, he was barely even athing.He was literally just a plot device placed to ascend Yhwach into a Transcendental Being. The anime adaptationconsiderablyexpands upon him, his (albeit still ambiguous) motives, nature, even giving him a name. While he is still ultimately there primarily to drive the plot forward, he is at the very least a now compelling-enough of a mystery to chew on. All There in the Manual: The manga’s final arc drops bits and pieces of his past, but mostly just portrays him as an inanimate object.Bleach: Can't Fear Your Own Worldfully explains what he used to be and why he ended up in such a state in the present story. Almighty Idiot: Despite being the equivalent of God in the universe ofBleach, the Soul King is an irresponsiveEmpty Shellwithout will or personality whose only function is basically being a human lynchpin who keeps the balance and stability of the entire creation going on. Ambiguous Situation: The last we saw of him, he was effectively absorbed by Yhwach entirely. Upon doing so, Soul Society started falling apart. When Yhwach died, that also means that the King died, yet the Soul Society was in one piece meaning he somehow survived. But how... and where? The novelBleach: Can't Fear Your Own Worldreveals thathe indeed died and that Yhwach's corpse is his replacement, but questions if he was alive in the first place and what his more and more antagonistic looking relationship with the Soul Reapers was. And I Must Scream: Averted. He is said to have known beforehand that the five figures that established Soul Society would seal him away to maintain and allowed them to while they deprived him of his body parts, still alive yet mostly brain dead with his remaining sentience acting through his severed body parts. With the sole exception of Ichibē, those who see him are horrified at his state of existence; Aizen even refers to him as a "thing". His fate is so horri

characters.name: The Right Hand
characters.description: Adaptational Badass: Mimihagi is just a plot device in the manga for stalling Yhwahc's attempts to absorb the Soul King, defeating it easily and even absorbing its power quickly afterwards. In the anime however, it was able to fight back Yhwach with its own Reiatsu and even after it gets defeated, it still manages to minimize the impact of Yhwach's plan of fusing the Three Worlds due to Ukitake still alive, though it still gets absorbed much later. Animate Body Parts: Mimihagi is the Soul King's severed right arm, which has developed a will of its own and sided with Soul Society. Yhwach is annoyed by this, remarking that this must mean that the Soul King's will no longer resides within it. Indeed, theAdaptation Expansionin the anime all but states that it is Ukitake's will that is driving and powering Mimihagi to stop Yhwach, confirming his suspicions. Casting a Shadow: In the physical world, Mimihagi manifests as a hand-shaped mass of darkness. Creepily Long Arms: When manifested from Ukitake, it stretches all the way from Soul Society to the Royal Realm. Eyes Do Not Belong There: It has a single giant eye, though contrasting its counterpart the eye is on the back of the hand—which passes for its head—instead of the palm.

characters.name: Other examples
characters.description: Pieces of the Soul King ended up bonding with various people among the humans of the Land of the Living, giving them the potential to become Fullbringers when in contact with a Hollow. The Soul Reaper Rangiku Matsumoto is a similar case as she was infused with one of the Soul King's nails, surviving its extraction by Sōsuke Aizen as he was gathering many of those parts to increase the Hōgyoku's power.

characters.name: In General
characters.description: Asskicking Leads to Leadership: Hollows are led by the strongest, usually Vasto Lorde-class Menos.Baraggan Louisenbairnruled as theirGod-Emperorfor thousands of years because no one else had the strength (or will) to challenge him. Later,Tier Harribelof the Espada ruled as theundisputed queenuntil she was overthrown and later reinstated as co-queen alongside fellow former EspadaNelliel Tu Odelschwanckbecause there were no other Hollows stronger than them. This behavior even extends to non-Hollows asSosuke AizenandYhwachmanaged to take control simply by being more powerful than anyone at the time. Boomerang Bigot: Despite most Hollows having once been humans themselves, they usually prefer to feast on their souls and regard them as little more than prey. Cannibalism Superpower: Hollows grow more powerful by consuming souls; they eventually reach a point where the only thing that can satisfy their hunger are other Hollows, which eventually causes a Menos to form. The Corruption:Pluses become Hollows when they are sufficiently overcome with negative emotions like rage, hatred and despair causing them to discard their hearts and become monsters. They can also be forcibly Hollowfied by having theirChain of Fateremoved.Soul Society'sscientific communityonce experimented with a process called"Hollowfication"which intended togrant Hollow powers to Soul Reapers. Official research was discontinued since test subjectsturned into mindless ultra Hollowsandtheir souls eventually destabilized and self-destructed. Aizen surreptitiously continued this research, developing a mutagen capable ofinducing it via wounds.Kisuke Uraharadeveloped a means of preventing the "Soul Suicide", though subjects would still be at risk unless they suppressed theirInner Hollowsand he later developed the Shineiyaku—pills that temporarily induce Hollowfication—to defend against theVandenreich.The Fullbringers were mostly born to mothers who survived Hollow attacks and passed theirLife Energyto their chil

characters.name: Ichibē Hyōsube
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isIchimonji, a giant brush with the power to cut words, essentially cutting anything into its base half (cutting an "arm" reduces it into an "ar", leaving it with only half of its strength). When Ichibē activates the Shikai, the tip turns into a blade that scatters black ink, erasing the names of whatever the ink stains. He refers to Bankai asShinuchi, citing that as the original word beforeBankaireplaced it, and his is calledShirafude Ichimonji. It is a giant white brush with the power to rename targets that have been affected by the Shikai. Targets renamed as a black ant, for example, will only have the abilities of a black ant. Ichimonji is also able to controlblackto launch very powerful attacks. Adaptational Villainy: Ichibē'strue colorsdon't really come into play until theCan't Fear Your Own Worldnovels, while the manga largely kept his atrocities ambiguous, and his darker moments, while present, seemed to push him towards aCreepy Goodcharacter. However, the anime adaptation of theThousand-Year Blood Waris far less vague. Right off the bat, during Ichigo's training in the Royal Realm, Ichibē is shown to express nefarious ulterior motives in regards to beefing Ichigo up for reasons other than simply defeating the Wandenreich. Later, during a flashback when Ichibē is seen attempting some sort of treaty with the Licht Reich, Yhwach instantly sees through his jovial demeanor and attempt at deception — and thenliterallythrough him with the Almighty, revealing not only was Ichibē dishonest with him about the treaty, but a series of flashes that seemingly imply that it was Ichibēhimselfwho committed the Original Sin, turning someone into the first Soul King, with Ichibē looking downrightgleefulat the act. This causes Yhwach toexplodeand immediately try to kill him on the spot. It's almost downright impressive that the monk manages to make aHate Sinklike Yhwach look like atragic figureby comparison. Ambiguously Evil: It is heavily implied that his jovial

characters.name: Kirio Hikifune
characters.description: In battle she wields an enormous...spoon. It's deadlier than it sounds, as she can manipulate and condense Reishi into tree-like formations, trapping any said Reishi within it. Those trees will instinctively seek and devour Reishi. Big Eater: She has a monstrous appetite, being able to eat unnaturally huge portions of food. In Soul Society, the only Souls that eat are Souls that possess Reiatsu; the amount eaten is connected to how much Reiatsu they need to restore. Kirio may look like a massively overweight woman but that's because she needs a huge body to maintain her huge Reiatsu. Whenever she depletes her Reiatsu, her body becomes correspondingly thin. She then has to eat enormous amounts of food to regain her full power. Big Fun: She's a big and friendly woman. She's appears to be well-liked among her peers — Hiyori in particular was very attached to Hikifune (her former captain) and was angry when she was promoted to the Zero Squad. However, since Shinji initially doesn't recognize her 112 years later, it's heavily implied that she didn't used to look fat back then. Buxom Beauty Standard: Her chest is the part of her body that is the least affected by herTemporary Bulk Change. Kon, Renji, and evenIchigogetdistractedthe first time they see the cleavage of her busty slender form. Chef of Iron: She's aSupreme Chefand a formidable combatant who usesFood-Based Superpowersand aspoonto fight.

characters.name: Senjumaru Shutara
characters.description: Her Zanpakuto takes the form of a long sewing needle, allowing her to weaponize any article of clothing to her own devices, including the clothes her enemies are wearing. She can also sew into existence her own soldiers of varying sizes. Her Shikai is called Shigarami. Her Bankai,Shatatsu Karagara Shigarami no Tsuji(lit: Crossing of the Old Woman's Gate, Kāla's Corpse and Thorny Entanglements), summons a building-sized loom with varieties of cloths and linen that surround and envelop enemies: The purple cloth reflects all attacks; the golden cloth forms into a trap similar to an iron maiden; the black fractal cloth swallows enemies whole; the snowflake cloth freezes enemies; the burning tree cloth burns enemies alive; the star cloth bearing the Wandenreich symbol mimics the effects of Auswählen; and finally,Shide no Rokushiki Ukimon no Hata(lit: Loom of the Six-Colored Floating Patterns of Death)cuts all the cloths from the loom and seals all enemies within. Like the rest of her squadmates, the true depth of her power—Bankai included—is sealed by the blood-oath seal of the members of Squad Zero due to its overwhelming might. To unseal it, three out of five of them (excluding Shutara) need to consent to removing the seal bycommitting suicide. Adaptational Badass: Among all of the Squad Zero she's the one who really stands out in the anime compared with the manga. Not only is her Shikai properly shown there, but she's the only of them besides Ichibei that gets to show her Bankai (that would have defeated all of the elite Quincy if it wasn't for Yhwach's Almighty). Alliterative Name:SenjumaruShutara. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: Has dark hair and isveryaloof and cold. Animal Motifs: Her appearance and abilities heavily invoke spiders, from her six apparent artificial arms (that combined with her legs give her eight limbs, just like spiders) and her Zanpakuto being based in sewing, akin to how a spider uses its silk to create spiderweb. Furthermore, her Bankai enclosing her

characters.name: Tenjirō Kirinji
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isKinpika, a rowing paddle with a small blade concealed within the wooden sweep. It can shine brightly and disorient enemies, but its full powers were not explored. He can also summon and control all of the water from his hot springs, either to scald and burn his enemies or to heal his allies. Blinded by the Light: The anime adaptation shows that his Shikai, Kinpika, creates light around the blade that he can use to effectively create a flashbang type effect. Chivalrous Pervert: In the manga, he ogles Rukia's butt as she's floating face-down in the White Bone Hell and teasingly asks Ichigo if it puts him in the mood for peaches. Combat Medic: He's a superior medic to Unohana and more powerful than the Captains.His fight in the animeagainstJugram Haschwalthis decisively in his favor, utterly overwhelming the Sternritter and killing him with little problem. Delinquent Hair: Sports a ridiculously long, hooked pompadour that accentuates his thuggish looks.

characters.name: Ōetsu Nimaiya
characters.description: In battle, he wields a sword known asSayafushi. The sword is by designflawless, capable of cutting through literally anything and is entirely impervious to even minute damage and staining. Due to this, the sword is also impossible to sheathe (as it would cut right through it), and is thus considered a failed creation, too dangerous to be wielded by anyone else and usually stored in a large tank of jelly. His personal Zanpakutou, or if he even has one, has yet to be revealed. Absurdly Sharp Blade: Sayafushi, the sword he wields against the Schutzstaffel, is so sharp that a scabbard can't be created for it. He laments that because of this it fails to meet the basic standards of a sword and couldn't be given to anyone. Beware the Silly Ones: For all his jovial eccentricity, he traps Ichigo and Renji in a pit with wrathful Asauchi for three days just to test them. When he does finally fight, he's very no-nonsense and quick to kill. He also follows-through to make sure the enemies he's downed really are mortally wounded. The only reason the Elite Guard manage to survive against him at all is thanks to Yhwach's Auswählen. Cloudcuckoolander: Even amongst his colleagues, Ōetsu is pretty bizarre, largely stemming from his hamminess. Hikifune warns Ichigo and Renji beforehand that he's unpredictable, and he proceeds to greet them on a stage with a harem of female Zanpakuto and make them awkwardly handstand to take embarrassing pictures of them. Crazy-Prepared: As the creator of all Zanpakuto, he has an idea of what an Asauchi will become when they bond with a Soul Reaper and is presumably nearly as old as Ichibē himself. He tends to hang onto "failed" creations (likeSayafushi) in the event they might come in handy, and is also the creator ofShinken Hakkyōken, the god-slayer blade, putting it in the position of becoming an ancestral blade to the Ise family.

characters.name: Thirteen Court Guard
characters.description: Asskicking Leads to Leadership: Downplayed. Soul Reapers mostly get to the highest positions by being the strongest and/or most skilled; one's power usually corresponds to their position and rank. However, it’s also worth noting thatsimply using prestige and suchisn't enough to earn respect (though it does help). It should also be noted that there’s other methods to become a captain that involve less bloodshed than others, and we don’t know how each and every captain we see in the story managed to attain their current position, so it’s unknown how many captains got promoted to the position through more bureaucratic means and how many got the rank throughKlingon Promotionlike Zaraki did. Badass Army: The Court Guard Squads as a whole are this with each Captain being aOne-Man ArmyandPhysical Godin their own rights. They simultaneously fended offSōsukeAizen's invasion of the Living World and helped rescueOrihime InouefromHueco Mundo. After a crushing first defeat they assisted in bringing down theWandenreichand its Quincy leaderYhwach. Beware the Silly Ones: Many of them are weird and eccentric (with some even beingdownright insane), but at the end of the day, they’re still a military force mostly comprised of thousands of soldiers who have literally centuries of experience fighting ghost monsters who can easily kill humans. Blind Obedience: The 13 Court Guards are expected to carry out the will of the Central 46 without question. Even the captains are powerless to challenge the decisions made by the Central 46. Defying these decisions is considered treason, and merely questioning their orders is strictly forbidden. This clear flaw in the system is what Aizen exploited when he disguised himself as the Central 46 to orchestrate Rukia's execution. It also explains why Yamamoto was furious with Ukitake and Kyouraku for their perceived treachery. Additionally, this context sheds light on Byakuya's willingness to support his sister's execution, despite the fact that further

characters.name: Central  46 & Noble Houses
characters.description: Adaptational Villainy: The anime adaptation made the original Central 46 worse by showing how they inadvertentlycreated many villains and antagonistsof thefillerarcs through their actions or how their rules help some of them out as well. The next iteration isn't shown to be much better either with a short story showing one member of Central 46 sell out a fellow member to Shaz Domino to save himself. Aristocrats Are Evil:Zig-Zagged; there are certainly more corrupt members ofhighSoul Society. Asshole Victim: After learning the roles a previous iteration of Central 46 played it's hard to feel sorry when those members end up being slain;fillermaterialshelp expand uponthe problemsInherent in the Systemwith Soul Society's government. Badass Bureaucrat: Some of Soul Society's upper echelons are actually quite capable of kicking ass and taking names. The Beautiful Elite:Deconstructed; with a few exceptions Soul Society's upper class have a tendency to flaunt themselves which leads to them being viewed as untrustworthy and/or unreliable.

characters.name: Kukaku Shiba
characters.description: Action Girl: Mainly in the video games, but in canon she's perfectly willing to jump into the fray againstAizen. Angst? What Angst?:Invoked. Unlike Ganju, she never was angry at Rukia for Kaien's death, mainly because she knew the full story from Ukitake. She even punches Rukia when for repeatedly apologizing and tells her it's all right. An Arm and a Leg: She's missing her right arm. The anime depicts herwith a prostheticwooden one. Beauty Is Never Tarnished: Downplayed. She lacks an arm. In the anime she replaces it with a prosthetic one; in the manga she has only her stump. She is still a good-looking woman who acts as aMs. Fanservice. Cool Big Sis: She's Ganju's spunky and badass older sister, and she also acts as a helpful older sister figure to Ichigo's gang. A more tomboyish example, so this is especially evident when she's calm and relaxed.

characters.name: Ganju Shiba
characters.description: Badass Biker: Substitute the motorcycle with a literal hog and he fits the bill, or at least tries to. Big Ol' Eyebrows: He has thick, imposing eyebrows. Boisterous Bruiser: He's loud, aggressive and on the crude side. Combat Pragmatist: What do you do when you know you're vastly outclassed by your opponent? Keeprunning awayandplaying the fooluntil they drop their guard, then throw afireworkathis hairandget the hell out of Dodge. Demoted to Extra: While he served as a major ally during the Soul Society arc, once that concluded, he all but vanished from the story forseven yearsin real time. He wouldn't show up at all outside of animefilleruntilthe final arc, upon which he becomes one of Ichigo's allies in fighting the Wandenreich, though he doesn't do much even with the team.

characters.name: Yūshirō Sakimune Shihōin
characters.description: Ambiguously Brown: Yuushirou has very dark skin, but standard features for a manga character (large eyes, small nose, slim build). As a result, the reason for the dark skin is impossible to visually figure out and the ethnicity of the Shihouin family is never discussed. Badass Adorable: He took over as the head of House Shihōin after Yoruichi disappeared. He's emotional, sensitive, and very affectionate, especially towards his older sister whom he idolises. However, he mastered Shunkou in a very short space of time and his physical strength is so great he can take on Sternritter-level opponents. A single punch was enough to make Nakk Le Vaar take him seriously.Askin Nakk Le Vaar:"W...Wait... This is insanity! You can't be this strong!" Berserk Button: Being mistaken for a girl on account of his slender build enrages him to the extent he promptly cuts loose on Nakk Le Vaar and pummels him withRapid-Fire Fisticuffs. Big Sister Worship: He deeply admires Yoruichi. He expresses great sadness when Yoruichi goes ahead of him in his first appearance, and later expresses great joy when he reunites with her. He abandons the group of Soul Reapers he's with to rush to her side and is willing to fight the Sternritter just for insulting her. Dude Looks Like a Lady: He is small and slight of build with very feminine facial appearance and hair bound into a pony tail. He looks like a younger version of his older sister, Yoruichi. When Nakk Le Vaar first sees him, he mistakes Yushirou for a girl, much to Yushirou's indignation.

characters.name: Yuichi Shibata
characters.description: Death of a Child: He was a young boy when Shrieker separated his soul from his body, a separation that lasted so long Shibata was unable to return to it. After Shrieker is defeated anDragged Off to Hell, Shibata is given the konso to allow him to pass on to Soul Society. Last-Name Basis: He's most often referred to by his family name Shibata. It's only much later that Sado starts referring to him as Yuichi. Trauma Conga Line: His parents were murdered by Shrieker, then Shibata was murdered as well. While his parents were located by the Soul Reapers and able to ascend to the Soul Society, Shibata was trapped in a bird's body so that Shrieker could have some more fun at the boy's expense. When Shrieker is finally defeated and Shibata is able to ascend, he finds out that Soul Reapers randomly assign souls to random districts, so there's no guarantee he'll ever reunite with his parents. Poor kid.

characters.name: Jidanbo Ikkanzaka
characters.description: Ambiguously Human: With the exception of Komamura, all Soul Reapers were either deceased humans or at the very least descended from human souls. Jidanbo not only looks inhuman, but he's got a younger brother that's only one or two feet taller than the average human. It's possible the giants belonged to some now-extinct race of fantasy beings that only exist in the Soul Society at this point, but none of that is confirmed in-universe. An Arm and a Leg: His arm got ripped off by Gin. (The anime tones down to a small gash) Brainwashed and Crazy:During their assault on Soul Society, Pepe of the Wandenreich manages to put Jidanbo under his control, after which he is made to attack Squad 12. Dual Wielding: He wields two massive cleavers. Dumb Muscle: When counting a 10-hit combo he clearly shows little knowledge of numbers or counting, especially since it ends up becoming a13-hit combo.Jidanbo: One! Two! Three! Four! Five! Six! Seven! Seven! Six! Eight! Um... Six! Eight! Time to finish up... Ten!!!

characters.name: Hisana Kuchiki
characters.description: Barefoot Poverty: Before her marriage to Byakuya, she was so overwhelmingly poor that not having a pair of simple straw sandals were literally theleastof her worries. Incurable Cough of Death: She passed away from an illness, with one symptom being uncontrollable coughing. Inter-Class Romance: Despite being a commoner, Byakuya fell in love with her and they marry. The Lost Lenore: Without her, the Soul Society arc would never have unfolded the way it did as she was the root cause of the two conflicting vows that forced Byakuya to be Ichigo's main antagonist. My Greatest Failure: Due to having abandoned Rukia as a baby, Hisana considers herself unworthy of being Rukia's sister and insists to Byakuya that henever revealthe blood relationship to Rukia if he ever manages to find her.

characters.name: Great Old One
characters.description: Big "SHUT UP!": He bellows "JUST SHUT YOUR MOUTH!" when Komamura tries to appeal to him. Canis Major: He is a giant dog that even dwarfs a character as large as Komamura. Hate Sink: In addition to laughing off Komamura's request to learn his clan's secret arts, he flat out admits he doesn't care what happens to Soul Society. Later, it's revealed that he knew that the Human Transformation Technique would turn Komamura into an ordinary powerless wolf after it wears off. Not only is he not upset about it, he's thrilled at Komamura succumbing to his clans roots of revenge, and at the prospect that his grandson's life is ruined and his Soul Reaper days are over. There's nothing redeeming about him and he's very clearly written that way because he's lampshaded in-universe as an example of the Buddhist "sin" of ignorance, and only seemingly exists to kick Komamura out of the plot. Jerkass: The first time he ever takes great pride in Komamura is after he falls into the state of a mindless beast fuelled only by the thirst for revenge that has consumed the clan. Karma Houdini: While he was punished for his sins in life, in his afterlife he lords over his clan members and devours their hearts with no one to stop him.

characters.name: Former Residents
characters.description: SeeAizen & His Cohorts

characters.name: Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto
characters.description: His Zanpakuto is namedRyujin Jakka, rightfully reputed as the most powerful fire-type. His Bankai isZanka no Tachi, rightfully reputed to be the equivalent of aweapon of mass destruction, capable of instantly drying the air itself, harnessing heat equivalent to that of the Sun, and even re-animating the bones and ashes of fallen enemies. Adapted Out: He's absent in every musical theater adaptation prior to the 2024 production adapting the start of the Arrancar arc. Adaptational Jerkass: The movies tend to make him antagonistic towards the heroes. In the first movie, he plans to nuke the enemies even if it would cost Senna's life. In the second movie, he genuinely believes that Hitsugaya became a traitor and sends the Gotei 13 to arrest him, despite the lack of a motive. The third movie justifies this since everyone of the Gotei 13 forgot who Ichigo was. The fourth movie is an exception, where he merely gives Ichigo a littleNice Job Breaking It, Hero!speech. In the filler arcs as well as in the canon story, Genryūsai trusts Ichigo and would support him, even if he has to deceive Ichigo first. Arc Villain: Subverted. As the leader of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads, he's initially set as the main antagonist of the Soul Society arc, but once Aizen's conspiracy is revealed and he fully takes the position ofBig Bad, Yamamoto instead becomes theBig Goodof the story during the following arcs. Animate Dead: The ability of Zanka no Tachi South: Kaka Juuman Okushi Daisoujin. By impaling the tip of his sword into the ground, Yamamoto can summonup to ten trillion reanimated corpses to fight on his behalf. They're actually the corpses of those that have been killed by Ryūjin Jakka's flames. He can bring forth any of his victims he wishes for the purpose of psychological combat by using the corpse of a person that was close to his enemy in life.

characters.name: Chojiro Tadaoki Sasakibe
characters.description: His Zanpakuto is namedGonryomaru, a traditional western rapier with electrical abilities. His Bankai isKōkō Gonryō Rikyū, capable of calling down thunderstorms and bolts of lightning. Adaptational Badass: The anime adaptation of theThousand Year Blood Wararc shows that he managed to strike a blow on Yhwach during Yhwach's duel with Yamamoto. This allowed Yamamoto to unleash his Bankai on Yhwach and win the fight. Adaptation Dye-Job: In the manga, his eyes are solid gold with neither pupils nor sclera. In the anime, he's given normal sclera and pupils, leaving him with golden irises, though these additions are removed in the adaptation for theThousand Year Blood Wararc. All There in the Manual: He's so much a part of the background in the manga that most of the information comes from the databooks. It's not until the final arc that we see flashbacks explaining his relationship with Yamamoto. Brits Love Tea: He's not technically a Brit, but heisa big fan of the British tea culture.

characters.name: Genshirō Okikiba
characters.description: Replacement Flat Character: He takes over Chojiro Sasakibe's role, but he gets even less characterisation. We don't even know anything about his Zanpakuto.

characters.name: Soi Fon
characters.description: Her Zanpakuto is namedSuzumebachi, an ornate gauntlet and stinger enveloping her right middle finger. It allows her to instantly kill her enemy if she hits the same spot twice. Her Bankai isJakuhō Raikōben, an enormous battery housing a missile with enough destructive power to level a city block. She is able to use a special form of Shunko calledMukyu Shunkō, which recycles the energy she uses to grant her infinite stamina. Action Girl: She's a Captain for a reason and gets a lot of opportunities to show off in fights. She even helps defeat the former God-King of Hueco Mundo. Ambiguously Gay: The true nature of Soi Fon's attachment to her mentor, Yoruichi, and her sexuality in general is treated ambiguously. She's a stern, no-nonsense personality who wilts and fawns in the presence of Yoruichi. Yoruichi used to be her entire world, someone she worshipped; her loyalty was so great that, when her mentor went on the run from Soul Society without warning, Soi Fon was devastated. When Yoruichi returns after a hundred years, Soi Fon is so angry she tries to kill her beforebreaking down in tears, begging to know why Yoruichi didn't take her into exile with her. In supplemental material, slice-of-life comedy sketches focus on her attempting to sneak photographs of Yoruichi in nude. The anime team played with this, creating filler episodes that create heavyShip Teasebetween the two women. In the post-manga novels, the villain can insult her subordinates and family and mock the incompetence of her division, but the only thing that makes her angry is his suggestion that he take Yoruichi as his wife. When Yoruichi rejects Tokinada, Soi Fon is so happy that she forgets her mission. Anchored Attack Stance: In order to counter her Bankai's tremendous recoil, she has to anchor herself to a large stationary object by wrapping a heavy metal sash around it, making her largely immobile. The one time we see her doing this is against Baraggan, where she wraps the sash around the building

characters.name: Marechiyo Yoshiayamenosuke Nikkōtarōemon Ōmaeda
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isGegetsuburi, a large spiked flail. Acrofatic: You'd expect that him being fat would make him slow. Rather, hewantsyou to think that. You would be wrong. He's the lieutenant of the Gotei 13's ninja division for a very good reason. Adaptational Badass: The anime allows him to defeat Nirgge Parduoc properly by crushing him with his zanpakuto in contrast with the manga where Nirgge is accidentally killed by Ggio when the throws Soi Fon towards him, making Omaeda look more competent. Benevolent Boss: Sort of, as despite his loudmouthed and pompous personality, he does seem to think about looking out for others even if it's just to give himself a better image. The databooks mention that he's responsible for improving the quality of life for his squad's living conditions by paying out of his pocket, adding all sorts of amenities to the point that Isane admits to being jealous when interviewed. He also lets his fellow lieutenants (mostly Shuhei) freeload off of him just because he can, and the post-manga novels reveal that his family hires members of the werewolf clan, who are implied to face some prejudice as Komamura originally felt the need to hide his own face when he joined the Soul Reapers. If nothing else, hisCondescending Compassionis still a slight step up from his captain who initially expects her subordinates to risk their lives and not much else. Big Brother Instinct: He'll do anything to protect his little sister Mareyo. He normally a coward, but whenBG9attacks her, he goes absolutelyberserk. The animated adaptation of the blood war goes further and has him successfullyTaking the Bulletfor her during said instance.

characters.name: Marenoshin Ōmaeda
characters.description: Father to Marechiyo and lieutenant to Yoruichi, Marenoshin retired from his position and fathered four children (two daughters; two sons), living in a luxurious lifestyle typical of aristocrats. All There in the Manual: Everything we know about him was revealed in theMaskeddatabook and the novel 'Spirits Are Forever With You'. Always Someone Better: Despite sharing his son'sUpper-Class Twitattitude, The post-manga novel 'Spirits Are Forever With You' shows that he's actually considerably more powerful and respected than his son even as aRetired Badass. Being capable of threatening a formerKenpachiwith Kido alone and being treated with respect bySoi Foneven if he's been retired for literal centuries makes it clear that during his time as Yoruichi'sNumber Twohe was a completely different beast than his son despite the similarities in personalities. Early-Bird Cameo: In an after-episode segment and manga omake, we get our first glimpse of Marenoshin when Marechiyo introduced the Ōmaeda family to Ichigo and Rukia. In particular, Marenoshin now has darker and curlier brown hair, along with a pair of sunglasses, extra weight and tons of jewellery. Fat and Skinny: The Fat to Yoruichi's Skinny.

characters.name: Gin Ichimaru
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isShinso, which has the ability to instantly turn to dust, expand, then reform, giving the illusion that the blade simply extends lightning-fast. His BankaiKamishini no Yariupgrades his basic Shikai abilities to almost unfathomable speeds and distances, along with the ability to poison enemies with the dust produced by the blade. The Ace: According to hisstats, he is aJack of All Tradeswho is pretty good at everything he does. He was aChild Prodigywho graduated from the Soul Reaper Academy in just one year. The only other Soul Reaper that graduated that fast was Toshiro Hitsugaya. He has a genius intellect, a highly proficent swordsman, an expert of Shunpo, and a moderate amount of Spiritual Power. It's pretty telling that of all the characters in the series,hecame the closest to ever killing Aizen. Alas, Poor Villain: His death is played very solemnly, with a flashback revealing his motivation for joining Aizen and his strong love and devotion for Rangiku. In the end, his last moments see Rangiku crying over his dying body—the absolute last thing he wanted to see before his death. All for Nothing: He spentdecadesto get close to Aizen and kill him and learn his secrets. Even though he finally manages to strike him down, Aizen comes back stronger than ever and kills Gin and wasting his life-long efforts for revenge. And to twist the knife even further, Rangiku shows up to watch him die, leaving her nothing behind but a broken heart. Ambiguous Situation: Despite being a naturalTrollamong other traits, a deeper exploration into his character and motivations reveals a complicated picture—it's often unclear whether his antics are purely for his own amusement or if there’s a deeper purpose at play. His relentless trolling of Rukia, like deceiving her about saving her from execution and ensuring she makes contact with Aaronierro, is remarkably cruel. However, considering how these experiences ultimately push her to confront and overcome herDeath Seekertendenc

characters.name: Izuru Kira
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isWabisuke, a strange L-hook-shaped katana with the sharp edge of the blade on the inside of the hook. It doubles the weight of anything it strikes and its peculiar shape makes it ideal for framing a person's neck to behead them. Artificial Zombie: Mayuri turns him into one, after Bazz-B kills him by blasting a good chunk of his torso away. The Atoner:He blames himself for getting manipulated into attacking Momo, as well as luring Rangiku and Toshiro away from Central 46(inadvertently leading to Momo meeting up with Aizen and Aizen stabbing Momo) and tries to make up for it.During Izuru and Hisagi's trial following Aizen's defeat, Izuru adamantly refuses to have Gin take the blame for the things that Izuru did of his own volition, such as attacking Momo. Nayura deduces that Izuru has become the kind of man who can only connect with the world by atoning for his sins, which is why he doesn't like being forgiven or having his crimes being blamed on others. He blames himself for getting manipulated into attacking Momo, as well as luring Rangiku and Toshiro away from Central 46(inadvertently leading to Momo meeting up with Aizen and Aizen stabbing Momo) and tries to make up for it. During Izuru and Hisagi's trial following Aizen's defeat, Izuru adamantly refuses to have Gin take the blame for the things that Izuru did of his own volition, such as attacking Momo. Nayura deduces that Izuru has become the kind of man who can only connect with the world by atoning for his sins, which is why he doesn't like being forgiven or having his crimes being blamed on others.

characters.name: Chikane Iba
characters.description: All There in the Manual: Everything we know about her was found in the MASKED databook and the Death Save the Strawberry novel. Generation Xerox: Her son made it his mission to become a lieutenant so he can please his mother, herself a long-serving lieutenant. Iron Lady: While not without hersoft spots, Chikane is described as an abrasive and strict woman with uncompromising high expectations in others and even her own son calls her a "witch". Old Soldier: Seemingly was one of the longest serving lieutenants among the Gotei 13, having served in her role even before Rose originally becameThe Captainof Squad 3. Pet the Dog: As abrasive as she is, she's the one who pushed for Rose to become her captain, according to Rose himself in the Death Save the Strawberry novel.

characters.name: Retsu Unohana
characters.description: Being one of the senior captains, Unohana harbors great wisdom and perception, and prefers supporting from behind. In fact, she is the only one to notice that something amiss when Aizen 'died' and was able to catch up with him and correctly identify him as a traitor, which prompts him to reveal his trickery... andrun offinstead of taking her out. Her Zanpakuto and Bankai are both namedMinazuki(肉雫唼 for Shikai, 皆尽 for Bankai). Her Shikai takes the form of a green manta ray that can hold wounded people in its stomach and heal them over time. Her Bankai produces massive quantities of blood that she can manipulate with her blade. Achey Scars: Her front-braided hair hides a nasty chest scar. Zaraki inflicted it on her when he was a child and it throbs whenever she hears his voice. Action Girl: The databooks revealed early on that she was a power fighter specialist and expert swordsman, contrasting heavily with her role as the medic usually in the back lines. She's the original Kenpachi and is brought forward by Kyoraku to help train Kenpachi Zaraki, who she proceeds tohand his assto with minimal effort at the start of the training. Animal Motifs: The manta ray is both graceful and dangerous, and has been associated with both medicine and destruction in folklore. Unohana, considered the most beautiful woman in Soul Society, was the most dangerous killer of her generation, and the initial reason she mastered the art of healing was so that she could prolong her fights for as long as possible. Initially the founder of both the Kenpachi position and the Eleventh Division, she eventually came to define the role of the Fourth Division as a combat medical unit, becoming the Thirteen Court Guard Squads's pre-eminent doctor.

characters.name: Isane Kotetsu
characters.description: Her Zanpakuto isItegumo, which can generate ice with a healing property. Absurd Phobia: For some odd reason, she has nightmares over...fish paste. Adapted Out: Nowhere to be seen in the musical adaptations. All There in the Manual:Word of Godstates that her Zanpakuto is ice-based and has the ability to heal. Attack! Attack! Attack!: At one point, she charges the escaping Sosuke AizenandGin Ichimaru. That was after she was the first of the three to call out her shikai against Ichigo when he stopped them from chasing Renji and Rukia.

characters.name: Seinosuke Yamada
characters.description: Older brother of Hanataro and the former lieutenant to Unohana. Seinosuke was reputed to have a "bad character", but made up for it through his loyalty to Unohana. He is currently a medical advisor for noble families. All There in the Manual: His rank, his name, his height, his weight and his birthday, along with his design, were all shown in theMaskeddatabook. His first actual appearance in the series outside a cameo is in the novelCan't Fear Your Own World. Big Brother Bully: He is Hanataro's older brother and likes to mess around with him. In his debut scene inCan't Fear Your Own Worldalone, he mocks Hanataro's lifeless looks and ponders if patients would want to kill themselves just from being under his care. A Day in the Limelight: Appears as cameos at best in the main series or official art, but has a considerable presence inCan't Fear Your Own World. In particular, he tends to Hikone's wounds and has some awareness of Tokinada's plans. Dr. Jerk: He is a fantastic medic, but his personality is horrible and he apparently has questionable ethics as a doctor. This caused him to often clash with Unohana, and the friction lead to problems with Squad 4. Despite their mutual respect for one another, it's implied Seinosuke's promotion to General Director of the Central Medical Institute was also beneficial for Unohana and her squad, with Urahara noting how nice the next Squad 4 lieutenant (Isane) is.

characters.name: Yasochika Iemura
characters.description: No-Respect Guy: Iemura's frustrated by the lack of recognition he gets in spite of being 3rd in command of his division. Stepford Smiler: He's got a habit of venting his annoyances with his fellow Soul Repears in his diary, only to cross it out and rewrite something more flattering.

characters.name: Hanataro Yamada
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isHisagomaru, a katana that heals damage instead of dealing it when it cuts. Upon "absorbing" enough wounds, it transforms into a tiny scalpel capable of launching a single disproportionately powerful energy blast. Awesome, but Impractical: His Zanpakuto release produces a massive attack, but he can only use it once and then he's forced to fight with a scalpel. Butt-Monkey: Squad 4 is typically bullied by other squads, but only Hanataro is also bullied byother Squad 4 members. Cowardly Lion: Though he is weak physically, when Ganju refused to risk himself for his brother's killer in the Soul Society arc Hanataro began to head out to hold offByakuya Kuchikiall on his own. Crippling Overspecialization: He is very competent at healing, but his combat skills are lacking and he can't even useShunpo. Even his sword is designed to absorb the injuries done to other people, healing them in the process. The energy absorbed by the sword can be fired in a single, powerful attack that reduces the sword to a scalpel until it can absorb more energy.

characters.name: Harunobu Ogidō
characters.description: Chick Magnet: According to the first official character book, Ogido is very attractive to a lot female Soul Reapers.

characters.name: Momo Hinamori
characters.description: Her ZanpakutoTobiumelets her launch fireballs. However, she mainly fights using complex Kido spells expertly woven together. Action Girl: In anime filler she tends to be given a much more active role and can be found fighting captains or hunting rebelling Zanpakuto spirits. TheAdaptation Expansionof the final arc's anime adaptation puts her in more of aCombat Medicrole. Action Survivor: Following Aizen's defeat and his psychological grip on her broken, Hinamori falls into this during the adaptation of the final arc, fighting through the Wandenreich's Soldat and being in the thick of dealing with fightersfarmore powerful than her, such as Bambietta and Gerald Valkyrie...yetstillmanaging to survive and/or get away. Adaptation Expansion: Cour 4 of the final arc confirms that she was the one who healed Renji and Rukia after Gerald Valkyrie blew them all away. Ambiguous Situation: During a Q&A session, a curious fan asked if Momo and Aizen had"done it"the night before Aizen's supposed murder, when she falls asleep in his quarters. Kubo decided to not answer that, directly invoking theRule of Funas the reason.

characters.name: Ginrei Kuchiki
characters.description: A Day in the Limelight: Flashbacks in the Zanpakuto Rebellion filler arc prominently feature him as Koga's father figure who witnesses (and unwittingly contributes to) Koga'sFace–Heel Turn, before sealing him away. Old Soldier: Was sort of shown to be this in flashback episodes of the filler Muramasa arc, only not nearly as much of one as Yamamoto when the two seal away a renegade member of the former's clan.In Klub Outside, Kubo states that he is included among the senior captains during the Turn Back the Pendulum arc along with Kyoraku, Ukitake and Unohana, citing Kyoraku omitting his name as a mistake. In Klub Outside, Kubo states that he is included among the senior captains during the Turn Back the Pendulum arc along with Kyoraku, Ukitake and Unohana, citing Kyoraku omitting his name as a mistake. Screw This, I'm Out of Here!: Played for laughs in one omake where a young Byakuya asks where Ginrei's kenseiken is. The Stoic: Probably given how little reaction he had to Yoruichi pestering his grandson a century before the series began.

characters.name: Byakuya Kuchiki
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isSenbonzakura, a sword that scatters into a thousand pieces resembling cherry petals that can instantly skewer his enemies. His Bankai is namedSenbonzakura Kageyoshi, a highly flexible form which has many different forms and levels, that can be switched through depending on the situation. The most basic form is a more extensive and powerful version of his Shikai, manifesting as a thousand large swords from the ground which then scatter into millions of "petals"; by using a form calledGōkei, he can organise the petals into a sphere that surrounds and engulfs an opponent from all sides, leaving no escape. The Bankai's true form, which concentrates the petals into thousands of swords that create a massive killing arena of floating swords that he can mentally control in bulk or summon one at a time to his hand. The most powerful form of his Bankai isShukei: Hakuteiken, which condenses the Bankai into a single white sword and surrounds his body in a pure white aura that creates a halo over his head and flares out from his body like the wings of an angel. The Ace: Byakuya Kuchiki comes from one of the most esteemed noble clans in Soul Society. He is very proficient in every form of Soul Reaper combat; Zanjutsu; Hoho; Kido; and especially Shunpo. He possesses a versatile and deadly Zanpakuto that allows him to telekinetically manipulate blade fragments that resemble cherry blossoms. Hanataro Yamada states that he is the most famous of the current Captains, and is notable for being one of the first opponents along with Renji that provides a legitmate challenge for Ichigo, serving as a key motivator for Ichigo to get stronger. InCan't Fear Your Own World, Shunsui notes briefly that if anything were to happen to him, Byakuya would most likely succeed him as Head-Captain. Achilles' Heel: He doesn't allow his Shikai or Bankai within an 85-centimeter radius of himself. If push comes to shove, such as it did with Tsukishima, he can and will violate this safety bubb

characters.name: Sojun Kuchiki
characters.description: All There in the Manual: His appearance, his height, his rank, his weight and his birthday were all found in theMaskeddatabook. Strong Family Resemblance: Byakuya very strongly resembles his deceased father Sojun. The only difference between them is in the way they each wore their hair, and that Sojun's face usually had a much gentler expression.

characters.name: Ginjiro Shirogane
characters.description: All There in the Manual: The fact that he even exists. We still don't know what he looks like. He does, however, have a minor role in a post-manga novel. Determinator: Shirogane once sent a pair of sunglasses to Byakuya, but his ex-captain sent them back, saying that he didn't want them. Shirogane doesn't seem to care; he keeps sending sunglasses to Byakuya, anyway. Nice Guy: Takes his ex-captain's indifference in stride, and even gave a discount to Renji, but it's subverted in the latter case. The prices of sunglasses are so high, that even with the discount, Renji still has problems getting the goggles that he wants.

characters.name: Rikichi Yuki
characters.description: Plucky Comic Relief: Rikichi tends to goof off alot, such as when he nearly loses a Hell butterfly and tries to lure it back with an obvious decoy in the hopes it would try to mate with it. Nevertheless, he's a determined Soul Reaper who sees Renji as his role model. Screw the Rules, I'm Doing What's Right!: After Byakuya beats Renji, Rikichi calls Hanataro to heal him, stating that his loyalty is to Renji rather than to Squad 6 as a whole.

characters.name: Sajin Komamura
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isTenken, a large sword that is duplicated as a phantom-like form. His Bankai isKokujō Tengen Myō'ō, an enormous armored giant that mimics his every move. When Komamura takes a human-like form, his Bankai removes its armor to becomeKokujō Tengen Myō'ō: Dangai Jōe, a giant that is invulnerable to physical harm. Adapted Out: Has not been included in any of the musical theater adaptations. All for Nothing: Yamamoto's death drives Komamura to undergo the Human Metamorphosis, temporarily gaining more power and immortality at the cost of losing his humanity. After his fight with Bambietta, the timer runs out and Komamura transforms into a wolf without power or the ability to speak and is therefore unable to continue the quest to defeat Yamamoto's killer, Yhwach. With Yhwach's final fate to become the new Soul King and be protected by the Soul Reapers that had previously been trying to kill him, Komamura's sacrifice achieves none of the goals Komamura set for himself. To rub salt in the wounds even further, his final opponent, Bambietta, ends up getting revived as a zombie, and Mayuri dispatches her with no effort, meaning even his final battle was completely meaningless other than to make him the first major casuality of the 2nd invasion. All of the Other Reindeer: Why he wore a mask, and why he was so quick to form a friendship with Tosen. His shame in his appearance is the focal point of the friction between him and his great-grandfather, who scolds him for hiding it. Ironically, the Soul Reaper's actually prefer him without his mask, since hiding his face made him less trustful. By the time he's openly showing his face to everyone, nobody bats an eye, and only his enemies would ever mock him for his appearance. Always Someone Better: Iba specifically points him out as one to Ikkaku by comparing their Bankai, as Komamura’s has all of his own’s strengths and none of its flaws. It’s emphasized in order to humble him and remind him that even when achieving Ba

characters.name: Tetsuzaemon Iba
characters.description: BFS: His unnamed Shikai takes the form of a large falchion with a spike protruding from it. Blood Knight: He used to be in the eleventh division and still duels Ikkaku from time to time. He only transferred out in order to become a lieutenant. In the manga, Ikkaku remarks that Tetsuzaemon's still an eleventh division member at heart after Tetsuzaemon says it would be fun to fight Ichigo. Blunt "Yes": When Ikkaku asks Iba if he thinks Ikkaku allowed himself to lose to Poww, Iba says yes. Butt-Monkey: The Soul Reaper Men's association frequently gets its budget cut and forced out of the meeting spaces it has. Combat Pragmatist: Believes that the most important thing when fighting for one's division is winning, even if it involves running away or taking an opponent from behind.

characters.name: Jin'emon Kotsubaki
characters.description: All There in the Manual: Everything known about him was revealed in theMaskeddatabook. Cool Old Guy: Appears to be in his late-forties, by the time he was Love's lieutenant. Cool Shades: Frameless red sunglasses, specifically. Good Scars, Evil Scars: One runs along the left side of his face, from his forehead, through his eye and to his cheek.

characters.name: Atau Rindou
characters.description: His zanpakuto's name is unknown, but it can summon a kettle of hawks to attack the enemy. Animal Lover: He’s first introduced surrounded by animals, implying he he has a soft side for them. Animal Motifs: Hawks. His Shikai's special ability summons a whole flock of them. Pretty Boy: He's very pretty with his androgynous features and thick wavy hair. The Speechless: He cannot speak out loud, which in a world ofCalling Your AttacksandBy the Power of Grayskull!would be quite a disadvantage, but is able to make up for it by writing the name of his Shikai directly on the blade.

characters.name: Jirōbō Ikkanzaka
characters.description: His zanpakuto isTsunzakigarasu, which is able to summon a group of flying blades that the wielder can mentally control where they go. Adapted Out:Downplayed Trope.BLEACH: Rebirth of Soulsrecreates the scene where he attacks Uryu and Orihime, but rather than having a unique character model and being identified by name, he is replaced by a generic nameless Shinigami whonever even gets to release his Zanpakuto. Asshole Victim: He's on the recieving end of arguably the most one-sidedCurb-Stomp Battlein the entire series, and ends up permanentlyBrought Down to Normalas a result, but his personality makes it clear he's utterly underserving of any sympathy. Break the Haughty: He's an arrogant jerk who getsCurb Stompedby Ishida without landing a single hit on him, and ends up getting permanently Brought Down To Normal for his troubles. De-power: Ishida renders him permanently powerless by using his Heilig Pfeil to destroy his Saketsu and Hakusui with by two shots, sending him flying back and effectively ridding him of his Soul Reaper powers by cutting off his Reiryoku production.

characters.name: Shunsui Sakuranosuke Jirō Kyōraku
characters.description: His zanpakuto isKaten Kyokotsu, one of the very few dual Zanpakutos. Their power is to make children's games real, which grants him various strange abilities, from "playing word games" with his opponents to seemingly hiding within shadows themselves. His bankai isKaten Kyokotsu: Karamatsu Shinjuu. Its powers are fairly obscure: Utilizing four tragic stories, it can cast four terrifying curses upon anyone within its range —allies and himselfincluded, making his Bankai exceptionally difficult to unleash. Absurdly High-Stakes Game: Shunsui weaponizes games with his Shikai. Utilizing it, he can catch his opponent in a children's game where the rules vary depending on what his Zanpakto wants to play. It mixes up combat and game rules, with the loser inevitably dying. Adaptational Superpower Change: As his abilities weren't truly revealed until his fight with Starrk in the Arrancar arc, some videogames including Shunsui as a playable character such as theBleach: Heat The Soulseries give Katen Kyokotsu completely different abilities than the ones in canon (likely based in its activation command), in particularthe one to manipulate wind and create tornadoes. This change turns out to not becompletelyoff the mark, as he's eventually revealed to have at least one wind-based technique in the form of Bushogoma. Agent Peacock: He likes to enter a fight in a swirl of rose petals and he wears a flowery, pink woman's kimono that once belonged to his sister-in-law. According to the SOULS character book, he is officially Soul Society's biggest dandy. Befitting this trope, he is also a captain and therefore in a position ofRank Scales with Asskicking. On one occasion, he tries to make sure his flowery kimono doesn't get damaged in battle, only to deliberately ruin part of his actual uniform. Antagonist in Mourning: His expression when he cuts down Starrk is outright aggrieved as he recognizes the other man is hardly evil. His dialogue after implies he doesn't feel great about the fight

characters.name: Nanao Ise
characters.description: Her zanpakuto's name isShinken Hakkyōken. It was passed down her family, and is used for rituals where the divine intervenes. As such, it is considered a "godslayer" — it reflects divine light and deals grievous damage to holy beings. A-Cup Angst: TheBeach Episodeshows that she is self-conscious about her small chest, barking back at Rangiku's teasing, and later wears pads that Rangiku happily exposes. Ancestral Weapon: Her Zanpakuto isn't actually her own, but is instead passed down to the heads of the Ise family. It's supposedly powerful enough to scatter the divine, but it is said to come with a personal curse that ensures all men who marry the women of the Ise clan die young. Nanao didn't have access to it for a long time because her mother made Kyouraku promise to hide it within his own Zanpakuto. Attack Reflector: Shinken Hakkyōken's power can deflect the power of godly beings. As such she's the only one able to defeat Lille at his full power. Barrier Warrior: Her Kido speciality; Shunsui claims it's why she made Lieutenant but she cryptically states that's not the only reason, which he doesn't want to discuss. Her barriers even impress Haschwalth, who admits breaking it took longer than expected; he also indicates he's been holding back while doing it.

characters.name: Yuyu Yayahara
characters.description: Her zanpakuto is unknown, but gives her the ability to summon a bear motif to deal damage. Airplane Arms: Runs with her arms extended straight out. Alliterative Name:YuyuYayahara Animal Motifs: Bears. The attacks of her Zanpakuto summon a bear to bite through enemies, her given name roughly means "bear-like" and she herself has a set of jagged teeth. Bears Are Bad News: Her Zanpakuto summons the image of a bear which can bite the head off of a gigantic Hollow.

characters.name: Tatsufusa Enjōji
characters.description: His zanpakuto isHozan, but its abilities are unknown. Amazon Chaser: Omakes and databooks indicate he's got the hots for Soi Fon. Hot-Blooded: He's a highly passionate man. Testosterone Poisoning: Enjōji is very tall and muscular, with an unbridled ego and haphazard sense of swordplay. A Twinkle in the Sky: Sado punches him so hard that he goes flying like this.

characters.name: Shuhei Hisagi
characters.description: His zanpakuto isKazeshini(Death's Wind), a pair of chained scythes though this is revealed to be only half of Kazeshini's Shikai. Once Hisagi unlocks his true power, the full, it's revealed that the scythes represent death, while the chain represents life. While fighting an opponent, more chains from Kazeshini wrap around the opponent; whilst the chains can connect with his opponent, any injury Hisagi sustains, fatal or otherwise, is immediately repaired as chains course through Hisagi's body and repair the injury. The power of his Bankai was not shown in the manga, but was revealed in the light novelBleach: Can't Fear Your Own World. It's name isFushi No Kōjyō(Undying Hangman's Noose). It takes the form of a large jet black ball of chains in the sky connecting one chain around Hisagi's neck like a noose, extending upward (as if he were actually hanging), with various individual chains extending from Hisagi's person; the scythes themselves remain unchanged. Alien Arts Are Appreciated: Though on a different realm rather than planet. He’s particularly interested in the living world and human society, and has interests including guitars (although he’sterrible at it) andmotorcycles. Anime Hair: Has unrealistically spiky hair, with the spikesneverbudging. Ascended Fanboy: Once Kensei agreed to be reinstated as Captain of the 9th Division, Hisagi was stated to have become the happiest he had ever been since becoming a Lieutenant. Badass Biker: Has an image of a badass (or at least attempts it) and owns a pretty spiffy and nice motorcycle he worked hard to buy. Ginjo notes the irony and impracticality of owning a bike in a world without gasoline (the Soul Society), but Hisagi somehow manages to get by.

characters.name: Toshimori Umesada
characters.description: Dirty Old Man: He hits on the15-year-oldOrihime. Small Name, Big Ego: Umesada holds himself in high esteem despite the fact his rank is incredibly low compared to every other named Soul Reaper.

characters.name: Toshiro Hitsugaya
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isHyorinmaru, the strongest of the ice-based Zanpakuto. His youth means his power is unmastered and immature, placing severe limits on his abilities. His Bankai isDaiguren Hyorinmaru, which enhances the volume of ice his weapon and attacks can produce. When fully mastered, his Bankai can prevent opponents from using their powers by freezing reishi. Actually a Doombot: Harribel enters her Resurreccíon and seems to immediately slice him in half, only to get assaulted by him a moment later. What she actually cut was a block of ice projecting his image, which he admitswon't fool her twice. All of the Other Reindeer: In his own words, when he was much younger: "They're scared of me. It's not like I did anything bad to them, but... even then, I could tell they were afraid of me." The databook indicates that he's much more popular now, but making captain and leading his Squad well could be seen as his won't-you-guide-my-sleigh-tonight moment. Anime Hair: Funny thing though, his hair hangs down in flashbacks and after the time skip, which seems to imply that he styles it for the majority of the series. Artistic Age: He has the height of a kid, but his face and overall demeanor make him look more like a very short and underdeveloped teenager when compared to other children.

characters.name: Rangiku Matsumoto
characters.description: Her Zanpakuto isHaineko, which dissolves into razor-sharp ash which she can control. Action Girl: Oh yes. She's a surprisingly effective fighter despite her lazy attitude. Adaptation Dye-Job: Her hair is blonde in the manga but strawberry blond in the anime. Oddly, she gets her original hair color back for a filler, Episode 304. In 2022, for the Thousand Year War anime, her hair finally turns manga-accurate, fully blonde. Adaptation Expansion: This is true for many other characters, but Rangiku in particular receives many,manyextra scenes in the original anime, usually forFanservice. All Women Are Lustful: Considering how her hobbies involve seducing men with her breasts.

characters.name: Gosuke Kiganjo
characters.description: Adaptational Heroism: If only due to Maki Ichinose being introduced prior to Gosuke's actual introduction of his true characterization in theTurn Back The Pendulumarc, and that if Maki's intended captain was intended to be a very different person. Despite being a lazy, boorish, and incompetent individual that was disliked by all of the Captains of that generation, he apparently inspired enough loyalty in Maki for the latter to conspire with the Bounts to avenge his captain's death despite his aforementioned traits. All There in the Manual: We learned of his height, name, weight, birthday, and design in theMaskeddatabook. Big Guy Fatality Syndrome: He was gigantic in life and the leader of the most brutish squad. He was also killed off by his eventual successor. Characterization Marches On: Retroactively and inadvertently due to the Bount Arc coming before the revelations of Kiganjo's true characterization. Maki's words and the general description painted the Captain as intended to be Kiganjo to be an admirable man of an implied benign character that was tragically cut down by Zaraki- serving as a motivation for Maki Ichinose to avenge him. Then theTurn Back The Pendulumarc reveals that Kiganjo was actually such aLazy Bumand boorish man that all of the Captains at the time didn't bat an eye when Zaraki killed him. The anime's decision indirectly caused the dissonance, and the intended anime-only character/Kiganjo's characterization intended by Kubo to result in drastically different interpretations of the same individual. Klingon Promotion: He killed the previous Kenpachi to become captain of the 11th division. The other captains weren't very impressed with him.

characters.name: Kenpachi Zaraki
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isNozarashi, and its Shikai turns it into an enormous cleaver that he claims can cut anything, even intangible items. Its Bankai(currently unnamed)is unique in that while the size of his sword decreases, his skin turns red and he enters an unstoppable berserker state. Absurd Cutting Power: Although most Zanpakuto are capable of cutting with unnatural ability even in a sealed state, Nozorashi's entire power is based on cutting. In base state, it can cut things other Zanpakuto can only handle when unsealed. Kenpachi claims there's nothing his Shikai cannot cut and demonstrates by first reducing a falling meteor to rubble with a single strike before going on to cut his way through outer space. His Bankai possesses even more cutting power despite being tiny, especially when compared to his massive Shikai. Achey Scars: When Zaraki was young, he fought Unohana, who at the time was the original Kenpachi. He received a scar from her during that fight. Ever since, it aches whenever Unohana speaks. Achievements in Ignorance: All of them, from his ability to become a captain to his sudden mastery of Bankai. Kenpachi has managed to keep up with Soul Society's best and brightest without going through a single day of formal training. Anime Hair: His hair looks spiky beyond all belief, but that is only because he goes through a lot of trouble to style it like that. When left to its own devices it hangs down.

characters.name: Ikkaku Madarame
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isHōzukimaru, a three section staff with a blade on the end. His Bankai isRyūmon Hōzukimaru, a set of three enormous blades which grow in offensive strength the longer he fights. Almighty Janitor: Third Seat Ikkaku Madarame is known for being vice-captain-class or even higher despite his lower rank. What's less well-known is the fact he'shiding Bankai, only someone who possesses the talent to one day achieve captain-class can achieve (to the point Renji begs him to take Aizen's position as Captain after the latter's betrayal). Ikkaku, however, has no interest in leaving Kenpachi's side, so he sticks to his division. Awesome, but Impractical: His Bankai drastically increases his power and the longer he uses it the stronger he gets. However, not only is it so brittle that it starts breaking when he actually scores a direct hit, but it actually takes him a fairly significant amount of time before his weapon even finishes waking up. Finally, it doesn't increase his speed. Badass Boast: After he fights Shishigawara with his bare fists and defeats him with a massive headbutt, he grins with his face covered in blood and gives a pretty awesome and boastful speech."You had a bad opponent. You were a lucky man, but I'm the luckiest bastard in the entire Thirteen Court Guard Squads!" Bald Head of Toughness: One of two characters in Soul Society that's bald and is a member of the squad whereMight Makes Right,Rank Scales with Asskicking, and everyone is aBlood Knight. Though originally the 3rd seat, he was alsowidely known as having vice-captain level abilities. Making fun of his baldness however does get under his skin.In a bit of a subversion, when he finally develops his Bankai it's aGlass Cannon, trading in defensive durability for offensive power.

characters.name: Yumichika Ayasegawa
characters.description: His Zanpakuto is "nicknamed"Fuji Kujaku(just to annoy him), and it takes the form of a multi-bladed falx resembling a fan. It lets him sap his opponents of their energy and stamina. When called upon by itsrealname,Ruri'iro Kujaku, its powers drastically increase. Adaptation Dye-Job: His feathers are multi-hued in the manga. The anime changes this to one pair of solid red feathers and one pair of solid yellow feathers. Agent Peacock: Aside from hisAnimal Motifbeing an actual peacock, Yumichika fits this trope to a T. True to this, he's a preening pretty boy among a squad of brutish, boorish fighters(and Yachiru)and isThe Fashionistaamongst the Eleventh Squad.
