However, he's also an incredibly dangerous fighter who's much more powerful than his relatively middling rank would suggest: if he's really pushed into using it, his true power is able toOne-Hit KOopponents with no trouble. Almighty Janitor: He's officially the fifth seat (later promoted to third seat) of the strongest combat division. No one has the fourth seat because hewon't take itand no one can defeat him to take it, which makes him the fourth strongest member of the division. He's officially expected to take on enemies and responsibilities that only captains and vice-captains are supposed to be assigned to. All this is based on his publicly acknowledged abilities. Now factor in theabilitieshe'skeeping secretthat allow him to win fights in asingle strikewhen he uses them. Animal Motif: The peacock—every aspect of the Asian symbology, which includes not just the beauty, vanity and pride, but also the loyalty, rejuvenation, resurrection, and watchfulness themes, too.

characters.name: Makizō Aramaki
characters.description: Affectionate Nickname: Yachiru nicknamed him "Maki-maki", which he finds cringeworthy. Because You Were Nice to Me: Aramaki figures out that Orihime and Uryu are the intruders he was warned about, but before he can do anything about it Mayuri Kurotsuchi ambushes them. When he see Orihime protecting him, Aramaki realises they're not bad people and pays them back by calling on the higher ups of his division into helping save Rukia. Know When to Fold 'Em: When Uryu prepares to fight Mayuri and threatens to shoot Aramaki unless he takes Orihime and runs away, Aramaki wisely decides not to question the situation and immediately does as told."I have no intention of getting caught up in that freak Kurotsuchi's fight or getting shot by that four-eyes freak..." Made of Iron: Episode 397 proves he must be when we find him standing to the right of Mashiro Kuna during a speech by Shunsui, since we last saw him just before Bambietta's group started decimating Squad 11. Not bad for somebody who had only served for 13 years at that point. No-Respect Guy: Appears to be this compared to the rest of his squad. Being the only one with the sense to not fight someone who might actually kill him probably gets him no respect in a squad comprised ofBlood Knights.

characters.name: Mayuri Kurotsuchi
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isAshisogi Jizo, an oddly shaped weapon that is capable of paralyzing and poisoning his opponents. His Bankai isKonjiki Ashisogi Jizō, a huge monster that appears to be amonstrous hybridof caterpillar and baby; it can instantly kill his opponents with its deadly toxins or simply crush them under its immense size. After extensive modification of his own Zanpakuto, Mayuri is able to used a modified version of his Bankai calledKonjiki Ashisogi Jizō Matai Fukuin Shōtai; it transforms into an obese, dark-skinned baby that Mayuri can program with data to give birth to other modified Bankais. Abusive Parents: Mayuri is not a pleasant father to his creation Nemu. Mayuri uses Nemu as a human shield and their tag-team strategy is that hecuts through herto get at opponents with his poisoned sword. When she asked for the antidote, hestarted kicking herand states that he made her too well to die from such petty wounds, so by his logic, she was insulting his intelligence. Adaptational Villainy: The Bount arc of the anime makes Mayuri a more treacherous character, having him withheld crucial information to his own allies regarding the Bounts and indirectly aiding them in their goal to enter Soul Society so he can catch a Bount alive and study a member of such an scarce race, actions that make the Bounts cause havoc in the Soul Society in the final stages of the arc. In canon, for all his cruelty and wrongdoings, Mayuri's biggest redeeming quality is that he's genuinely loyal to the Thirteen Squads and in a crisis he fights to save Soul Society even if he crosses several lines to achieve victory. Noticeably, when a similar invasion to the Bount one happens in canon with the Wandenreich, Mayuri reveals that ever since his defeat at the hands of Uryu he became paranoid of a possible Quincy attack and worked on defending against it rather than allow invaders access Soul Society to satisfy his curiosity. As his Bount arc characterization is based on his more villainous de

characters.name: Nemu Kurotsuchi
characters.description: Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: She fits this trope very well. She has long, braided black hair, and wears a passive and quiet expression24/7. Nearly nothing can get her to change her face, aside from being complimented by Yachiru. Artificial Human: Mayuri set up the Nemuri Project to experiment with the creation of an artificial lifeform. His seventh attempt produced Nemuri Nanagou (Sleeping Number Seven) which Mayuri regards as his greatest achievement. She becomes his right hand in all matters, successfully functioning as his lieutenant under the name Nemu Kurotsuchi. Badass Creed: Mayuri created Nemu with the mission to learn and develop, and to never act outside his orders. When Mayuri struggles in battle against Pernida, she enters the fight without waiting for his orders and saves his life. She dismisses his anger at disobeying his orders and putting his research (her creation and existence) at risk, by stating she's realized what her mission really is: the only way she can truly prove to Mayuri how much she's learned and developed is by using all of her abilities to protect his life. After this declaration, Mayuri reluctantly accepts he has to let her fight Pernida on his behalf. Blunt Metaphors Trauma: She says "Butter" when she takes a picture of Byakuya in an omake, even after Isane corrects that. Boob-Based Gag: Her boobs are big enough that she weaponizes them to pin people down for Mayuri's experiments, usually bysmothering them.

characters.name: Akon
characters.description: He often functions as mission control. A Day in the Limelight: He spends most of the series as a minor character only occassionaly shown to provide small exposition, but the Thosand Year Blood War arc gives him more moments to shine, such as being the one contacting Ichigo in Hueco Mundo during the first invasion and guiding him through the Garganta to Soul Society or explaining Nemu's origins to his colleages in Squad 12 and the audience Acid Attack: In theEchoing Jaws of Hell arc, Akon is shown for the first time on the battlefield, melting some Hollows with acid from a vial spilled on the enemy. Audience Surrogate: When Mayuri shows up a glowing sun-themed outfit in chapter 547, Akon ends up lampshading the ridiculousness. Badass Bookworm: Much like Mayuri, while he mostly works at the lab, in the cases where he's forced to fight he's shown to be a competent warrior using his inventions to battle, as he shows in the Hell arc one-shot where he melts some of the Hell Hollows with a device he presumably made.

characters.name: Rin Tsubokura
characters.description: Adaptational Early Appearance: He first appears in Episode 68 of the anime, at the start of the Bount arc. In the manga, he doesn't show up until the Arrancar arc. Butt-Monkey: The story doesn't take Rin seriously at all. The Klutz: Rin is incredibly clumsy. Mission Control: Like Akon, he's responsible for relaying orders and communications. Nervous Wreck: Tends to be very ill at ease in his duties. Consideringwhichsquad he works in, though, can you blame him?

characters.name: Hiyosu
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: His skin is inconsistently coloured green in the anime's original run. Bald of Evil: He's a cyborgMad Scientistwith an unusually-shaped bald head, who performed horrendous experiments on Quincies — including Uryū's grandfather — under Mayuri's orders, and gleefully ogles Rukia's nude gigai alongside several of his colleagues. His subsequent appearances are significantly less creepy. Cyborg: He has a crank on the left side of his head, and can use it to extend his left eye out of its socket, which he does while ogling what's strongly implied to be Rukia's gigai's butt. Gonk: He hasTombstone Teeth, bulging eyes, no neck, slits for nostrils, and a scar on his head. Perverted Drooling: He — along with several of his colleagues — literally drools over Rukia's naked gigai after Squad 12 finally gets their hands on it.

characters.name: Jushiro Ukitake
characters.description: His zanpakuto is namedSōgyo no Kotowari, one of the very few dual zanpakuto. One sword lets him absorb any energy-based attack, and fire it back with the other sword. Achilles' Heel: He is one of the oldest and most powerful captains, but he was afflicted with an incurable lung disease as a young child. He is unable to function for prolonged periods because of his frequent sickness. He's living on borrowed time as his parents made a deal to prevent his death at the age of three. Even with that pact, he is still frequently unable to attend to administrative duties, let alone reliably fight. Adaptational Superpower Change: As his abilities weren't truly revealed until his fight with Starrk in the Arrancar arc, some videogames including Ukitake as a playable character such as theBleach: Heat The Soulseries give Sogyo no Kotowari completely different abilities than the ones in canon (likely based in its activation command), in particularthe one to manipulate waterandgenerate electricity. Adaptation Dye-Job: His eyes are brown in both the manga and anime. However, for a colour cover special in chapter 335 that possessed the theme "green on white", Kubo changed his eyes to green to match the theme. Animal Motifs: The Carp. This includes the concept of the carp representing boys who can overcome adversity to become stronger. He gained an incurable lung disease as a child. Despite that, he's stillmanagedto not just reach the captain rank but is one of the longest-serving captains of all.

characters.name: Kaien Shiba
characters.description: His zanpakuto wasNejibana, a trident which let him launch water-based attacks. Adaptation Personality Change: A minor case. Kaien fights Metastacia for the sake of honor- that of his men, his wife and himself- but in the manga, Ukitake says that Kaien's own honor is most important, while in the anime, Ukitake says Kaien's wife's honor is most important. Big Brother Mentor: Was an admirable and caring older brother figure to both to his siblings and his subordinates, especially Rukia. Dance Battler: His fighting style is said to resemble traditional Japanese dances. Death by Origin Story: His death is the reason for why Rukia values her life so little and submits so easily to execution.

characters.name: Miyako Shiba
characters.description: Death by Origin Story: Her death started a chain that ended up taking out both her and the lieutenant Kaien and saddling Rukia with immense guilt. Onee-sama: Rukia idolized Miyako (or "Miyako-dono") as the perfect woman, as she was a beautiful and talented seated officer in their division. Miyako was also one of the few who treated Rukia kindly and without discrimination. Posthumous Character: She died years ago in a hollow attack prior to the series. Yamato Nadeshiko: The reason Rukia adored Miyako was because Miyako was ladylike, elegant and gentle.

characters.name: Kiyone Kotetsu and Sentaro Kotsubaki
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: In the anime, Kiyone's hair is much more red than the manga, where she is definitely a blonde. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Sentaro is loud, temperamental and prone to arguing with Kiyone, but he's a good person at heart. He even goes so far as to claim that Hanataro was forced to assist the Ryoka when reporting to Unohana in the hopes of getting leniency for Hanataro. NO INDOOR VOICE: Sentaro is nearly always yelling or speaking a lot louder than necessary, even when indoors. Kiyone can sometimes be seen covering her ears in annoyance behind him. Rank Up: After the timeskip, Kiyone becomes vice captain of the 4th Division, with her big sister Isane as captain. Two years later (in the "No Breathes From Hell" chapter), Sentaro is shown as having become the 13th Division's new vice captain. Sibling Yin-Yang: Kiyone is very boisterous and prone to arguing with the likes of Sentaro; in contrast, her older sister is meek, more level-headed and tries hard to get along with everyone.

characters.name: Hidetomo Kajomaru
characters.description: Half the Man He Used to Be: Haschwald casually slices him in halfvertically. Mr. Exposition: Explains to Yuki and Shino the major differences between Quincies and Soul Society, the bad blood between them and the "balance of souls" that led to the war. Oh, Crap!: When he identifies the location of the Quincies. The moment he realises the Emperor is inside the Seireitei, the Emperor proceeds toannihilateabout half of the 13th Division. Pretty Boy: Pretty looks, but not to the level of being effeminate. Sacrificial Lamb: Poor guy pretty much existed just to show how ruthless the Stern Ritter are and to remind the readers that the Quincies and the Soul Reapers both believe strongly in their world views which is why they're at war with each other.

characters.name: Zennosuke Kurumadani
characters.description: His zanpakuto isTsuchinamazu, a wind and fire wheel that when slammed down, can cause the earth to crack and shoot up fragments. Afro Ass Kicker: Played with. He was only a comic relief character when introduced around the same time as Shinji Hirako, but he stood up to Aizen, even if only for a couple seconds, when he was pursuing Ichigo's friends. Dishing Out Dirt: His zanpakuto's power is to cause fragments of the earth to shoot up and impale or trap enemies. Embarrassing Nickname: Is usually called "Afro-San" instead of his actual name.

characters.name: Ryunosuke Yuki
characters.description: Adaptational Expansion: The anime give him and Shino more screentime than in the manga, where they participate in forming the gate to the Soul King Palace, as well as slaying hollows in the Human World due to instability of the Three Worlds caused by Yhwach. In the manga, they disappeared after the first invasion of Wandenreich. Butt-Monkey: Tends to get abused by Shino for laughs. Naïve Newcomer: Especially when it concerns war. Oh, Crap!: When he identifies the location of the Quincies. He's the one who spots that Yhwach is in factinsidethe soul barrier around the Seireitei. Shrinking Violet: In contrast to his partner, he's a lot more timid.

characters.name: Shino Madarame
characters.description: A-Cup Angst: Doesn't like it when someone remarks on her flat chest. Adaptational Expansion: The anime give her and Ryunosuke more screentime than in the manga, where they participate in forming the gate to the Soul King Palace, as well as slaying hollows in the Human World due to instability of the Three Worlds caused by Yhwach. In the manga, they disappeared after the first invasion of Wandenreich. All There in the Manual: Her surname Madarame and relation to Ikkaku was revealed in the light novelBleach: Can't Fear Your Own Worldbefore it was canonized in the anime adaptation of theThousand-Year Blood Wararc. Big "NO!": Let's out a loud "no" when Kajomaru is killed in front of her and the rest of the Division. Hot-Blooded: She's very aggressive and reckless.

characters.name: Sōsuke Aizen
characters.description: After revealing himself and retreating from Soul Society, he takes up residence in the world of Hollows, Hueco Mundo, and uses the aforementionedMacGuffinto create the Arrancar army in hopes of eventually finding the King's Key and becoming 'the one to stand atop heavens'. He is noted for his extraordinarily powerful abilities,Kick the Dogtendencies, elaborate schemes, and mysterious aura. His Zanpakuto,Kyoka Suigetsu, lets him manipulate his opponents with near-perfect illusions. As he fuses with the Hogyoku, he progressively transforms into monster-like forms, which grant him absurd levels of power. Above Good and Evil: Aizen reveals that people define their boundaries, morality and what's right or wrong based on their own limited understanding of the world. He claims that he is above all of this and therefore, can make his own rules as he goes. As a result, he even rejects the concept of truth and lies because that's just perspective, too. Despite this, he later gets very angry with Urahara for never having agreed with his point-of-view, because he can't understand why someone of Urahara's intellect would disagree with the way he sees the world. Achilles' Heel: Kyoka Suigetsu is shown to have three weaknesses. His power cannot be used on the blind, meaning Tosen is immune to it, making him decide to recruit him as his subordinate as a result. It's also possible to sense his Reiatsu through the illusions he creates if you let Aizen stab you directly by his Zanpakuto, but onlyYamamotowas shown doing that, so it's unclear how practical that method is. Also, anyone that touches the blade before the Shikai is released gains immunity for that instance as well. Actually a Doombot: Aizen's Shikai gives him illusory powers, which he can use to convince people they're seeing someone they're not. He faked his death this way, distracted Komamura on Sougyoku Hill by making it seem he was somewhere he wasn't and made Hitsugaya stab Hinamori, thinking he was stabbing Aizen.

characters.name: Kaname Tōsen
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isSuzumushi, capable of making his opponents black out with a supersonic frequency or creating echoes of his blade to launch as projectiles. His Bankai,Suzumushi Tsuishiki: Enma Kōrogi, negates the senses as the environment is enveloped in a black sphere. He is also capable of using an Arrancar's Resurrección, namedSuzumushi Hyakushiki: Grillar Grillo, which transforms him into a horrendous cricket-like monster capable of firing Ceros and using sound-based attacks. Ability Mixing: Tōsen's Zanpakutō, Suzumushi, was taken from the grave of his close friend Kakyō, after she was murdered by her husband, noble scion Tokinada Tsunayashiro. According to Kubo's Klub Outside Q&A, as a result of Tōsen imprinting his own Zanpakutō Spirit onto Suzumushi after it had already been imprinted upon, he is capable of using both his own and Kakyō's Zanpakutō powers. Achilles' Heel: His Bankai allows him to remove all of the senses of his enemy except for touch. Kenpachi has a hard time against him when Tōsen uses it. After thinking for a while, Kenpachi is able to deduce the one crippling weakness of the Bankai: simply by touching his sword, Kenpachi is able to regain his senses and attack Tosen. Adaptation Dye-Job: The anime usesHair Color Dissonanceto make his hair predominantly purple-looking as a sheen for his black hair whereas in the manga, his hair is simply black. Afro Asskicker: In the "Turn Back the Pendulum" mini-arc Tosen styled his hair into a star-shaped afro and he was skilled enough to murder three Soul Reapers while infecting his captain and lieutenant with a Hollowfying virus.

characters.name: Menos Grande
characters.description: Bedsheet Ghost: All Gillians wear long black robes. Bishōnen Line: When a Hollow becomes a Gillian, it becomes a black-cloaked colossus with a white mask. If any of the countless souls comprising a Gillian proves lucky enough to assert their individuality over the others, they gain unique masks and can become Adjuchas- which are much smaller but far more powerful, and are usually shaped like animals. Adjuchas must continue to devour other Hollows or risk devolving into a mindless Gillian, and a rare few have the potential to become particularly powerful, humanoid entities called the Vasto Lorde. Additionally, most Hollows that have their masks broken transform intoHumanoid Abominationscalled Arrancars. Fake Ultimate Mook: Gillians are aretroactiveexample. When the first one was introduced it was referred to as a serious threat that only Captain-class Soul Reapers could hope to vanquish. Once the Arrancars came about they are revealed to be the weakest class of Menos despite their massive size and only a threat to low-level Soul Reapers, with Lieutenants and Captains capable of easily slaughtering them. Many Spirits Inside of One: Gillians are generally mindless brutes due to the consciousnesses of the Hollows that form them lacking cohesion. If one soul is able to dominate the others, it becomes an Adjuchas. Metamorphosis Monster: When Hollows begin cannibalising each other, a Gillian-class Menos eventually rises from the resulting feeding frenzy, with all the component Hollows meshed together into a hungry mass. Occasionally, one of the souls within a Gillian will be able to overpower the others, becoming the dominant personality of what is now an Adjuchas-class Menos. A rare few Adjuchas have the potential to become the humanoid Vasto Lorde if they devour enough souls.

characters.name: Fishbone D
characters.description: Establishing Character Moment: Eating the ghost girl that Ichigo helped at the beginning of the first chapter, just because she smelled like Ichigo. Fish People: His mask was shaped like a fish's head and he had a dorsal fin, but was otherwise humanoid. Healing Factor: While he didn't possess Instantaneous Regeneration, he was able to heal a cut Rukia dealt to him by retreating to Hueco Mundo for a few seconds. Man Bites Man: He tries to swallow Ichigo whole only for Rukia to intervene and get chomped on instead. Small Role, Big Impact: His attack on Ichigo's home kickstarts the whole plot.

characters.name: Hexapodus
characters.description: Curb-Stomp Battle: Hexapodus was on the receiving end of one, being easily slain by Ichigo. Giant Spider: He resembles a spider-like creature, but was relatively massive. Would Hurt a Child: He was hunting the ghost of a young boy. Because of this, Rukia was able to convince Ichigo to become a Substitute Shinigami.

characters.name: Acidwire
characters.description: Black Eyes of Crazy: When Ichigo enrages and injures him, the sclera of his exposed eye turns black. Breath Weapon: He has acidic saliva that he can shoot from a gap in his mask's incisors. Chekhov's Gun: When Acidwire's mask is broken, his human side asserts control. Later in the manga it's established that a Hollow becomes an Arrancar if their mask is broken, allowing them to regain their humanity. The Corruptible: In the anime, he was shown as a Plus being attacked by a group of Hollows led by Grand Fisher, who dragged him to Hueco Mundo and forced him to Hollowfy. Dying as Yourself: After Orihime tells him that she hadn't forgotten him but that she didn't want him to be sad, Sora suppresses his Hollow instincts long enough to remove the rest of his mask, and impales himself with Ichigo's Zanpakuto.

characters.name: Shrieker
characters.description: Achievements in Ignorance: He managed to retain hisPast-Life Memoriesdespite Hollows having a poor track record of doing so. Arm Cannon: Can fire explosive leeches from his arm wrappings as a Sinner. Beyond Redemption: For the crime of committing murder in life, Shrieker is denied passage to the Soul Society upon being slain and instead gets dragged into Hell. Whether or not he can move onto the Soul Society after serving out a sentence isn't made clear. Black Cloak: When Shrieker returns as a Togabito, he wears a black cloak that enables him to move freely outside of Hell. Came Back Strong: As a Sinner he retained the form and abilities he possessed as a Hollow but was significantly more powerful.

characters.name: Grand Fisher
characters.description: Adapted Out: The scene when he's first turned into an Arrancar is completely removed from the anime, so his first Arrancar form doesn't gets to appear there. He appears being Arrancarized with his second form at the start of the Arrancar arc in the anime. Adaptation Expansion: The anime builds him up through the first episodes of the Substitute Soul Reaper arc before his actual appearance, making him the leader of a Hollow community and appearing talking as a sinister figure from time to time, even being the one corrupting Sora Inoue into a Hollow. Adaptation Relationship Overhaul: Downplayed. In the manga it's implied he's a Hollow working for Aizen by the comments Aisslinger and D-Roy make about him when they turn him into an Arrancar following his defeat at the hands of Ichigo. The anime for some reason removes most of these elements except for a brief scene in the beginning of the 8th episode where Aisslinger and D-Roy appear in a blink-and-you-miss cameo looking at Grand Fisher going to the human world, so most viewers could be forgiven for thinking he's working independently like the Hollows preceeding him. By the time the Arrancar arc begins in the anime, he's properly shown as an Arrancar working with Aizen, however. Animal Motifs: Angler fish. He has a lure as part of his body that can take the form of a human child to lure preys. Hence the name "Grand Fisher". Back for the Dead: After his defeat in the Substitute Soul Reaper arc, he returns at the beginning of the Arrancar arc seeking out revenge against Ichigo and attacking Kon after mistaking him for his sworn enemy. He doesn't lasts much, however, as Isshin makes quick work of him after revealing himself as a Soul Reaper.

characters.name: Demi-Hollow
characters.description: Animal Motifs: He looks like a frog when he's fully Hollowfied. Chained by Fashion: He was wrapped up by his Chain of Fate, which bound him to the long-abandoned hospital he'd coveted in life. Greed: He'd planned to become filthy rich by inheriting the hospital from his dying father, who kiboshed those plans by choosing his younger son as his heir. It's All About Me: He was the eldest son of the owner of a hospital, but was passed over in favor of his younger brother. He didn't take that well, which is why he remained bound to the hospital after death. One-Winged Angel: Don Kanonji breaking his Chain of Fate caused him to Hollowfy, transforming from a corrupted Plus into a frog-like Hollow.

characters.name: Numb Chandelier
characters.description: All There in the Manual: Her name and gender are never mentioned in the anime and manga and are only revealed in the databooks. Body Horror: Her spores imbed themselves in her victims' bodies, growing grotesque roots that are visible through their skin and enable Numb Chandelier to control them. Dirty Coward: She doesn't fight on her own as she dislike engaging in direct combat, but instead has pawns fight for her. Disproportionate Retribution: She attacks Orihime when she notices Orihime's spiritual power, but does so indirectly by controlling the bodies of Orihime's classmates. Tatsuki rushes in to save Orihime and does such a good job that Numb Chandelier decides to have the male classmates attack Tatsuki with the intention of gang-raping her and then having her kill herself afterwards. Expressive Mask: Unlike all other Hollows, her mask has flexible tentacles.

characters.name: Bulbous G
characters.description: The Brute: He has no special powers outside of being incredibly strong. Determinator: Sado blasts one of his arms off, but Bulbous G isn't the least bit discouraged. His determination gets him killed.

characters.name: Metastacia
characters.description: Artificial Human: He was an artificial Hollow created by Aizen as part of his Hollowfication experiments. Metastacia was given two abilities: the destruction of a Zanpakuto upon touch, and fusing with Soul Reapers by entering their bodies. Additionally, his corpse also had the function to return back to Hueco Mundo after Metastacia's death. Body Horror: Metastacia's tentacles can be seen worming their way out of Kaien's flesh and eye sockets while possessing him. Clipped-Wing Angel: He can only shatter Zanpakuto once per night and his possession ability permanently fuses him with Soul Reapers until he assimilates them back into his original form. By destroying Kaien's Zanpakuto and taking over his body, he was unprepared to face down Kaien's comrades Ukitake and Rukia. Combat Tentacles: He has numerous dark red tentacles growing out of his back that he can use to destroy a Soul Reaper's Zanpakuto and take over prey. Eye Scream: His eyes are too deepset for most panels to show the glowing eyes inside, but once he takes over Kaien, Kaien's eyes become empty sockets that only occasionally display the deepset glow. However, there's liquid all around the edges of Kaien's eyes, suggesting his own eyeballs exploded as the Hollow took him over. They regenerate once Rukia slays him.

characters.name: Runuganga
characters.description: Dishing Out Dirt: His body is formed out of the sand in Hueco Mundo, and is able to manipulate the sand to create sandstorms and antlion pits. The Dreaded: A massive Hollow that hides in the sands of Hueco Mundo and kills anyone who he deems as trying to break into Las Noches. Unsurprisingly, Nel and company are terrified of him. Healing Factor: Because he's made of sand, he is able to heal any damage received from physical attacks immediately. He can also create secondary bodies in the chance his active body is unable to heal. Kill It with Water: Being hit by water prevents his existing body from regenerating. When he is frozen by Rukia,his body completely shatters. Normally, he would be invincible, since Hueco Mundo doesn't have water anywhere except in Aizen's Las Noches, although few Arrancars like Harribel and Findorr do have water powers. Red Baron: The Guardian of the White Sands.

characters.name: Fûrâ
characters.description: Blob Monster: It's a colossal mass of flesh with barely any shape beyond its stubby arms. By the Lights of Their Eyes: It first appears to rescue Aizen, Gin and Tosen from Soul Society, but all that can be seen of it is an eye. Cyclops: It is a towering giant with a single massive eye. Dub Name Change: The English manga changes his name to "Hooleer". Enemy Summoner: It can vomit hordes of Gillian Menos.

characters.name: Espada
characters.description: See pages forEspadas 1-5andEspadas 6 - 10for more info. Allegorical Character: Each of them represents a different form of death, be it from their powers or personalities.Starrk isWillfully Weak, having split his own power just to have a companion that wouldn'tdiefrom his mere presence, and represents loneliness.Baraggan represents aging, appearing as an old man and his powersrapidly agingfoes andrapidly decayingany objects.Harribel represents sacrifice, being aNoble Demonwho protects her underlings.Ulquiorra represents emptiness, being an emotionlessStraw Nihilistthat sees no reason to any of the heroes actions.Nnoitra represents despair, being aJerkassCombat Pragmatistwho revels in striking at weakened opponentsjust as they think they've won.Grimmjow represents destruction, being a proudBlood KnightandPerson of Mass Destruction.Zommari is intoxication, having the power to control any object he sees and spending much of his fight with Byakuya indulging in his power.Szayelaporro represents madness, being anAx-CrazyMad Scientistwho takes every opportunity he can to play with his enemies.Aaroniero is greed, having the combined powers of several Hollows, including one who absorbed the powers of Kaien Shiba.Yammy represents rage, being a textbook case ofThe Brutewho never displays any powers other than enhanced strength and durability. Starrk isWillfully Weak, having split his own power just to have a companion that wouldn'tdiefrom his mere presence, and represents loneliness. Baraggan represents aging, appearing as an old man and his powersrapidly agingfoes andrapidly decayingany objects. Harribel represents sacrifice, being aNoble Demonwho protects her underlings.

characters.name: Dordoni Alessandro Del Socaccio
characters.description: His Zanpakutō isGiralda, and it allows him to summon cyclones from his legs. Accent Adaptation: In the anime, Dordoni was given a Spanish accent to go with theGratuitous Spanishhe threw around in the original. Accidental Misnaming: On the receiving end of one, courtesy of Ichigo, who calls him Don Panini. Beard of Evil: He sports a long goatee along with a thin, stylized mustache, giving him a devilish image. Blow You Away: When released he gets wind-based powers.

characters.name: Cirucci Sanderwicci
characters.description: Her Zanpakutō,Golondrina, is a disk-like weapon attached to a handle by a thin cord. When she releases it, she gains two large wings that are covered with several huge metal blades. She can launch and remotely control the detached blades. She can also drop the wings and channel reiatsu through her tail to form weapons. Animal Motifs: Swallows, as in the bird. 'Golondrina' means swallow, and her Resurreccíon gives her wings. Arch-Enemy: After she was resurrected by Mayuri Kurotsuchi, Cirucci quickly made it clear she wanted to settle the score with Ishida, due to him previously defeating her, and only works for Mayuri in the hopes of getting that fight. Batman Gambit: During her fight with Ishida, she made it seem as though Golondrina was limited to always attacking in a straight line when thrown, and when pulled back, prompting Uryu to fire his arrows in other directions as opposed to simply in front of her. It destroyed most of the pillars as a result... which was exactly what she wanted, because he created more openings for her whippings. She could weave it around more erratically, since he wouldn't have much else left to hide. Beauty Is Never Tarnished: Zigzagged upon her revival as Mayuri's zombie soldier. As a zombie, she sports a long, noticeable stitch going from her forehead to her right cheek, but despite that she's no less attractive than as when she was alive.

characters.name: Gantenbainne Mosqueda
characters.description: His Zanpakutō,Dragra, armors him up and gives him the ability to fire concentrated energy blasts. Affably Evil: Compared to two other Privarons, he has a more honorable side. Afro Asskicker: His main physical trait is a big orange afro hairdo, and in spite of this it doesn't hinders him at all while fighting, being able to move swiftly and throw powerful blows towards his opponents. Anti-Villain: Has no qualms about fighting Sado, but he's honorable enough to warn Chad of an attack by Nnoitra. Mythical Motifs: His Zanpakutō means "Dragon Fang" and its shape resembles a giant chinese dragon.

characters.name: Nelliel Tu Odelschwanck
characters.description: Her Zanpakutō is known asGamuza. It transforms her into a centaur wielding a lance. Adaptational Curves: Zigzagged. Neliel is consistently shown to have bigger boobs than anyone in the series except Kirio Hikifune of the Zero Squad, and her butt is also consistently big. However, depending on the art, her stomach has been shown to be either very toned or a bit bigger and softer. Her Brave Souls Hogyoku art and her double-spread swimsuit by Tite Kubo are the former, with her bikini in Chapter 353 and her post-series calendar art being the latter. This is made more complicated by the fact that these appearances are all from different time periods, so meaning weight gain or loss also can't explain it. Adaptational Modesty: When her child form’s clothing is torn up from regaining her adult body, the anime has it cover up more skin, most notably herUnderboobsthat were exposed in the manga. Adaptation Dye-Job: The manga showed her with green hair, while the anime has her with bluish-green hair.Subvertedwith the release of theThousand-Year Blood Waranime, where her hair is green, just like in the manga. Animal Motifs: She is goat-antelope (and true antelope) themed. Her mask has ram horns, and per goat stereotypes, sheeats a lot. Her Resurrección is called Gamuza (Spanish for "chamois", another goat-antelope, but the kanji mean "antelope knight"). Her Resurrección form is a centaur-like gemsbok. Though the fur on her forepaws make them look like those of theBarbary sheep(Ammotragus lervia).

characters.name: Luppi Antenor
characters.description: Asshole Victim: His smug attitude and overly-flamboyant demeanor, coupled with his needless attempt at skewering Rangiku's boobs, makes his death at Grimmjow's hands pretty sweet, and nobody misses him nor sheds a tear for him, not even Orihime herself. Back from the Dead: Thanks to Mayuri, he returns as a zombified Arrancar. Blood from the Mouth: Logically, after Grimmjow impales him with his restored right arm. Camp Straight: Despite his flamboyance, he flirts with Rangiku at one point. Combat Tentacles: Eight of them, and they're capable of protruding spikes, too.

characters.name: Shawlong Koufang
characters.description: His Zanpakutō,Tijereta, gives him an earwig motif with razor-sharp claws. Affably Evil: He is by far the most courteous person in Grimmjow's group who looks after his comrades, makes choices in their best interests and is unfailingly polite even to his enemies. He even greets Hitsugaya shortly before attacking him. Big Creepy-Crawlies: 'Tijereta' means earwig. His Resurrección is earwig-themed, and his form when he was still Adjuchas-class Hollow is a humanoid earwig. It comes withCreepy Long Fingerscapable of nearly cutting (arestrained) Hitsugaya to death. Blood Knight: He admits he enjoys the prospect of having to fight a captain, leading to aPsychotic Smirk. Combat Pragmatist: He fully believes that Ichigo should be killed before he becomes a problem, a sentiment he shared with Grimmjow.

characters.name: Edrad Liones
characters.description: He wieldsVolcanicá, which lets him upgrade his physical abilities with fire. Affably Evil: While very much dismissive and vicious like any other Arrancar, Edrad actually adopts Ikkaku's views of honor and respect, and dies smiling, content with what he learned from his enemy. He also finds theBlood Knightphilosophy, to fight for sport,to be disturbing. Anime Hair: Even in this series, he has an incredibly bizarre hair style, which includes a spikey and long black half on his left with a butch-styled right half on his right. For whatever reason, the anime itself switches these colors. The Brute: Among Grimmjow's Fracción he's the second tallest, most muscular member and also the one holding the most destructive power out of the five. Character Development: Hard to imagine, sure, but when the first started, he doesn't think of Ikkaku (a 3rd Seat) as a threat, and refuses to introduce himself because of that. Ikkaku claims that introductions are a last courtesy for the person that you're about to kill. Later into the fight, Edrad revealed his full name to Ikkaku, and just before he dies, he admits that he's glad Ikkaku revealed his name to him.

characters.name: Nakeem Grindina
characters.description: Dies Wide Open: The last shot that we see of him in the anime is his eyes being wide open as the blood pours out of his chest, courtesy of Rangiku Matsumoto. Dumb Muscle: No, Nakeem.One kickisn't enough to defeat a lieutenant. He also neglected to finish her off after that off-screenCurb-Stomp Battle, even though she was completely unharmed. Explaining Your Power to the Enemy: He explains the Arrancar speed movement is called Sonído which is enough for Rangiku to work out it's barely any different to Shunpo, except for the sound it makes. Her skill at Shunpo is far superior to his skill at Sonído so she defeats him easily. Flat Character: Among all the Arrancar on Aizen's army he displays the least amount of personality, simply standing there while Grimmjow and his partners do the talking and simply following Shawlong around. Like with Di Roy, his Resurrección is also never shown. Giant Mook: Big and somewhat tough looking, but just a mook when you get down to it. Once the limiter was gone, he quickly dies from a single slash to his shoulder.

characters.name: Yylfordt Granz
characters.description: His Zanpakutō,Del Toro, transforms him into a bull with enhanced physical strength. Ax-Crazy: Appears to be the most unhinged and openly cruel in Grimmjow's group (besides Grimmjow himself),laughing maniacallyas he wounds Renji in their fight.This serves as a subtler hint to his familial connection to Szayelaporro. Bare-Handed Blade Block: When he looked over to Di Roy's location after the latter was killed, Yylfordt effortlessly blocks Renji's Bankai without suffering a scratch. Blood Knight: Like most of his friends, Yylfordt enjoys fighting, but is particularly more violent about it in comparison. InSpirits are Forever With You, before meeting Grimmjow and the others, his uncontrollable fighting impulses caused Szayelaporro to discard the brother that he ate in the past because they got in the way of his scientific goals. Catchphrase: He says "brother" more times thanHulk Hogan, though this is curiously only ever said to his opponents andis otherwise absent in his speech. This is intended to foreshadow his younger brother,Szayelaporro, being an antagonist.

characters.name: Di Roy Rinker
characters.description: Adaptational Late Appearance: His first appearance in the manga supervising Grand Fisher's conversion into an Arrancar is removed from the anime (only getting a small cameo as a shadowed figure before Grand Fisher goes to the human world at the start of the Memories in the Rain adaptation), so he first appears in the animated adaptation in the part where Grimmjow is introduced instead. Bare-Handed Blade Block: He blocks Rukia's sealed Zanpakutō with his bare hand. Boisterous Weakling: After almost killing Sado and blocking Rukia's unsealed sword, he appears to be very dangerous. However, he's defeated the moment Rukia releases her power. Upon realizing he's dead, his companions dismiss him as a weakling who, despite insisting on joining the invasion team, couldn't put his money where his mouth was. According to the databook, he's the Adjuchas closest to Gillian in Grimmjow's group, explaining his comparatively weaker abilities. It is later revealed via a flashback that this was because Grimmjow ate a part of him early in his Adjuchas stage,causing him to be unable to develop any further alongside his fellows. Can't Catch Up: As a Hollow, he was seemingly regarded as at least an equal to his companions at one point considering their surprise that Grimmjow was able to wound him so easily. Said wound then permanently halted his growth, preventing him from getting any stronger and leading him to eventually become the weakest and least respected of Grimmjow's Fraccions over time. Chekhov's Gunman: He first official appearance is in Chapter 199 when Grimmjow invades the living world. However, his first appearance is actually in Chapter 25. He was watching Grand Fisher getting transformed into an Arrancar and scolded him for losing to Ichigo.

characters.name: Charlotte Chuhlhourne
characters.description: He wieldsReina de Rosas, which upgrades his physical capabilities, and lets him use flashy - but impractical - attacks. Adaptation Expansion: His fight with Yumichika lasts longer in the anime. Affably Evil: He's odd as hell, but he has a better moral compass than his comrades. Agent Peacock: He's campy, scantily dressed, and a showman through and through whose powers are a parody of theMagical Girlgenre... and is lethal enough that Yumichika is forced to reveal his closely guarded secret (a magic-based Zanpakuto) to defeat him. Ambiguous Gender Identity: Using the name Charlotte, feminine mannerisms, dressing in what would probably be an attractive outfit on a more feminine figure, and expressing a feeling of kinship towards Giselle, could be seen as indications of being a trans woman, though it's more likely based on theokama stereotype.

characters.name: Abirama Redder
characters.description: He wieldsÁguila, which transforms him into a bird with steel wings capable of mowing enemies down. Achilles' Heel: His steel feathers also become his downfall when Kira finally releases his own power to ground him. Blood Knight: He really loves fighting, to the point where he spends his entire introduction screaming about what he'll do to Kira as a way to psyche himself. When he loses, Kiramakes sure to deride him for it. Blood Upgrade: Abirama gets stronger by cutting himself. He also grow an extra pair of wings. Boisterous Bruiser: Bombastic and battle-hungry to a fault,

characters.name: Findorr Calius
characters.description: His Zanpakutō is known asPinza Aguda, and it transforms his right arm into an enormous lobster claw capable of firing immensely pressurized blasts of water and steam. Adaptational Badass: In the anime, his attacks are more destructive than in the manga, he gives Hisagi a much harder time, and instead of fleeing at the end of his fight, he attempts to end it with an extremely powerful Cero. Adaptation Expansion: Like all the pillar battles, this one is extended in the anime. This one is notable for its rather impressively fluid animation and choreography. Blade Below the Shoulder: In his unreleased state, he has small wrist blades that go over the back of his hands. He doesn't use them much for stabbing, however, but to chip away at hisPower Limitermask. Blood Knight: Despite coming off rather gentlemanly, if arrogant, at first, he's quite eager to fight Hisagi and even laughs maniacally at several points.

characters.name: Choe Neng Poww
characters.description: He wieldsCalderón, a tiny Zanpakutō that transforms him intoan enormous whale-like beast towering over even sky scrapers. Adaptation Expansion: His fight with Komamura is extended in the anime, including how the battle ends. In the manga, Poww charges a Cero only to lose his nerve in the face of seeing Komamura's Bankai and tries to attack Komamura himself while demanding to know his name, only to be told "just an insect" before the Bankaicrushes him in one swing. In the anime, Powwactually puts up a fightagainst the Bankai: shooting it with a Cero only to have it deflected, punching it only to be blocked and countered, and finally grappling and trying to shoot it with another Cero before it forces the Cero back down his throat and the blast detonates inside him. The badly wounded Poww finally asks for Komamura's name in disbelief as Komamura gives the same answer and cuts him down. Animal Motifs: Poww is essentially a monstrous whale that masquerades as a humanoid. In Resurrección he becomes monstrously large (not that he wasn't already) and gains a throat like a baleen whale. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Attacking a captain wasn't a smart move, Poww. Yes, yes, we know you have a powerful punch, but we repeat -you do not attack a captain, ever! Clipped-Wing Angel: Poww's Calderon causes him quite a bit of discomfort, as his body apparently feels very heavy and hard to move in.

characters.name: Ggio Vega
characters.description: He wieldsTigre Estoque, a Zanpakutō that grants him a saber-tooth tiger motif with enhanced physical skills. Adaptation Expansion: There's an entire episode dedicated to Ggio out-maneuvering Soifon in their fight after he goesOne-Winged Angel. Animal Motifs: His powers are tiger-themed, he has tiger stripes and his mask includes the fangs of a sabre-tooth cat. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: You shouldn't have attacked a captain who has a two-hit-kill. Yeah, you had her on the ropes, but she was deliberately holding back so she could gauge your strength. Instead of dicking around, you should have finished her off sooner. Ballistic Bone: He shoots the sabre-teeth from his helmet as projectiles.

characters.name: Nirgge Parduoc
characters.description: His Zanpakutō is known asMamut. It transforms him into a mammoth-like beast with enhanced strength. Adaptation Expansion: His fight with Ōmaeda is expanded in the anime, to the point where Ōmaeda killed him instead of Ggio unintentionally doing so. Clipped-Wing Angel: Nirgge's Mamut slows him down, but he doesn't regard it as much of a problem because he presumes that someone as fat as Omaeda won't be moving fast either.Quite the surprise he received... Cruel Elephant: In his released state he turns into a big elephant man while remaining as much of a nasty brute as he was before. Dirty Old Man: He admits that he would've preferred to fight Rangiku instead of Ōmaeda.

characters.name: Kukkapūro
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: In the anime he has light brown fur, but the UNMASKED databook says his fur is white. Canine Companion: He was Yammy's Fracción, and despite being mistreated was loyal to the end. Disaster-Dodging Dog: He's said to have survived Wandenreich's invasion according to Kubo, in which the anime also confirms. Kick the Dog: Yammy chucks a bone at him when he's introduced. Non-Human Sidekick: Unlike all the other Arrancar, his appearance is completely animalistic.

characters.name: Pesche Guatiche and Dondochakka Birstanne
characters.description: The name and ability of Dondochakka's Zanpakutō is unknown, while Pesche wieldsUltima. Animal Motif: Pesche's disguise is meant to evoke a stag beetle. Beware the Silly Ones: They may seem like idiots....well, theyareidiots, but they'remuchmore impressive in combat than they've led everyone else to believe. Szayelaporro notes he'd have been seriously injured by their attacks if he wasn't soCrazy-Prepared. Boke and Tsukkomi Routine: When they're not fighting or trying to survive, they spend much of their time perfecting their comedy routine to entertain Nel. Pesche tries to set these up with Uryu when they're stuck together, much to the latter's annoyance. The Bus Came Back: They return for the "Thousand Year Blood War" arc, reuniting with Nel offscreen.In the anime, they also participate later on as part of Uryu's plan to destroy the central tower of Wahrwelt.

characters.name: Tesra Lindocruz
characters.description: His Zanpakutō isVerruga, which means "wart." It transforms him into an enormous warthog with overwhelming physical strength. All There in the Manual: A sketch Kubo did for Valentine's Day reveals that he has a crush on Nnoitra and once tried to confess. Sadly for him, Nnoitra's response was to destroy the Valentine's card with glee. Eye Beam: His Cero is fired from his eye, and named as Cero Cornea. Eyepatch of Power: Wears one to cover his one missing eye and emulate his master. Note that the eyepatch is absent in the flashback. Jerkass: Abuses his enemies just as badly as Nnoitra does, and without even an order to do so. He's just calmer about his savagery than his boss.

characters.name: Emilou Apacci
characters.description: Her Zanpakutō isCierva, which gives her stag-like features. Adaptation Expansion: The anime had aWhole Episode Flashbackabout how she met Harribel, Sung-Sun and Mila Rose. Ain't Too Proud to Beg: In Nestle To Night, she grabbed Orihime's head, locked eyes with her andrepeatedlybegged her to save Harribel, Sung-Sun and Mila Rose. Bambification: Averted. Despite her Resurrección being deer-themed, she is an ill-tempered, foul-mouthed Arrancar who is constantly butting heads with her fellow Fracción Mila Rose. Color-Coded Wizardry: Her Reaitsu is red in colour.

characters.name: Cyan Sung-Sun
characters.description: Her Zanpakutō isAnaconda, which transforms her into a naga. Anime Chinese Girl: The only female character who has a distinctly Chinese motif. Color-Coded Wizardry: Her Reaitsu is dark pink in colour. Dark Action Girl: Best shown when she impaled a Quincy soldier through his head with her sai. Deadpan Snarker: Sung-Sun regularly jabs at her other two teammates and is the least openly emotional of the three.

characters.name: Franceska Mila Rose
characters.description: Her Zanpakutō isLeona, which gives gives her the appearance of an Amazon-warrior with lion features. Amazon Brigade: She forms a unit of three with Apache and Sun-Sun. Together they serve Harribel and among the most powerful and capable Fracción-level warriors. The trio can also combine their powers by sacrificing their left arms to create a fighting monster so powerful that even lieutenant-level Soul Reapers are not strong enough to fight. Amazonian Beauty: She is one of the tallest female characters in the series at 5'9", carries a noticeable sixpack by the final arc, and wears the most skimpy and feral outfit of Harribel's Fracción. Color-Coded Wizardry: Her Reaitsu is orange in colour. Dark Action Girl: The anime plays it up more, as she fights Matsumoto personally and exhibits a behaviorial attitude reminiscent to aBlood Knight. In the manga, she even has a six-pack.

characters.name: Ayon
characters.description: Abnormal Limb Rotation Range: Ayon can twist its head a full 180 degrees on a dime, and can similarly twist its other limbs as needed. Almighty Janitor: While Apacci, Mila Rose, and Sung-Sun themselves are roughly around Soul Reaper lieutenant strength, with Rangiku and Momo able to fight evenly with them, Ayon is easily an Espada-level threat thatmultiplelieutenants can't stand up against. Attack! Attack! Attack!: It's fighting style basically is just hammering away at the enemy with brute force until nothing is left. It never changes strategies in any of the fights it is part of, which leads to it getting killed by Yamamoto. Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: Ayon doesn't seem to caretoo muchfor Apacci, Mila Rose, and Sung-Sun at first, given the first time it's summoned it totally ignores their orders and looks around for a bit before it commences with the ass-kicking at its own discretion, but the second time it's summoned against Quilge after the Sternritter badly injured all three of them it goes on the war path almost immediately to pound in his face and during a lull in the fighting looks back at them almost in concern. The Berserker: What makes Ayon so dangerous is how much it continues to keep fighting no matter what is done to it, partially because anytime it does get hurt, it just gets angrier and seemingly gets stronger. Yamamoto had to incinerate it completely to win, even though he was more powerful than it, and Quilge only managed to defeat it byabsorbing it's reishi. Against anyone that can't do anything along those lines, it keeps attacking no matter what it has to do, and doesn't slow.

characters.name: Szayelaporro's Fracciónes
characters.description: Co-Dragons: Szayelaporro's two main subordinates are called Lumina and Verona. Fat and Skinny: The most common body types among them are either snake-like or overly bulky. Gonk: Due to being both low-level Hollows and modified by a mad scientist, none of them look convincingly human. Non-Uniform Uniform: They all dress identical to Szayelaporro, with their outfits bearing his custom three-line marking on their chests and backs. One-Winged Angel: When Szayelaporro uses his Resurrección, he gets two Fracciónes who look even more monstrous than the ones he initially called forth.

characters.name: Roka Paramia
characters.description: All There in the Manual: Literally any information about her comes from the light novel spin-offSpirits are Forever With You, as she was merely a background character in the original manga/anime; a nameless nurse that reattached Yammy's arm who (supposedly) died after he tested out its strength. All Webbed Up: She can create webbing made of Negación, which she can use to upload information into her surroundings, letting her create a new body in the case of her death. By the time of her death at Yammy's hands, she had done so to a vast swath of Hueco Mundo. Artificial Human: She was an artificial Adjuchas created by Szayelaporro Granz to serve as a spy and means of resurrection. Body Backup Drive: She can use her powers to upload a copy of her soul and memories into her surroundings, manifest a duplicate body, and download her consciousness into it if her current body is killed. Death Seeker: Due to Szayelaporro constantly calling her useless and butchering her for his experiments, she wanted to die to escape the misery of her existence.

characters.name: Aisslinger Wernarr
characters.description: Adaptational Late Appearance: His first appearance in the manga turning Grand Fisher into an Arrancar is removed from the anime (only getting a small cameo as a shadowed figure before Grand Fisher goes to the human world at the start of the Memories in the Rain adaptation), so he first appears in the animated adaptation in the part where Ichigo, Uryu and Chad attempt to first infiltrate into Las Noches instead. Asskicking Leads to Leadership: His central belief is that strength is power and power is authority, and it is the reason he follows Aizen. Become Your Weapon: Aisslinger fused with his Zanpakutō instead of sealing his Hollow form into it. Bird People: Due to being an imperfect Arrancar, Aisslinger is much more avian than he is human. Chekhov's Gunman: In the manga, Aisslinger was the one that turned Grand Fisher into an Arrancar.

characters.name: Demoura Zodd
characters.description: Animal Motifs: He resembles a worm due to being an imperfect Arrancar. Applied Phlebotinum: Demoura gathers Reishi through his hands, enhancing his punches enough that it breaks the pavement rather profoundly. Dumb Muscle: Demoura is none too bright, which is evident in his speech pattern, but he's smart enough to useApplied Phlebotinumagainst Sado. Evil Counterpart: To Jidanbo, the giant who guards the gates to the Seireitei. While Jidanbo is a friendly guy, Demoura can barely tolerate Aisslinger. Face Framed in Shadow: When he first appeared, chasing Ichigo, Sado and Ishida through a narrow hallway.

characters.name: Loly Aivirrne
characters.description: Loly's Zanpakutō isEscolopendra, a sword that transforms her into a centipede with acid and poison-based abilities. Adaptational Heroism: She actually protects Orihime from Yammy in the anime, even when she clearly has no chance against him. Even if it'sbecause she can't stand the thought of someone else doing Orihime in, it's still a braver and borderline heroic thing than she ever did in the manga. All There in the Manual: The post war novels reveal that she and Menoly joined Rudbornn and Orihime and liberated Hueco Mundo from the Jagdarmee, fighting several guerilla wars. An Arm and a Leg: Her leg gets ripped off, courtesy of Grimmjow (the anime removes it). Animal Motifs: She's associated with centipedes, reflecting her nasty temperament and her toxic personality. Her Resurección covers her arms into two centipede-shaped tentacles and covers her body with the skeletal legs of one too.

characters.name: Menoly Mallia
characters.description: Adaptational Curves: Inverted as she's actually more chesty in the manga than in the anime. Adaptational Heroism: Despite herAdaptational Villainyin the anime, in the final confrontation she and Loly have with Orihime there she refuses to harm her while Loly gets mad at her comrade for supposedly chickening out, while Menoly proclaims there’s just no point in killing Orihime. Her manga counterpart can be shown joining in on torturing Orihime while wearing aSlasher Smile. Adaptational Villainy:While also more moderate than Loly as in the manga, the anime makes her more proactive in her torment of Orihime, smiling sadistically as Loly beats her and even threatening with shooting her Cero at her. By comparison, the manga has her look more meek and nervous at Loly's antics and is implied she only attacks Orihime out of being forced by Loly rather than for any pleasure she could have harming her.In the manga, there's not much implication that she's as much of aMonster Fangirlto Aizen as Loly is. The anime makes her more infatuated with Aizen, which leads to her torturing Orihime with more glee. While also more moderate than Loly as in the manga, the anime makes her more proactive in her torment of Orihime, smiling sadistically as Loly beats her and even threatening with shooting her Cero at her. By comparison, the manga has her look more meek and nervous at Loly's antics and is implied she only attacks Orihime out of being forced by Loly rather than for any pleasure she could have harming her. In the manga, there's not much implication that she's as much of aMonster Fangirlto Aizen as Loly is. The anime makes her more infatuated with Aizen, which leads to her torturing Orihime with more glee.

characters.name: Rudbornn Chelute
characters.description: Rudbornn wieldsÁrbol, which transforms him into... a tree. It's more menacing than it sounds, since the tree lets him sprout an infinite number of mooks. Adaptation Expansion: His confrontation with Rukia was furthered in the anime; instead of his opponent solely being Rukia, she was joined by Renji and Chad, who distracted him long enough for Rukia to freeze him. Affably Evil: While he can be quite arrogant when showing off his powers, he's very polite and professional as far as Arrancar go, and even when he carries out executions he simply treats it as a part of his job. Battle Discretion Shot: The manga's version of his fight with Rukia was skipped to the very ending, with Rukia completely unscathed and Rudbornn's tree branches frozen, preventing him from spawning the Calaveras. The Bus Came Back: He is defeated in battle by Rukia and then crushed by Yammy when he suddenly appears in front of Rukia. He isn't seen again in the manga, but is implied to have been killed by a combination of Rukia freezing his body and Yammy crushing his mask. However, he returns in theTite Kuboco-authoredCan't Fear Your Own World.

characters.name: Wonderweiss Margela
characters.description: His Zanpakutō is an enormous claymore namedExtinguir, solely designed to negate the effects of Yamamoto's Ryūjin Jakka by absorbing its flames. His Resurreccíon allows him to grow numerous arms from his shoulders. Alas, Poor Villain: Even Yamamoto pities him after he kills him.invokedYamamoto:Poor thing... Were your emotions taken away from you, too? (Stares at Aizen) That was cruel of you. Almighty Janitor: Soul Society classify him as Espada-level and his performance backs it up, but he still held the rank of Número throughout his time with Aizen. Considering that Aizen more-or-less lobotomized him, it isn't like he'd be able to hold that sort of authority to begin with. Beware the Silly Ones: In spite of hisCloudcuckoolandermentality, Wonderweiss is incredibly dangerous in a fight. He was able to pummel both Mashiro and Kensei - the latter while his Bankai was activated - and still had enough fight in him to target Yamamoto. From what could be seen of his Hollow form before Aizen used the Hogyoku to turn him into an Arrancar, Wonderweiss could very well have been a Vasto Lorde. BFS: His Zanpakutō is bigger than he is, and looks like a large long sword.

characters.name: Menos Grande Arrancar
characters.description: Ambiguous Gender: It's far too deformed to be identified as either male or female. I Am Not Left-Handed: Uryu tries to bisect its body, only for the Arrancar to split itself in two. Flying Face: Its "abdomen" is actually a second Arrancar whose face occupies its entire body. Overly Long Tongue: Its tongue is the length of its body and as a consequence hangs outside of its mouth at all times. Tiny-Headed Behemoth: It's at least twice the height of a human with a bulbous torso and upper arms, yet its head is disproportionately small.

characters.name: White
characters.description: Artificial Human: He was an artificial Hollow created by Aizen as part of his Hollowfication experiments. His creation mirrored the method Oetsu uses to create Zanpakutō, facilitating his ability to integrate himself into a target Soul Reaper's soul by taking over their Zanpakutō spirit. Barbarian Longhair: White possesses long white hair — the exact length varies from panel to panel — that protrudes from the back of his helmet, and is a powerful and savage combatant who killed numerous Soul Reapers. Battle in the Rain: Invokes this by only coming out to hunt during thunderstorms. Blade Below the Shoulder: White has two sword-like appendages in place of lower arms and hands, and Isshin inwardly remarks that despite being a Hollow it's a skilled combatant. Call-Forward: White's battle with Isshin contains several parallels to Hollow Ichigo's battle with Ulquiorra, with the anime including several shot-for-shot references. In the anime, some of White's roars are even recycled from Hollow Ichigo's.

characters.name: (#1) Primera Espada - Coyote Starrk and Lilynette Gingerbuck
characters.description: His Zanpakutō isLos Lobos, which transforms him into a traditional Wild Westgunslingerwith overwhelming offensive abilities. His guns allow him to fire Cero at a very rapid rate and he can use his soul-splitting abilities to create multiple weaponised spirit wolves. Abnormal Ammo: Aside from Ceros, he can also release exploding spirit wolves made out of pieces of his soul. Action Bomb: His spirit wolves explode with the force of a small nuke once they latch onto a target, as Love and Rose found out the hard way. The dub even calls them "wolf-shaped warheads". Adaptation Dye-Job: His hair is jet black in the manga, brown in the anime. Affably Evil: In spite of his laziness and apathy, Starrk is easily the least malicious and aggressive of the Espada. He never mocks his enemies, doesn't act arrogant, apologizes when he abducts Orihime, and even compliments Kyoraku's attacks during their fight. He's so nice that Kyoraku laments that they're enemies, and does not enjoy the fact that he has to kill him.

characters.name: (#2) Segunda Espada - Baraggan Louisenbairn
characters.description: His Zanpakutō is an enormous battle-axe namedArrogantewhich allows him to slow time and age his opponent through physical contact, leaving their bones brittle. He can release its true form to become a skeleton clad in purple furs and garbs that is able to launchRespira, a black wave of rapid aging that decays everything it touches in a matter of seconds. Alas, Poor Villain: Although he's anAsshole Victimas well, his death is still treated tragically to some extent, with"Never Meant to Belong"playing through it in the anime, Starrk mourning his death and even his killer, Hachi, pitying him for ultimately being no less afraid of death than anyone else. Horrible he might be, he dies as a broken man, no less of a victim of Aizen's manipulations as anyone else, unable to take his revenge on the traitorous Soul Reaper, with his final attack on Aizen failing miserably. All There in the Manual: The novels "Spirits are Forever with You" and "Can't Fear your Own World" explain more about his reign as the ruler of Hueco Mundo and how he had formed the first generation of the Espada. Animal Motifs: Completely averts this by being themed after human skeletons instead,showing him as the homo sapiens ruler of Hueco Mundo that is populated by animal-themed Hollows. Antagonist Abilities: Baraggan's Respira makes him an almostuntouchableopponent. In his unreleased state, he can slow down any attack coming at him so he can easily avoid it. Any tactics and techniques are impossible against him because simplygetting nearhim willageeitherthe techniqueor the opponent todeath. This even extends to the ground he's walking on and also allowed him to survive aFantastic Nuketo the face. If his Respira does touch an opponent, they have toseverthe part of the body that's rotting to avoid dying.

characters.name: (#3) Tres Espada - Tier Harribel
characters.description: Her Zanpakutō,Tiburón, gives her a shark motif and control of water-based abilities. In her normal form, the blade is hollow and can be filled with spiritual power to increase its strength. Adaptational Modesty:In the manga, her outfit leaves herUnderboobsexposed, and her mask fragments underneath just cover her nipples while baring most of her chest. In the anime, her outfit completely covers her chest, and her mask fragments only expose some cleavage.Her pants in the manga leave much of her thighs exposed, but are more conservative in the anime. In the manga, her outfit leaves herUnderboobsexposed, and her mask fragments underneath just cover her nipples while baring most of her chest. In the anime, her outfit completely covers her chest, and her mask fragments only expose some cleavage. Her pants in the manga leave much of her thighs exposed, but are more conservative in the anime. Adaptation Expansion: The anime dedicated a handful of filler episodes to showing her backstory as a pacifist Vasto Lorde opposed to Barrigan's reign, protecting a trio of female Adjuchas - who later became her Fracción - from the predations of other Menos.In Cour 4 of TYBW arc,she is finally rescued by Nelliel, and also takes part in a fight against Yhwach to execute Uryu's plan to take down the central tower of Wahrwelt.

characters.name: (#4) Cuatro Espada - Ulquiorra Cifer
characters.description: His Zanpakuto,Murciélago, transforms him into a bat-like demon that gives him incomprehensible speed and allows him to create energy javelins. He has a hidden second transformation namedSegunda Etapathat transforms him into a demon with vastly enhanced destructive and regenerative abilities. He received a short comic made by Tite Kubo about his back story in the third data book,Unmasked, which shows his origins. Alas, Poor Villain: His character arc is about trying to understand the meaning of human emotions, which he finally does, just barely too late, in his final moments. The tragedy of this is reflected in how the protagonists react to his passing; Orihime comes to peace with him by reaching for his hand, and Ichigo is obviously devastated at having killed Ulquiorra the way he did. All of the Other Reindeer: In his backstory inUnmasked, Ulquiorra had a white body except for his wings and no mouth, while his brethren were jet black and had mouths. They tried to devour him for his different appearance, and he was forced to kill them in self-defense. All There in the Manual: His backstory is not addressed in the manga or anime but is instead revealed in theUnmaskeddatebook, which furthermore reveals what exactly his unique Segunda Etapa form is.

characters.name: (#5) Quinto Espada - Nnoitra Gilga
characters.description: Santa Teresa, his oddly shaped... axe-like Zanpakutō, gives him six arms and six scythes, all capable of high-speed regeneration if he was to lose one or two. His number tattoo is on his tongue, and his Hollow hole is where his left eye should be - along with the remains of his Hollow mask. Alas, Poor Villain: Clearly what the anime (with a very sad music theme) aimed at, showing him as aStraw Nihilistliving behind theDespair Event Horizon, with an absurdly huge overcompensated inferiority complex. Ambiguous Situation: An interview to promote the final arc revealed which Espada will return. Grimmjow, Nel and Harribel were stated to return, as they had survived the events of the Arrancar Saga. Notably Starrk, Nnoitra and Zommari were given a small chance to return, while the other Espada were given zero, With the final arc being cut short it remains unknown what the significance of said distinction was. Starrk, Nnoitra, Zommari, Szayelaporro, and Aaroniero were killed by a Zanpakutō (Baraggan died by his own powers, Yammy of blood loss, and Ulquiorra was fatally injured by a Cero), which would mean that they were either cleansed and ended up in Soul Society or ended up in Hell. I Am Not Left-Handed: His Resurrección looks like it has four arms, but it really has six. He also has a very powerfulHealing Factor, just in case anyone actually manages to damage him. Animal Motifs: His Resurrección, Santa Teresa, is the Spanish name for apraying mantis. His transformation grants him six arms, giving him an insect-like appearance, and his scythes are meant to evoke the image of a mantis' forelegs.

characters.name: (#6) Sexta Espada - Grimmjow Jaegerjaquez
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isPantera, which transforms him into a cat-man hybrid that is capable of extreme speed. He can also create giant energy claws and howl loudly enough to cause shock waves. Acquired Poison Immunity:Bleach: Cannot Fear Your Own Worldreveals that he gained some resistance to poison after surviving his fight with Nakk Le Vaar, who had the ability to make everything poisonous by lowering the lethal dose. While fighting a zombified Luppi, Grimmjow finds himself briefly poisoned and paralyzed by the chemicals Mayuri left inside Luppi's body, only to overcome the paralysis moments later, something that surprises both Mayuri and Grimmjow himself. Animal Motifs: As an Adjuchas he strongly resembled apanther(if the title of chapter 625 is of any indication, more concretely a jaguar), and his Resurrección, Pantera, gives him a number of feline traits. It's befitting of his wild, independent and vicious nature. Anti-Hero: Grimmjow may have agreed to ally with Ichigo's group for the final battle, but it's not for heroic reasons; he solely wants to get a rematch with Ichigo in Hueco Mundo. However, while still violent and merciless towards his enemies, he still follows a code of honor and fights to ensure the safety of Hueco Mundo. Unlike Nelliel who genuinely considers Ichigo and his friends as allies, Grimmjow still considers them to be enemies. An Arm and a Leg: Tōsen cuts off his left arm as punishment for insubordination, making sure to burn it to ashes afterwards. The injury was considered debilitating enough to strip him of his rank, something Yammy had the fortune to avoid because his arm was left intact after Ichigo cut it off. After Orihime is kidnapped, she is ordered to display her power by restoring it.

characters.name: (#7) Septima Espada - Zommari Rureaux
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isBrujeria, and it transforms his lower body into something similar to that of a sea urchin with 50 eyes covering his body. Each of these eyes are capable of "tagging" targets and telekinetically controlling said targets. If the eyes are incapacitated, he can open 8 more on his forehead. All There in the Manual: The Unmasked Data book reveals that he used to be a king, without further elaborating on it. Ambiguous Situation: An interview to promote the final arc revealed which Espada will return. Grimmjow, Nel and Harribel were stated to return, as they had survived the events of the Arrancar Saga. Notably Starrk, Nnoitra and Zommari were given a small chance to return, while the other Espada were given zero, With the final arc being cut short it remains unknown what the significance of said distinction was. Starrk, Nnoitra, Zommari, Szayelaporro, and Aaroniero were killed by a Zanpakuto (Baraggan died by his own powers, Yammy of blood loss, and Ulquiorra was fatally injured by a Cero), which would mean that they were either cleansed and ended up in Soul Society or ended up in Hell. I Am Not Left-Handed: Pulled this several times during his fight with Byakuya, which include the fact that he can do up to five speed clones, his lower half acting as a last resort defense and his reveal of eight more eyes in his forehead to launch another attack. However, none of these attacks have any long term advantage over Byakuya. Animal Motifs: His Resurrección resembles a sea urchin in design, specifically the lower part.This doubles as brilliance as sea urchins were often used in witchcraft in Denmark and Southern England. Which prominently feature in the Evil Eye aspect of sorcery of which Zommari utilizes.

characters.name: (#8) Octava Espada - Szayelaporro Granz
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isFornicarasand yes, it does mean"you will fornicate"in Spanish—though all English localizations censor the name to toLa Lujuriosa, which is Spanish for "The Lustful One". It gives him a motif based on various aquatic animals such as jellyfish, sea anemones, and corals with a wide range of abilities. Agent Peacock: Szayelaporro presents himself as a flamboyant Espada with a penchant for theatrics and sexual innuendo. He's powerful enough to contend with captain level fighters and willstop a fightjust so he can change into a less torn set of clothing. In his Resurrección, he obtains a much more feminine set of attire that further pushes his sexual themes through an invasive set of abilities. Kubo has also described Szayelaporro as a character he designed to look pretty, although hisoffputting behaviormay have canceled out that impression big time. All There in the Manual: The novelSpirits are Forever With Youreveals his past as human, the relationship with his brother Yylfordt, how he became a Hollow and how he got demoted from the Espada before climbing up the ranks again. And I Must Scream: Due to a drug he accidentally injests, his perceptions are sped up to the point that the few seconds it takes for Mayuri toveryslowly kill him seem like they took thousands of years. Thousands of years of simply staring at a sword and waiting for it to stab him. By the end of it, he isbeggingto hurry up and die. Animal Motifs: His Resurrección is related tocnidarians, a phylum of marine invertebrates that are characterized by their gelatinous structure, ability to capture and subdue prey with their tentacles, asexually reproduce via cloning and completely regenerate from even losing most of their bodies. Those traits are as follows:The tentacles he gains on his lower half resemble sea anemones and his bodily structure can be likened to a jellyfish (in its medusa phase).Furthermore, he's likely based on the immortal jellyfish, as they're the only species of jellyfis

characters.name: (#9) Noveno Espada - Aaroniero Arruruerie
characters.description: Aaroniero is the 9th and only Gillian Espada. Because of his nonhuman appearance, he usually wears a white mask with eight tiny holes over his head so as to not attract unwanted attention. He is prideful of his status as the last of the first-generation Espada, a position he has managed to maintain due to his potential for infinite growth by continuing to devour other Hollows even as an Arrancar. He defines the death aspect of 'Greed'. His number tattoo is on his heads, and his Hollow hole is in his left thigh. His Zanpakuto isGlotonería, which transforms him into an enormous octopus-like creature. In this form, he has all the abilities of every Hollow he has devoured at his disposal. He additionally wields Kaien'sNejibana, a trident utilizing water-based attacks. Adaptational Dye-Job: The monstrous bottom half of Glotonería upon Resurrección is yellow in the manga, but it's purple in the anime and most video games. In the anime adaptation ofThe Hell Verseteaser chapter, the anime corrected this by turning it back to yellow. Alas, Poor Villain: While Aaroniero's primary head deserved his fate, his secondary head gets a rather pitiful moment where it screams in pain, begging to be saved from an agonizing death before finally expiring. It helps that the secondary head wasn't as actively cruel as the primary one. Alliterative Name:AaronieroArruruerie.

characters.name: (#10) Diez & Cero Espada - Yammy Llargo
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isIra, which transforms him into a gargantuan...thing, vaguely resembling an ankylosaurus if he is angered. If he is to be further angered in this state, he can additionally transform into an even bigger form resembling a gorilla. All There in the Manual: The official UNMASKED databook notes that Yammy actually put up a fight in his off-screen fight against Byakuya and Kenpachi, leaving them significantly wounded. Animal Motifs: His Resurrección resembles an ankylosaurus. His powered up form resembles an ape, specifically agorilla. An Arm and a Leg: Ichigo manages to cut off his right arm in their first fight, but the arm is left intact for him to get it reattached, preventing him from losing his Espada rank like Grimmjow when his arm was cut off and subsequently incinerated by Tosen.
