When he activates his Resurrección, Byakuya and Kenpachi in particular take turns chopping off fingers and legs, but he heals over once he activates his powered-up form. He's lost the arm again by the time Byakuya and Kenpachi defeat him off-screen. Attack of the 50-Foot Whatever: He can apparently change size in his sealed form; when Chad sees him again in Las Noches, he notes that he's far larger than he was in the real world. And then there's his release... And his second powerup if that was even possible.

characters.name: Isshin Kurosaki
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isEngetsu, which shares some abilities with his son's sword Zangetsu - namely the signature technique Getsuga Tenshou. Action Dad: He pretends to be aSupernatural-Proof Father, but in reality he's an extremely powerful Soul Reaper, to the point that he proved capable of pushing Aizen to his limits without releasing his Zanpakuto. In general, he lets his son handle the Hollows that intrude into Karakura Town due to being powerless for the first half of the series, and being a fugitive from Soul Society. Amazingly Embarrassing Parents: Isshin is a master atObfuscating Stupidity, to the point where as far as Ichigo and (to some extent) Karin are concerned he's an embarrassment to the family. As You Know: Isshin and Urahara have a conversation about the Visoreds and the Arrancar in which they inform each other of much information they both already know, for Kon's (and, in the anime, theBount modsouls') benefit... which fortuitously also brings the readers up to date. Later on, the "Turn Back the Pendulum" and "Everything but the Rain" arcs reveal that the version of events they shared was only part of the story. Beware the Nice Ones: Isshin is a loving, bumbling father who adores his kids. He's a pleasant doctor and a very nice man who's well-liked in Karakura. He is also one of the most powerful Soul Reaper captains of his generation and will show zero mercy to his enemies. He's even polite to Grand Fisher, the Hollow who murdered his wife. Even after he's just sliced the beast in half.

characters.name: Masaki Kurosaki
characters.description: Isshin's wife and the mother of Ichigo, Karin and Yuzu. She was a beautiful, sweet redhead who died when Ichigo was nine years old, protecting him from a Hollow that attacked the poor kid when they were walking by the local river. Her death completely changed the family dynamics: Ichigo was a crybaby but matured into aHot-BloodedKnight Templar Big Brother, Yuzu became a responsible and sweet caretaker, and the formerly tearful Karin toughened herself up so her family wouldn't worry. Little did they know, her murderer would be back later... Action Girl: As a trained warrior, she didn't hesitate to jump into battle to save strangers from Hollows. She first met Isshin while saving his life from a Hollow designed by Aizen. Alliterative Name: MasakiKurosaki. Ambiguous Situation: It's unclear what became of her soul after her death. Typically, Hollows devour the souls they kill, the only way to free them being to purify the Hollow with a Zanpakuto. As she was killed by Grand Fisher and his lure possessed a memory of her, this would imply he did devour her, and her soul was freed when Isshin killed him. Complicating things is that she's a Quincy, as Hollows are toxic to Quincy souls, but it's noted by others that Masaki somehow had a strong tolerance to White, managing to last a day before Isshin and Urahara needed to help her. In addition, right before Grand Fisher killed her, Yhwach conducted an Auswählen, whichdepoweredher. So the questions are whether or not Masaki's Soul was destroyed by Grand Fisher, if her soul was already strong enough to survive destruction, and if the Auswählen occurring affected what became of her soul. What makes this even more confusing is Kubo stating that any Quincy who dies does not go to the Soul Society. Arranged Marriage: She and Ryuken were set up together in an effort to preserve the Ishida family's Echt lineage. Neither Masaki nor Ryuken were thrilled about this.

characters.name: Karin Kurosaki
characters.description: Abnormal Ammo: Whenever Karin tries her hand atHollow-slaying, it involves herkickinga Reiatsu-laced soccer ball intosaid Hollow's face. With varying and limited success. Alliterative Name:KarinKurosaki. Big Brother Worship: Not nearly as pronounced as Yuzu's but Karin does love Ichigo. She knows that he will ultimately never let her down and trusts him implicitly. When he was depowered for a time, she started to visit Urahara's shop for help in dealing with the stray spirits, like Ichigo used to. Character Development: Starts off as a bratty kid who wants nothing to do with any spiritual nonsense to admitting to Urahara of all people, that she wants to protect Ichigo and their family in his place now that all his Shinigami powers were gone. Deadpan Snarker: She tends to lampshade the stupid antics of her family in a very calm, bored tone.

characters.name: Yuzu Kurosaki
characters.description: Big Brother Worship: While both her and Karin adore Ichigo, Yuzu idolizes her older brother to such an extent that Karin teasingly impliesshe has an incestuous crush on him. Book Smart: She does so well at school that she achieves near-perfect scores in exams. Character Development: Yuzu started off as polite and cheery. After theTime Skip, she's still cheery, but a lot more temperamental. Children Do the Housework: Yuzu does most of the cooking, cleaning and shopping for the Kurosaki household. She's been doing all this since the age of five, at the time her mother died. Disney Death: She dies from overexposure to Hell's atmosphere in theHell Versemovie, but later makes a recovery.

characters.name: Kon
characters.description: Attention Whore: When he originally got control of Ichigo's body, he was thrilled that his ability was enhanced leg strength since it let him stand out and get everyone's attention. Big Brother Instinct: While Kon usually tries to avoid Yuzu because she treats him like a doll, he is protective of her and Karin and does what little he can to look after them when Ichigo is away. Butt-Monkey: If you thought, "Are you forgetting Kon, how the hell do you forget Kon?", then that's becauseeveryoneforgets Kon. That's why he's pissed all the time. Buxom Beauty Standard: Kon's view of women. He's willing to make an exception for Rukia, otherwise bust size determines his reaction. Caught with Your Pants Down: Upon returning from Soul Society, Ichigo walks in on Kon in his body, jerking off to an imagined threesome with Rukia and Orihime. He's less than impressed.

characters.name: Soken Ishida
characters.description: He was killed when Uryu was a young child by a gang of five hollows. The Soul Reaper watchers were delayed in coming to his rescue because they had been bribed by Mayuri Kurotsuchi to sit back and collect Soken's soul after death. As part of Mayuri's Quincy experiments, Soken's soul had been tortured to death for information. He died swearing to the pride of the Quincy and with the name of either his grandson or his student on his lips. Mayuri claims he can't remember, baiting Uryu into confirming he was Soken's grandsonandstudent. Action Dad: Soken was an active Quincy fighter despite having a family to raise. It meant he often missed dinner with his wife, son and Masaki, which greatly upset his wife. Adaptation Expansion: Whilst implied to have had aMysterious Pastwith the Wandenreich, Soken's posthumous presence in the final arc is quite minimal. This is changed in the anime, where it is revealed that he kept a notebook recording as much of the Lichtreich's and Wandenreich's history as possible, which Uryu manages to discover and read. From the journal, Soken, despite noting the brutality of the genocides that the Soul Reapers inflicted on the Quincies, and not knowing as much as Yhwach's powers as he maybe would have preferred to pass down, ultimately condemned the so-called King of the Quincies as a false savior whose hypocritical goals brought even more suffering to the Quincies and endangered all of existence, hence Soken's opposition to the Wandenreich. He himself is later revealed to have engaged in a course of research not unlike Urahara and Aizen through trying to sublimate and combine different souls together in his quest for a united world...and gave Yhwach the theory for the Distortion that would form the backbone of his second invasion of the Three Worlds, which is implied to have been the final straw for his tenure at the Wandenreich. Adaptational Intelligence: Cour 4 of the anime reveals that Soken is actuallyon Urahara and Aizen'slevel concerning t

characters.name: Izumi Ishida
characters.description: Awful Wedded Life:Zig-zagged; she loves her husband, but Ryuken theorizes that becausehis father spends so much time away from homeIzumi has become grumpy and lonely as a result, ultimately taking out her frustrations on Masaki. Game-Breaking Injury: Izumi's leg is notoriously scarred, possibly an injury from a previous battle. When Ryuken runs away from home usingHirenkyakuwhile trying to save Masaki, Izumi is unable to follow him. Named by the Adaptation: She is only known as "Mrs. Ishida" in the manga. Her first name was revealed when Masaki called her "Aunt Izumi" in the corresponding episode. Strong Family Resemblance: She looks like an older and female version of her grandson without glasses. What Happened to the Mouse?: She is only shown in flashback and is never be mentioned by either her son or her grandson, leaving it unknown whether she was one of Yhwach's victims or if she passed away from natural causes. Since Uryu never mentioned her and there is no flashback of his interaction with Izumi, its implied she passed away before his birth.

characters.name: Ryuken Ishida
characters.description: Although he refuses to use his own Quincy power, Ryuken is apparently much stronger than Uryu. He and Isshin have known each other for over twenty years and their relationship is a more mature equivalent of the relationship between their two sons. Arranged Marriage: He and Masaki were supposed to be married in order to preserve the "pure" Quincy blood. Badass in a Nice Suit: Ryuken rarely wears anything but white suits in the manga(beige in the anime),justifiedin that he's the director of a major urban hospital and has to be professionally dressed. He's also a very powerful Quincy and capable of kicking much ass (includingcurbstompinghis very talented son) without even removing his jacket or loosening his tie. Beneath Notice: His rejection of his Quincy heritage in favor of a normal life as a doctor, despite his great power and talent, means that Yhwach and the rest of the Vandenreich basically don't even realize he exists. This gives him the perfect blindspot to deliver the one weapon that can help kill Yhwach for good. Best Served Cold: After his wife is killed by Yhwach's Auswählen, Ryuken performs an extensive autopsy on her corpse that lasts several days in order to find the root cause of her death. He discovers a special silver clot that developed in her heart as a result of the technique and forges it into an arrowhead. He then spends the next decade deliberately alienating himself from the remaining Quincy including his own father and son as well as the spiritual world in general in order to stay beneath Yhwach's notice. Ryuken finally delivers the arrowhead to Uryu just before the final battle, allowing him and Ichigo to kill Yhwach once and for all and avenging his wife.

characters.name: Kanae Katagiri
characters.description: Action Girl: Ryuken singles out Katagiri as his fighter of choice when discussing the subject of mixed bloods fighting instead of purebloods. When he does go to fight, she is his first choice for battle partner. Although they don't actually get to fight on that occasion, she's introduced from the outset as a highly competent Quincy warrior who also happens to be female. Alliterative Name:KanaeKatagiri. Anguished Declaration of Love: She pulls this on Ryuken as part of aYou Are Not Alonespeech. It's so utterly heart-wrenching and genuine that he pulls himself out of hisHeroic BSoDbefore she can break down as badly as he did. Bait-and-Switch: Up until Episode 40, it was implied that she was directly targeted by Yhwach himself. Turns out, it wasUryuwho was drained by Auswahlen, and Kanae had tosacrifice her strength and health to save her son. Bodyguard Crush: She's not just Ryuken's faithful bodyguard, she's also his late wife and Uryu's mother.

characters.name: Tatsuki Arisawa
characters.description: Action Girl: While her burgeoning powers ultimately end up going nowhere, she's regardless quite the badass martial artist and more than capable of taking down any punk fools who cross her - just notquitecapable of fighting Hollows or anything else spiritual. Adaptation Dye-Job: Her blue eyes from the manga became brown in the anime. Badass Normal: Tatsuki is a talented martial artist with just enough spiritual power to see ghosts, but against the series' threats she's only human. Boyish Short Hair: Tatsuki has an aggressive personality, is too masculine forChizuru'staste, and who used to be better than Ichigo at karate. Fittingly, she has the short, spiky hair common to anime males to go with her personality. After the time-skip, she grows out her hair and becomes more noticeably feminine in appearance — if not personality. Brainwashed and Crazy:Numb Chandelier, a Hollow summoned by Ishida's bait, infects Tatsuki with herBulb Scatterability and forces her to attack Orihime despite Tatsuki struggling to resist it. Fortunately, Orihime awakens her Fullbring — Shun Shun Rika — and heals Tatsuki before angrily slicing the sadistic Hollow in half.Tsukishima uses his Fullbring, Book of the End, to alter Tatsuki's past so that he was one of her close childhood friends, resulting in Tatsuki becoming violently protective of him and berating Ichigo for attacking him.

characters.name: Mizuiro Kojima
characters.description: Action Survivor: Upon waking up in a sleeping city, the first things he grabs are food, water, a cell phone charger, a gasoline canister, and stun guns for everyone. Dissonant Serenity: He doesn't seem too fazed by all the crazy stuff going on around him, even after seeing the guy who's trying to kill them disintegrate objects with hisreiatsu. The only time heeverpanics is whenKeigois about tothrow his life away trying to slow down Aizen. Energetic and Soft-Spoken Duo: Keigo and Mizuiro are two of Ichigo's oldest friends and are always together. Keigo is the outgoing funny-man while Mizuiro is the quiet, introverted leader of the pair. Although they develop enough power to see the spirit world, their involvement in the main storyline is peripheral as they have no way of fighting the spiritual threats that exist. During the Deicide mini-arc, their lack of power doesn't stop them from briefly confronting Aizen when he tries to kill them just to incite Ichigo's rage. Mizuiro creates a home-made Molotov cocktail at Aizen in an attempt to buy them enough time to flee. Kid-anova: Surprisingly successful, judging bychapter 0.8. He's able to get a homemade meal almost every day despite not living with his mother or knowing how to cook himself. Likes Older Women: Stated to have a preference for older women. Considering he's estranged from his mother, that has...interestingimplications.

characters.name: Keigo Asano
characters.description: Action Survivor: When Aizen enters Karakura town, he pulls out his hidden competency and nerve and manages to hold things together quite well. Book Dumb: He apparently takes pride in ranking low on exam scores, but he's actually incredibly resourceful and street-smart. He even acts as the de facto leader of the group while they flee Aizen's pursuit, and shows a lot of ingenuity and observation in the process, such as the fact that a Zanpakuto would be a better weapon against Aizen than anything else available. For someone with only a very basic knowledge of Soul Reapers, he certainly learns quick. Butt-Monkey: He's always being blown off by his friends or smacked around by his older sister. He's the one who ends up in crazy situations and freaking out or becomes the voice of cynical disbelief whenever Mizuiro does something weirdly off-kilter. Buxom Beauty Standard: Keigo's view of women is that the bigger their chest size, the more irresistible they are. Chest size acts as his main guide in how he reacts to women. As such, the sight of theverybusty Rangiku drives him wild. Dumb Is Good: Takes great pride in his lack of academic achievement and is aNice Guy, sort of. Mizuiro does once tell Ichigo that Keigo's actually much smarter than he lets on, but for some reason refuses to use it.

characters.name: Mizuho Asano
characters.description: Hand-or-Object Underwear: She forces Ikkaku to do this is episode 229 by walking into the bathroom to give Ikkaku's back a scrub. Ikkaku is so shocked he drops his towel and is forced to use his hands to cover himself. Has a Type: She's only interested in bald/shaven men.Ikkakufinds her a handful to deal with as a result when he along with a small group of shinigami go undercover in the realworld for a bit. Her only previous boyfriend mentioned is a toupee-wearing boy that goes to a neighboring school. Smitten Teenage Girl: Even in the manga, she's rather dramatic about her desire for Ikkaku. The anime makes it worse and even takes it to its usual conclusion of involving aRescue Romance(in aPlayed for Laughssort of way). Stalker with a Crush:Fillerepisode 229turns her into one for comedy purposes as part of her plan to win Ikkaku's heart by being a "considerate woman". She's even willing to walk in on Ikkaku in the bathroom to give his back a scrub and secretly plants an alarm clock on him so she can randomly pop up with lunch at just the right time (Ikkaku's actually in the park when she dives out of the bushes with lunch). Student Council President: The 24th, no less, and Ishida's predecessor.

characters.name: Chizuru Honsho
characters.description: Bowdlerise: Most of her lesbian flirtation in early parts of the manga get cut from the anime, though whether its a true example of this trope or a streamlined adaptation is anyone's guess. Her later appearances in the anime (including filler) certainly make up for it. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: She was a consistent presence as part of the Karakura chapters, even being one of the few still awake during the Deicide arc. After the timeskip however, she's completely vanished and isn't brought up by anyone. Fish Out of Water: The Deicide arc revealed Chizuru had the ability to sense spirits, Hollows, and Soul Reapers when she regained consciousness while Karakura Town was trapped in Soul Society. Because no-one knew, she'd hadabsolutely no informationgiven to her about the supernatural world and, since the gang was fleeingAizen, she was tossed into the deep end in the worst possible way. She had absolutely no idea what was going on and demanded to be brought up to speed as soon as possible; she was well aware she may not understand everything she was told, but felt she should be told it anyway. No-one disagreed. Like the other spiritually aware school children, she was strong enough to survive Aizen's presence without dying. Genki Girl: Chizuru is very, very excitable when around Orihime. Tatsuki does her best to keep her in line but there's only so much she can do. Hidden Buxom: When carrying Chizuru, who was unconscious, Keigo told Tatsuki once she was more well-endowed than he thought. Tatsuki promptly punches him.

characters.name: Other Classmates
characters.description: Bookworm: Kunieda gets some of the best grades in the class. Brainy Brunette: Kunieda is the second best student in their class with Ishida as the top spot and Orihime as third. She's also seen often with books or magazines. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: They are never seen again after the time-skip. Deadpan Snarker: Kunieda tends to snark at the antics of the class. Girl Next Door: The three, in different ways. Michiru is the cute and homey one, Mahana is the more active and tomboyish type, and Kunieda is the smart and quietBookworm.

characters.name: Jinta Hanakari
characters.description: All There in the Manual: The series proper never really explain much about him during its run. It isn't until the Light Novel, "Cannot Fear Your Own World", which came out after the series end, that finally shed some light on him. Artificial Human:Bleach: Cannot Fear Your Own Worldreveals that Urahara created them. Shuhei Hisagi thinks he is a mod soul in a gigai, but Urahara denies that is the case. Kubo would later confirm on Klub Outside that Jinta and Ururu are Mod Souls made by Urahara. Tokinada Tsunayashiro suggests that Urahara created them with the intention of using them as replacements for the Soul King should anything happen to him, which Urahara also denies. Batter Up!: Jinta has been shown using a gigantic kanabo when attacking lesser hollows. Fiery Redhead: Jinta is as loud and brash as his hair. I Got Bigger: He's taller and somewhat more muscular than when we first saw him after the timeskip.

characters.name: Ururu Tsumugiya
characters.description: All There in the Manual: The series proper never really explains much about her during its run (Though does give some clues that she's clearly not human). It isn't until the Light Novel, "Cannot Fear Your Own World", which came out after the series ended, that finally shed some light on her. Ambiguously Human: Shelookshuman, but is superhumanly strong and can go into a machine-like combat-mode. Artificial Human: While the manga and anime only establish her as beingAmbiguously Human,Bleach: Cannot Fear Your Own Worldreveals that Urahara created them — explaining her superhuman abilities. Shuhei Hisagi thinks she is a mod soul in a gigai, but Urahara denies that is the case. Kubo would later confirm on Klub Outside that Jinta and Ururu are Mod Souls made by Urahara. Tokinada Tsunayashiro suggests that Urahara created them with the intention of using them as replacements for the Soul King should anything happen to him, which Urahara also denies. Badass Adorable: She managed to forceYylfordtto goOne-Winged Angel. BFG: Ururu who wields some kind of wrapped up rocket launcher type weapon.

characters.name: Don Kan'onji
characters.description: Badass Normal:Relatively speaking. By the standards of the setting, Kan'onji isjusta spiritually aware human with a minor level of reishi control. However, after being made aware of how he was accidentallycreatingHollows, he starts acting as a proper hero, even joining two separate teams created by Urahara, and is most effective just with his heroic heart. When Aizen begins walking through Karakura, Kan'onji is one of theonlypeople able to stand up, impressive when even Tatsuki could barely move and normal peopledisintegratefrom being near Aizen's reiatsu, and refused to back down despite being clearly outmatched,declaringit's his job as a hero to protect the innocent no matter what. Catchphrase: He has three: "SPIRITS ARE ALWAYS WITH YOU!", "Smells like bad spirits!", and "BWAHAHAHAHA!" Entertainingly Wrong: Tragically so. He was opening up the holes on demi-Hollows because it made them disappear. He thought this was freeing the souls and stopping places from being haunted. His show was just a way for him to get paid in order to keep doing this. While, yes, a demi-Hollow's hole being opened does make them disappear, they reappear later as soul eating monsters. Once told of this, he is horrified and works to ACTUALLY save people from becoming Hollows or being killed by supernatural forces. Fake Ultimate Hero: Only in the sense of not being ultimate. He's certainly got a good heart, and successfully protects people and combats Hollows on several occasions. Feet of Clay: He's beloved as a spiritual medium and does have some level of power, but he's completely incapable of handling even a single normal Hollow by himself.

characters.name: Ikumi & Kaoru Unagiya
characters.description: Action Mom: Her entry involves her beating up a whole group of thugs single handed. Predictably, she isquitedoting and over-protective of her son. Blood Knight: If herSlasher Smileafter beating up the gangsters is any indication, Unagiya seems to enjoy being thewinnerof a fight, at the very least. Catchphrase: "We're not an Eel Shop." She always starts her phone calls with this due to her surname unfortunately translating out to "Eel Shop". Charles Atlas Superpower: Played straight. Demonstrates this by wiping the floor with a gang andkidnappinga depowered Ichigo using the same move he used on Aizen at the final battle. All this and so farTite Kubohas not confirmed whether she's a former Soul Reaper, Quincy, Vizard, Arrancar or a spiritually aware human (though it should be noted that she can see Ichigo's Substitute Shinigami Badge, which is supposed to beInvisible to Normals). Cool Big Sis: She likes to view herself as a big sister figure. Ichigo teases her about how she's too old for it, but if he didn't feel the same he probably wouldn't have gone to her for emotional support in the first place.

characters.name: Sora Inoue
characters.description: Body Horror: Especially in the anime, where not only he fell in despair — but his soul was forcibly turned into a Hollow. Chekhov's Gunman: The hairpins that he gave to Orihime went from herTragic Keepsaketo her favored weapon: the Shun Shun Rikka. Despair Event Horizon: Believing that Orihime had forgotten about him drove him to the edge. In reality, Orihime never did so, and actually stopped praying to his memory to not have him worry about her in the afterlife. Sora/Acidwire doesn't learn about it until later. Early-Installment Weirdness: As Acidwire, his mask gets a significant chunk broken off during his arc yet he never transforms into a pseudo-Arrancar like Grand Fisher. Instead more of the person he originally was starts seeping through. Knight Templar Big Brother: As Acidwire, he attacks Tatsuki and later Ichigo and Rukia aside of Orihime, and he claims that he wants to kill Orihimeso no one else can have her.

characters.name: Shukuro Tsukishima
characters.description: His Fullbring,Book of the End, is a katana capable of cutting anything, but its true power is altering the past of anything Tsukishima cuts. The Ace:Invoked; once he "bookmarks" someone, he dictates the relationship he's had with the person throughout their history. He can become a cousin, a friend, a lover, a colleague, a business partner, or even an enemy, whatever choice is necessary to make himself the perfect person to pour all their emotion into. He takes control of Orihime and Sado by replacing the roles played in their pasts by their brother and grandfather respectively and by inserting himself as the main reason they were able to save Rukia or defeat Aizen.Inserting himself into an enemy's past also allows him to instantly learnallof their techniques and abilities, allowing to near-effortlessly dodge and bypass them mid-battle even if said enemy would normally outclass him in every aspect. Inserting himself into an enemy's past also allows him to instantly learnallof their techniques and abilities, allowing to near-effortlessly dodge and bypass them mid-battle even if said enemy would normally outclass him in every aspect. Adaptational Villainy: While he's already a nasty piece of work in the manga, the anime makes him even worse. While in the manga he's content with turning Ichigo's loved ones against him by altering their past and shows a sadistic delight playing with the memories of Chad and Orihime, in the anime he tries to outright harm them physically at least twice: first he uses the guy used in the plot of Ginjo's stolen bag to attack Keigo and Mizuiro, and after Ichigo refuses to join Xcution initially he turns a corrupted soul into a Hollow that then attacks Yuzu so Ginjo could save her in time and that way convince Ichigo to go with his plans, an event that makes Ichigo finally accept joining Xcution. Adaptation Expansion: The anime greatly expands his role in the first part of the Fullbring Arc. In the Manga, he attacked Ishida and then disappea

characters.name: Riruka Dokugamine
characters.description: Her FullbringDollhouseallows her to basically be aReality Warperto anything or anyone she finds cute, permitting said things or people with heart-shaped "passes." This includes shrinking people down to the size of an action figure and "permitting" them into her cardboard dollhouse. Abnormal Ammo: Her gun stores miniaturized objects, which re-enlarge upon being fired, to hopefully catch an opponent off guard and crush them. Adaptation Expansion: While already a prominent character in the Lost Agent arc in the manga, the anime gives her more scenes and interactions with the rest of the cast, including following Ichigo to his high school after he initially declines joining Xcution or trying to warn Chad and Orihime about Tsukishima. Animal Motifs: As someone who loves cute things, she's associated with rabbits —animals traditionally considered adorable by people. Her hat has two long rabbit ears stuck to it (which become more noticeable when her Fullbring becomes stronger thanks to Ichigo's power), Riruka favors the usage of rabbit plushies as both ammo and a vessel to trap Rukia inside, and upon her return in the Thousand-Year Blood War arc her new outfit has a hoodie resembling a rabbit-like creature with long ears. Anti-Villain: While technically a villain on behalf of working with Ginjo, she's one of the less evil Xcution members, lacking the psychotic or sadistic qualities some of her teammates have. She's also the only one who didn't want Ichigo's power at all, protesting when Giriko and Yukio accuse Ginjo of keeping it all for himself, and is implied she only went with the plan to steal Ichigo's Fullbring due to her loyalty to Ginjo. This eventually results in her change of heart when, inside Rukia, she realizes Ichigo is someone who can truly save Ginjo and change those around him for the good, culminating inher willingly getting in the way of an attack of Tsukishima directed at Ichigo to protect him.

characters.name: Yukio Hans Voralberna
characters.description: His Fullbring,Invaders Must Die, is channeled through his portable game console and allows him to imprison targets within a video game whose parameters (such as the gameplay system) and "characters" (his prisoners) are under his full control. It will only function as long as the battery is charged, however - unless it's plugged into a power-source. All There in the Manual: Kubo reveals his surname in his character profile in the back of Volume 53. Badass Longcoat: He can trap people in video game dimensions and control everything that happens to them. He is also never seen without his longcoat. But Not Too Foreign: His blond hair and surname imply at least a partial Germanic background. His clothing also gives him a Nazi-esque look. Character Development: Following his humiliating defeat at Hitsugaya's hands, Yukio treats Jackie kindly and suggests he'll reform the group in a couple of years, including her even though she lost her power. InCan't Fear Your Own World, he stays true to his word. He later appears to help Ichigo and co alongside Riruka without hesitation. This is the same kid who whined about something minor as helping Ichigo's training and openly admitted he despised Riruka and wouldn't have cared if she died.

characters.name: Jackie Tristan
characters.description: Her Fullbring,Dirty Boots, increases her physical combat strength as her clothes are dirtied. Action Girl: Tristan's the most action-oriented chick amongst the Fullbringers in Xcution. Adaptation Expansion: Enough that her backstory was the first to get revealed in the anime. Anti-Villain: Jackie lost her family because of her father's involvement in the black market, and later joined up with Xcution. She is the only Fullbringer of the group who does actually hate her powers, with or without Tsukishima's influence. She's the least evil member of the group along with Riruka and was even willing to die for the sake of Renji, despite Renji having defeated her previously. Armed Legs: Her Fullbring makes her stronger the dirtier herbootsare.They also make said boots heavier.

characters.name: Giriko Kutsuzawa
characters.description: Kutsuzawa's Fullbring,Time Tells No Lies, allows him to place "timers" and restrictions on basically anything based on conditions of his choosing. If these conditions aren't met, the target ispurged by the flames of time. Adaptation Expansion: Gets a lot more screen time in the anime. Asshole Victim: He's the only member of Xcution to die, aside fromGinjo and Tsukishima, and unlike the other members has noFreudian Excuseto speak off and murdered his wifejust to test his powers.So it's hard to say that him getting bifurcated by Kenpachi was undeserved. Ax-Crazy: Not all is well in this man's head. It's questionable enough when he starts power-tripping and chewing the scenery after his upgrade from Ginjo. Then we learn he murdered his wife just because he could. That being said, he did try to stop her from dying, which cost him his eye (since he violated his own Fullbring's rules). It seems he was just being bored, yet cruel, and her death and the physical and mental trauma drove him fully off the deep end. Bartender Confidant: For a large portion of the arc, he just sits back cleaning glasses. He serves Xcution's drinks.Bleach: Can't Fear Your Own Worldreveals that he continues to serve this position after ending up in Soul Society.

characters.name: Moe Shishigawara
characters.description: His Fullbring,Jackpot Knuckle, takes the form of a knuckleduster with three slot machine icons. Depending on how lucky Shishigawara's roll is, the opponent will experience equal misfortune. Upon contact, the numbers roll, and if he hits a jackpot, Shishigawara can manipulate a probability related to whatever he punches; for example, he causes a piece of the hilt of Ginjo's sword to break off due to "simple wear and tear", or "just happens" to completely dislocate Ikkaku's shoulder with a single hit. Apologetic Attacker: Apologizes when he hits a jackpot but he's a bit sarcastic about it. Beware the Silly Ones: Despite coming across as a lowly mook and acting like a wannabe gangster, the ability of his Fullbring is very powerful to the point that even Ginjo considers him too dangerous to empower with Ichigo's Fullbring. While he loses against Ikkaku due to not knowing the limits of his Fullbring, he came closer to beat his opponent than most of the Fullbringers who got upgraded with Ichigo's power. Blessed with Suck: The unpredictability of Jackpot Knuckle means that he can't fight with any level of consistency, which makes him incredibly threatening nonetheless since with a lucky hit he can do some immense damage despite not hitting that hard. Cue the Sun: Of the "end of a story" variant: After the final battle where Tsukishima wasImpaled with Extreme Prejudice, Shishigawara carries his master away from the battlefield. As the sun rises, he points out what a beautiful morning it is and promises to always be by Tsukishima's side. His words finally allow Tsukishima to understand that he will not die alone.

characters.name: Kisuke Urahara
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isBenihime, a hidden-cane-sword that can create blood-based structures and launch energy blasts. His Bankai isKannon Biraki Benihime Aratame, which summons a giant princess capable of 'restructuring' anything within its range. This allows both healing and remodelling limbs to optimise strength at the same time. It can also tear the flesh off of any foesfoolish enoughto get close to it. Actually a Doombot: Or rather, ablow-up dollthat he can swap out in the middle of battle. It's one of his many, many inventions. Adaptive Ability: His Bankai has the ability to dissect and modify anything it wishes. When used defensively, it can take something damaged and make it stronger, and help it recover from or even resist whatever damaged it in the first place. Combined with his analytical mind, which enables him tocounter any abilityhe's adjusted to, this makes him an extremely adaptable opponent and nigh-impossible to beat if you fail to do so in your first attempt. Anti-Hero: Of thePragmatic Herovariety. He manipulated Rukia into slowly losing her powers in an attempt to destroy the Hogyoku, risked Ichigo's life to use him as a weapon against Aizen, often fails to give his allies crucial information, andbreaks the laws of Soul Society and the human world with impunity. To his credit, Kisuke shows legitimate remorse when his deceptions are discovered, even apologizing to Ichigo, once he and his friends returned from Soul Society. Artificial Outdoors Display: Urahara has a habit of creating huge, elaborate, secret underground training rooms. The ground often has the look of rocky, mountainous terrain and the ceiling appears to be sunny, blue skies. When Ichigo comments on it, Urahara explains that he feels the airy, outdoor atmosphere makes for a better feeling when underground. Ichigo cynically retorts that's the sort of thing a gaoler would say. Hundreds of chapters later, it's confirmed that, until a century ago, Urahara did actually have a gaoler's job.

characters.name: Yoruichi Shihoin
characters.description: The Ace: Very intelligent, and one of, if not the, best hand-to-hand combatants andFlash Stepmasters in the Soul Society. Her students Byakuya Kuchiki and Soi Fon were never able to surpass her skills even after a hundred years of trying. Action Girl: Yoruichi is an excellent hand-to-hand fighter and developed a special technique to combine hand-to-hand combat with Kido. Adaptation Dye-Job: Her hair is black with a purple sheen in the manga. The anime took the manga's purple sheen and made an entire hair colour out of it for the anime. Ambiguously Brown: She's dark-skinned but has a Japanese name. Since she was born in Soul Society into a family that is older than the world itself, it is not supposed to be indicative of any ethnicity. She provides the trope image, and, as noted there, was the subject of an absolutelymassiveEdit WaronThe Other Wiki, to the point the final say was that she was "dark skinned". Animal Metaphor: Yoruichi and Soi Fon are symbolized by the cat and the hornet respectively. Yoruichi's personality is playful, and somewhat fickle, much like a cat's; in addition to her unexplained ability to actuallyturn into one, at will.Whereas Soi Fon, whose name literally means"break/broken hornet", has a personality befitting her namesake; being that she's slow to anger,yet deadlywhen provoked. This is also reflected in her zanpakuto, Suzumebachi, which is named after the Asian hornet. The chapter in which they fight is even titled "Cat and Hornet".

characters.name: Tessai Tsukabishi
characters.description: As the former captain of the Kido Corps, he is extremely adept at casting Kido spells, even forbidden ones. Almighty Janitor: He is the former captain of the Kido Corps, and is a very powerful magic user. However, in the current timeline of the series he is an assistant at a convenience store run by his childhood friend Kisuke, where he is seen doing grunt work despite his former high rank and amazing powers. The Archmage: While he never gets to show off too much, heisthe former leader of the Kido Corps, which would make him one of, if not the greatest magic practitioner in all of Soul Society. Bare-Fisted Monk: When Kisuke and his associates arrive to help exterminate the Hollows that were drawn to Karakura by Uryu's bait, he's seen knocking a Hollow's head off with a single palm strike. The Exile: One hundred years before Chapter 1, the Visoreds were the victims of Sousuke Aizen's illegal Hollowfication experiment. In the process of trying to save them, Tessai performed illegal Kido, and Urahara was framed by Aizen for the experiments. The Visoreds were sentenced to execution, and Tessai and Urahara were sentenced to imprisonment and the removal of their powers. They were rescued from their fates by Yoruichi, who helped them get to the World of the Living where they could live as fugitives in exile. Their names weren't cleared for over a hundred years.

characters.name: Shinji Hirako
characters.description: His zanpakuto isSakanade, an unusually-shaped sword that releases a sweet mist when called upon. Any foes who catch onto the scent have all of their senses flipped and inverted. Sakanade's Bankai is namedSakashima Yokoshima Happō Fusagari('Reversed Evil Eight-Treasure Barrier'), and it takes the appearance of a platform possessing flame-shaped extensions, with Shinji standing in the center. It also reverses the blade and the ring's appearance on the weapon. Its abilities are an extension of the perception-altering abilities of Sakanade's Shikai; however, instead of changing the perception of the senses themselves, it alters mental perception. Chiefly, it causes the perception between ally and enemy to be reversed, causing former allies to become hostile to one another. Adaptational Badass: He fares better in the anime version of the Thousand Year Blood War arc compared to the manga, where he couldn't catch a break through it. While he still loses quickly to Bambietta when she uses her Vollstandig as in the source material, in the anime he gets to use his Bankai, his brief encounter with Bazz-B where he's forced to escape is removed and he isn't instantly defeated by Gerard, managing to save Hinamori in time and confront the giant Quincy with the other Visored. All There in the Manual: His Bankai,Sakashima Yokoshima Happō Fusagari, is first revealed in the novelCan't Fear Your Own World. It gets anAdaptational Early Appearancein the anime, where he uses it on a group of Wandenreich footsoldiers. Awesome, but Impractical: His aforementioned Bankai. The ability to reverse the perceptions of friend/foe of everybody within his range might sound overpowered on paper, but since Shinjiisa Thirteen Court captain, he doesn't have many chances to use it without running the risk of causing his own 5th Division from attacking each other, thus turning the power into a liability unless he's by his sole self and surrounded by enemies for whatever reason. This Bankai is also noted t

characters.name: Hiyori Sarugaki
characters.description: Her Zanpakuto isKubikiri Orochi, an enormous cleaver. A-Cup Angst: Hiyori is self-conscious of her small bust size and becomes jealous of Orihime when they first meet. Action Girl: She's self reliant and aggressive to the point of being a brashLeeroy Jenkins, but she's more capable of taking care of herself than she looks. Animal Motifs: She has a monkey motif going on, with her small stature, young appearance, rowdy and rude personality and even her surname alluding to the most unpleasant stereotypes associated with the animal. Be Careful What You Wish For: When Ichigo approaches the Visoreds to learn how to control his inner Hollow, she repeatedly goads him into tapping into its powers, which he refuses to do out of fear that he'll lose control. After she beats him around enough, his Hollow side involuntarily takes over and immediately starts strangling her, forcing the other Visoreds to step in to save her. Afterwards, Shinji sarcastically asks if she's satisfied while she shedsTears of Fear.

characters.name: Kensei Muguruma
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isTachikaze, a trench combat knife that can launch wind-based attacks. His Bankai isTekken Tachikaze, a pair of armored spiked knuckles which can remodel themselves, and are perpetually emitting shockwaves. Ambiguous Situation: Kensei's fight with Wonderweiss is cut off after he unleashes his bankai. While Wonderweiss shows up again when Aizen deploys him against Yamamoto,Kensei and Mashiro aren't seen again.It's possible that instead of being defeated, Kensei was forced to get Mashiro to safety instead of finishing the fight with Wonderweiss, as we never actually see him defeated or being healed after the battle is over. The Big Guy: Though he's not the tallest Visored (Hachi is), Kensei nonetheless is the most muscular and physically oriented member of the group, preferring to use his strength and fighting in close range combat than relying on flashy abilities or Kido.He was, in fact,even biggerduring theTurn Back The Pendulumarc, with a neck like a paint can and nearly bursting out of his uniform. His slimmer design is a visual indicator of how the Visored struggled in the meantime, as he's bulked up again during theThousand Year Blood Warfinal arc. He was, in fact,even biggerduring theTurn Back The Pendulumarc, with a neck like a paint can and nearly bursting out of his uniform. His slimmer design is a visual indicator of how the Visored struggled in the meantime, as he's bulked up again during theThousand Year Blood Warfinal arc. Blade Below the Shoulder: Kensei's Bankai grants him blades shaped like knuckle dusters.

characters.name: Mashiro Kuna
characters.description: Action Girl: It's almost unreal how much raw, brute strength she possesses given how much of an absolute putz she can be. That being said, credit where credit is due - in her Hollowfied state, she can go toe-to-toe with one of Aizen's custom-engineered Arrancars. Animal Motifs: Her Hollow mask resembles a Grasshopper's face, tying into herKamen Ridertheming. Beware the Silly Ones: Oh yes. Her scenes are usually comical, but she's still extremely powerful and was capable of laying a complete beatdown on Wonderweiss before her hollow mask broke. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: Okay, so Kensei chose her to be the Ninth Division lieutenant... why, exactly? Well, if nothing else, she'sreallygood at tearing apart Hollows. Badass Adorable: She's undeniably adorable and is fully capable oftearing apart hordes of Gillians and manhandling an Espada level arrancarlikeWonderweissby herself.

characters.name: Rojuro "Rose" Otoribashi
characters.description: His Zanpakuto isKinsharaa sound-based whip capable of enveloping his opponents in powerful explosions. His Bankai isKinshara Butōdan, which uses music to create illusions to harm the enemy. Agent Peacock: ALong-Haired Pretty Boywith a flair for music, and aMusical Assassinwith abilities that enter the same realm as Shinji and Aizen in terms of theSuperpower Lottery. Animal Motifs: His Hollow mask resembles a bird. Badass in a Nice Suit: During his time as one of the Visored, he wore a sleek black casual suit with an untucked frilly shirt. Berserk Button: The man has a serious love for music, and the arts in general. WhenNaNaNainsults him and his guitar, the usually carefree Rose ispissed.

characters.name: Hachigen "Hachi" Ushoda
characters.description: Apologetic Attacker: He salutes and apologizes to Baraggan upon finally killing him. This is despite Baraggan being an utterly loathsome man, which proves just how magnanimous Hachi is. The Archmage: He was, at one point, Tessai's lieutenant in the Kido Corps of Soul Society, and is an incredibly powerful magician as a result. While he's admittedly loathe to use more offensive spells, this doesn't limit his effectiveness as a mage, and one of his most notable accomplishments is taking down theincrediblydeadly Baraggan Louisenbairn while barely moving, using only his mastery of magic and barriers to do it. An Arm and a Leg: Lost an arm during his battle with Baraggan...which he then used to defeat Baraggan. Barrier Warrior: His speciality is Bakudou (Binding Spells). He explains to Orihime that he doesn't have the mentality for battle so had to learn how to be useful in war. His barriers are his way of fighting. Beware the Nice Ones: He's one of the sweetest characters in the entire series. He's also anamazingspellcaster capable of feats so far unparalleled, having defeated the once reigningGod-King of Hueco Mundo.

characters.name: Lisa Yadomaru
characters.description: Her zanpakuto isHaguro Tonbo, a lengthy Shaolin spade. Action Girl: She favors direct combat and is pretty self-reliant. Ambiguously Related: The series never goes in depth on what her connection to Nanao is, only showing that they knew each other when Lisa was still a Soul Reaper part of Soul Society. Due to the similar physical details, it isn't clear if they just happen to look similar, or if they are at all related in some form, but the series never really returns to their connection again. Badass Bookworm: She's an impressive combatant, and an avid reader. Though...it's not exactly classic literature she prefers.Her past-self is played a bit straighter, at least in that she seemed to enjoy teaching Nanao to read. Bare Midriffs Are Feminine: Wears a school uniform slightly too small to cover her midriff, and is more traditionally feminine compared to fellow Visored Hiyori.

characters.name: Love Aikawa
characters.description: His zanpakuto isTengumaru, a gargantuan spiked club capable of dealing fire-based attacks. Afro Asskicker: Used to sport a standard afro when he was still a Captain. These days he styles it into a spiked variant. Alternate Character Reading: The characters in his name mean "net" and "military", but their On'yomi (Chinese) readings are "ra" and "bu" - and love is often approximated in Japanese as "rabu", which is presumably why their pronunciation is in katakana rather than hiragana. Carry a Big Stick: His zanpakuto, Tengumaru, takes the form of an enormous spiked club. Cool Shades: He almost always has a pair of large sunglasses on.

characters.name: Zangetsu
characters.description: When in bankai as Tensa Zangetsu, he appears as a handsome teenager - Yhwach at a young age. As Tensa Zangetsu, he can fuse with the Inner Hollow to become a representation of Ichigo's full power, and appears calm like the old man but with a violent side to him like the Inner Hollow. DespiteThe Reveal, he's often still referred to as Zangetsu here or or official materials released afterwards. Adaptation Dye-Job:HisSword Beamis yellow in the manga and turns dark blue with a white tinge post-Fullbring arc, but in the anime it's pale blue-white throughout.The fusion between Tensa Zangetsu and the Inner Hollow kept the former's peach skin tone in the manga. In the anime, however, the fusion had the Inner Hollow's chalk-white skin. The anime also colors his merged sword form white with a black tsuba. Furthermore, his sword beam started off as gold-yellow before being turned pitch-black by the Inner Hollow in the manga, but in the anime it was black with a blue outline before being turned black with a red outline by the Inner Hollow. HisSword Beamis yellow in the manga and turns dark blue with a white tinge post-Fullbring arc, but in the anime it's pale blue-white throughout. The fusion between Tensa Zangetsu and the Inner Hollow kept the former's peach skin tone in the manga. In the anime, however, the fusion had the Inner Hollow's chalk-white skin. The anime also colors his merged sword form white with a black tsuba. Furthermore, his sword beam started off as gold-yellow before being turned pitch-black by the Inner Hollow in the manga, but in the anime it was black with a blue outline before being turned black with a red outline by the Inner Hollow. Ambiguous Situation: Yhwach stripped Ichigo of his Quincy and Hollow powers during their penultimate battle. The manga doesn't clarify the extent to which Tsukishima and Orihime's intervention reverses this, especially as Ichigo doesn't noticeably use any Quincy or Hollow powers during the final battle and the white outer la

characters.name: Zabimaru
characters.description: Achilles in His Tent: Snakey runs off in one of the post-arc fillers, and they have to reunite to deal with a Toju. Anthropomorphic Shift: Originally they were shown as single baboon with a snake for a tail, but in a gag panel Renji asks Mayuri to modify his sword, resulting in the manifestation's evolution. The resulting humanoid form - a busty, furred woman chained to a young boy with a snake tail - is officially showcased in the anime's Zanpakuto Rebellion filler arc. Bag of Sharing: Chimpette and Snakey only have one sword between them, and they can both summon it whenever they want. Chained by Fashion: Their human forms are chained together, which surprisingly is more of an advantage in battle than a disadvantage,probably because of how long it is. They alsoconstantly bicker, but work together surprisingly well. Dem Bones: Zabimaru's bankaiturns Snakey into an enormous skeletal serpent.The real Bankai opts for a giant skeletal hand instead.

characters.name: Hyorinmaru
characters.description: Chick Magnet: Haineko, Tobiume and Suzumebachi certainly like having him around, thoughChimpetteand Sode no Shirayuki seem indifferent. Elemental Motifs: Water and ice, fitting for Hitsugaya's Zanpakuto. Good Scars, Evil Scars: He has a strange-looking white X-shaped scar over his face. An Ice Person: He uses ice against Hitsugaya. Justified in that he's Hitsugaya's Zanpakuto. His ice is so strong, it can even freeze Ryuujin Jakka's flames. Identity Amnesia: Doesn't remember what he was before Muramasa came along.

characters.name: Senbonzakura
characters.description: 24-Hour Armor:Played With. He does take off his armor when bathing, but astill keeps his masked helmet on. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: He has no problems wearing his mask while taking a shower in the mens' bath, nor showing it all of on display for the girls that were trying to sneak a peek on him, among other things. Cherry Blossoms: What his power looks like (and hence his name). Cool Mask: He wears a mask that resembles a Japanese ogre from folklore, and never takes it off, even in the shower. Curious as a Monkey: The subsequent arc shows him to be quite childish, pushing any button he can find to see what it does. This drastic difference between him and Byakuya is lampshaded, and then it's revealed that Byakuya is just like that, but he hides it better. Subtlely lampshaded, too, as the one trying desperately to control Senbonzakura's "monkey" urges is the "monkey" - or, more accurately, the baboon half of Zabimaru, Renji's baboon/snake zanpakuto

characters.name: Sode no Shirayuki
characters.description: Ethereal White Dress: Sode no Shirayuki is based on aYuki-onna, a ghostly 'snow-woman'. As a result, her appearance is based off one: she has very pale skin, silver hair and her kimono is white from top to bottom. She's quiet, well-mannered even when rebelling, is portrayed in a detached, mystical manner and is possessed of an otherworldly beauty, as befitting her association with the yuki-onna folklore. An Ice Person: Her standard powers. She uses them to much greater effect than Rukia ever did, even without Bankai, as in addition to the three dances, she can also shoot shards of ice. Yamato Nadeshiko: ALady of Warin a white kimono. Cold and apathetic, but polite at most points. She later showed a kinder, friendlier and somewhat mischievous side to Senbonzakura and Rukia. Yuki-onna: She is pretty obviously based on a yuki-onna, or "snow woman".

characters.name: Kazeshini
characters.description: Ax-Crazy: Kazeshini is extremely bloodthirsty and loves to battle, to the point of attacking Hisagi even after Muramasa's control is broken. In the novels he compares himself to White (the Hollow half of Zangetsu) and Nozarashi (also known as Yachiru). Badass and Child Duo: He comes across a baby while roaming Soul Society and carts it around in a similar manner to Kenpachi and Yachiru, which teaches him a measure of empathy. By the Lights of Their Eyes: Seems covered in an unnatural darkness at all times, but his eyes and mouth just seem toglow. Character Development: He mellows out a bit once he meets a random baby, finally understanding that he doesn't have to fight for fighting's sake, but he's still a temperamental, bloodthirsty bastard. Comedic Sociopathy: In one Omake, he apologies to Hisagi and promise to be a nice zanpakuto. However, as they hug each other Kazeshini asks how could he possibly buy thatand stabs Hisagi's shoulderwhilelaughing at him.

characters.name: Haineko
characters.description: Action Girl: As with most female zanpakuto, she's afast and agile fighter. Ashes to Ashes: She's able to manifest clouds of ash and use it as projectile attacks. Bare Midriffs Are Feminine: She's a Catgirl whose outfit leaves her midriff bare, which emphasizes her femininity. Big-Breast Pride: She's proud of her curvaceous figure and enjoys taunting and mocking Tobiume for being flat-chested, clearly enjoying pointing outthe disparity between their bust sizesand being convinced Tobiume is jealous of her over it. Buxom Beauty Standard: She's noted for being just as busty as her master. When Haineko had to wear a schoolgirl uniform, Rangiku even pulled down the shirt to expose more of her cleavage so she'd look "hotter".

characters.name: Tobiume
characters.description: Action Girl: Good at fighting, bad at winning. A-Cup Angst: She claims to like her figure, but her irritation at Haineko teasing her for being flat-chested implies she does feel insecure about her body. Brutal Honesty: She doesnothold back when chewing out Momo over her blind loyalty to Aizen. Character Development: She starts off somewhat sarcastic, manipulative, cruel, and critical, particularly towards Momo, and constantly argues with Haineko. However, later on, she starts getting along better with Haineko and (at the end of the Zanpakuto Rebellion) is much nicer to Momo. Covert Pervert: You might not know it first-glance, but she actually tried to sneak a peek on Senbonzakura while he was in the mens' bathroom to see what he looked like without the mask. Although she voiced her reservations beforehand, theLuminescent Blushon her face was enough proof to show that shedefinitelyenjoyed the view.

characters.name: Katen Kyokotsu
characters.description: Affectionate Nickname:While officially separated into "Katen" (Pirate) and "Kyōkotsu" (Ninja), Kyoraku prefers to refer to the two spirits as "Ohana" and "Okyō" respectively.Ohana meanwhile refers to Kyoraku by one of his middle names, "Sakuranosuke." While officially separated into "Katen" (Pirate) and "Kyōkotsu" (Ninja), Kyoraku prefers to refer to the two spirits as "Ohana" and "Okyō" respectively. Ohana meanwhile refers to Kyoraku by one of his middle names, "Sakuranosuke." Ascended Meme: They take the form of a ninja and a Japanese take on aPirate Girl, in what seems to be an obvious nod to the ninjas and pirates meme. Kyoraku's "King of Games" nickname is given a nod by the fact Katen seems to be a bit of game nut, notably card-like games, while Kyōkotsu prefers children's games like hide-and-go-seek. Bare Midriffs Are Feminine: Ohana's outfit leaves hers exposed and she is the embodiment of an utterly loyal partner.

characters.name: Sogyo no Kotowari
characters.description: Breaking the Fourth Wall: They look directly at the screen at one point in episode 257. Coordinated Clothes: They both wear the same outfit. Creepy Twins: They have elements of this when under Muramasa's control. When freed, they're just playful kids. Foreshadowing: Their clothing gives them some resemblance to that of a shrine priest. Fitting for the Zanpakuto of a man whose body contains the Soul King's sentient right arm, Mimihagi, who was worshiped in the Rukongai district.Can't Fear Your Own Worldreveals that Mimihagi's presence within Ukitake to be the reason why his zanpakuto manifests as two swords. Keet: They are both very energetic and playful.

characters.name: Suzumebachi
characters.description: Blade Below the Shoulder: Her whole right arm is a large stinger, almost as tall as she is. Comically Missing the Point: Tells Suì-Fēng to get a boyfriend, despite knowing that Sui-Féng seemingly only has eyes for "Yoruichi-sama". Death by Irony: A twofold example:For all their differences, it ends up being their one similarity that ultimately gets her killed: their habit of toying with the enemy, instead of simply killing them when they have the chance. By the time she finally decided to finish it, it was already too late. Sui-Féng had devised a way to immobilize Suzumebachi long enough to kill her.Also, like Sui-Féng, she bragged that she'd kill her if she hit any of the Homonka covering her body twice. Sui-Féng ends the fight by killing Suzumebachi witha single strike. For all their differences, it ends up being their one similarity that ultimately gets her killed: their habit of toying with the enemy, instead of simply killing them when they have the chance. By the time she finally decided to finish it, it was already too late. Sui-Féng had devised a way to immobilize Suzumebachi long enough to kill her. Also, like Sui-Féng, she bragged that she'd kill her if she hit any of the Homonka covering her body twice. Sui-Féng ends the fight by killing Suzumebachi witha single strike.

characters.name: Ashisogi Jizo
characters.description: The spirit of Mayuri's sword. Takes the form of a yellow-faced baby boy with wide eyes. Upon going Bankai, the kid grows to huge levels and his body looks a LOT like a caterpillar... that exhales poison. Butterfly of Death and Rebirth: He has butterfly-like wings, and is capable of reconstituting himself if killed as a result of being modified by Mayuri. Creepy Child: He may look like a child, but his yellow skin, bug-like eyes and squeaking sounds can be unnerving. Cute Mute: Can barely babble around and say "Bankai!" Killer Rabbit: Cute, makes warbling speaking sounds, somewhat curious, poisons people,stabs people with blades that come out of its chest?And then Bankai happens...

characters.name: Minazuki
characters.description: Ambiguous Gender: As stated above, the fact that we can't see what Minazuki looks like means that we can't tell what gender, if any, they may have. Bloody Murder: Its bankai's ability oozes a blood-like liquid that simultaneously corrodes and heals flesh. The Faceless: Wears this weird robe-like thing that obscures everything about Minazuki's body (if it even has one). Flat Character: It really doesn't have anything going for it - no dialogue, no personality, barely appeared on-screen, no known motivation to speak of, and no known gender. In the Hood: Wears a hooded robe that conceals their face.

characters.name: Hozukimaru
characters.description: The Big Guy: Fills the bill as one for the Zanpakuto, being a towering and bulkyoni. Lazy Bum: When the Zanpakuto were all first introduced, he was the only one shown sleeping. Oni: Looks like a tanned demon in Japanese folklore, as you'd expect from his name, which roughly means "Oni Lamp". Punch! Punch! Punch! Uh Oh...: He willingly takes blows to gather energy and powers. Trust Password: Ikkaku confirmed his identity with the "Lucky Dance".

characters.name: Ruri'iro Kujaku
characters.description: Agent Peacock: Like his owner, is flamboyant, obsessed with his appeance, and adangerouslyeffective combatant. Berserk Button: Ruri'iro Kujaku hates the colour purple. Yumichikatries to hidehis tabooFunctional Magicabilities from hisBlood Knightdivision byconstantly insultingRuri'iro Kujaku by giving it a purple-themed nickname (Fuji Kujaku, "Wisteria (Purple) Peacock"). As a result, it angrily refuses to unleash its power in battle, allowing him tokeep his power secret. Energy Absorption: His abilities, and the source of his frustration with Yumichika, who utterly refuses to use them in battle. Swiss-Army Weapon: When called Fuji Kujaku, he transforms into a fan-shaped array of blades evocative of a peacock's tail. Vampiric Draining: His abilities drain an enemy's life-force and heal him and his wielder, though he withholds the last bit because of hisBerserk Buttonconstantly being pressed.

characters.name: Tenken
characters.description: Attack of the 50-Foot Whatever: In bankai, he personally takes the form of the giant samurai that Komamura always uses. BFS: His sword when he is in bankai is massive, befitting a giant samurai. Breath Weapon: He roars fire at his opponents when angry. Curb-Stomp Battle: Effortlessly beats his master very shortly after appearing. David vs. Goliath:Invertedwhen he and Gonryoumaru go up against Sui-Féng. Tenken initially seems to have the upperhand, due to his massive height advantage and the difference in physical strength. Simply blocking one of his sword swings was enough to send Sui-Féng skidding backwards 'til she crashed through a stone wall. But the tables turn when Gonryoumaru attempts to finish her off. Sui-Féng activatesher Shunkôand easily repels his lightning, causing the storm clouds to part, then immediately floors Gonryoumaru himself. Tenken tries to avenge him, but Sui-Féng uses her Shunkô enhanced strength to effortlessly catch his blade with one hand, which is when Tenken realizes he's outmatched.

characters.name: Hisagomaru
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: He is Hanataro's sword, so this should be expected. Healing Shiv: Its gauge is filled by healing wounds, and when in shikai the accumulated energy can be unleashed in a surprisingly powerful blast. Bonus points for its shikai form being a scalpel. Immune to Mind Control: Muramasa couldn't mind-control him like the others because he had no hidden resentment for Muramasa to work with. Killer Rabbit: It looks like a small, cheeply-designed robot, but once the gauge has been filled by healing wounds it can unleash a blast powerful enough to one-shot Gillian-class Menos or a Touju with its Shikai. Nervous Wreck: Awkward and nervous, much like its wielder.

characters.name: Gonryomaru
characters.description: Bullying a Dragon: After effortlessly defeating the Onmitsukido, he and Tenken decide to push their luck by picking a fight with Sui-Féng, despite knowing she's a Captain. They end up having to be be saved bySuzmebachi. Butt-Monkey: No one knew who he is or who he belongs to, and he even ends up trapping himself in a pit in order to make an ambush. Dude, Where's My Respect?: The source of his grievance with Sasukebe is that he's so unnoticed and forgetable, that he's ashamed to be his zanpakuto. Sui-Féng struggles to even remember who Sasukebe is and openly admits that she barely notices him either.Sui-Féng:(Aha! pose)"Oooh, so you'rehiszanpakuto. Yeah, that guy's so boring, I hardly remember him either." Out of Focus:In-Universe. He desperatelywantsto be in focus, but Sasakibe is in the background so often that nobody recognizes him when he fights. Shock and Awe: He can electrify his spear and call forth storms. It's notably the first time we see Sasakibe's power being used, and would be theonlytime until the Thousand Year Blood War arc.

characters.name: Gegetsuburi
characters.description: Acrofatic: Despite his massive bulk, he's deceptively fast. Butt-Monkey: Like Omaeda, nobody takes him seriously. Epic Flail: His Shikai, which is the same as Omaeda. He never gets to use it, though. Fat Bastard: He's more concerned about eating than anything else. Gonk: The facialArt Shiftused to emphasise that Oomaeda is someone no-one respects and who is used mostly for comic relief, are even more exaggerated in his zanpakutou, who is even worse than Oomaeda.

characters.name: Wabisuke
characters.description: Chained by Fashion: Wears a lot of chains and also a huge stone tablet and an iron ball. Gravity Master: Can double the weight of anything he hits. Hypocritical Humor: Calls the baby that Kazeshini ends up taking care of "gloomy."Haineko:You're really not one to talk. The Quiet One: Rarely speaks, and usually communicates by shaking his chains. The other Zanpakuto spirits seems to understand him anyway. Walking Shirtless Scene: He distinctly lacks a shirt, though he's covered in chains.

characters.name: Ryuujin Jakka
characters.description: Flat Character: Probably even more so than Minazuki, as Ryuujin Jakka doesn't even have a humanoid form and is just a really big fire. It's really just aMacGuffin. MacGuffin: Ryuujin Jakka is one for Muramasa's plans, since it's got the shared memory of where Genryuusai (and Ginrei) sealed Kouga Kuchiki away, so it is not given any characterization. Muramasa dips out as soon as he got the information he needed, while Ryuujin Jakka stays behind to keep several of the captains busy. Mundane Utility: The omake of episode 249 reveals that Yamamoto Genryuusai has used Ryuujin Jakka for very mundane tasks like heating an oven, providing heat during winter and baking potatoes, which Genryuusai is very thankful for. Kyoraku thinks that Ryuujin Jakka is rebelling against his owner because of that. Playing with Fire: It is the strongest fire-based Zanpakutou of Soul Society. It manifests itself in the form of giant flames and nothing more. Sealed Evil in a Can: Ryuujin Jakka isn't evil, but Yamamoto Genryuusai trapped himself in a barrier for the majority of the filler arc just to prevent Muramasa from enslaving his Zanpakutou. Once Muramasa managed to destroy the barrier with Ichigo's Getsuga Tenshou, Muramasa was able to enslave Ryuujin Jakka, the strongest Zanpakutou, and got access to the memory of the location where Kouga was sealed.

characters.name: Nozarashi
characters.description: Absurdly Sharp Blade: Nozarashi's power is to cut through almost anything, which is amplified to absurd levels with its bankai, which transforms Kenpachi into a red-skinned oni. BFS:Nozarashi's sealed form is a chipped and jagged nodachi.Nozarashi's Shikai is a massive axe-like cleaver.Subverted by Nozarashi's Bankai, which takes the form of a smaller if still decently-sized cleaver. Nozarashi's sealed form is a chipped and jagged nodachi. Nozarashi's Shikai is a massive axe-like cleaver. Subverted by Nozarashi's Bankai, which takes the form of a smaller if still decently-sized cleaver.

characters.name: The Sword Five
characters.description: Short and temperamental, Mera has spiky hair, which is tied up in a ponytail at the back. She wears a vest with a large, furred collar, and a short skirt. Hot-Blooded: She's short-tempered and aggressive, and has no time for Nimaiya's goofy methods of introducing Soul Reapers to his palace. Even when dealing with serious people, she's impatiently no-nonsense. Meaningful Name: Her name translates into "Kindling Island" and she has the ability to breathe fire. Odd Name Out: Unlike the rest of the Sword Five, her name is notalliterative. Playing with Fire: She canbreathe fire out of her mouth, which is what Nimaiya uses to reforge Zangetsu.

characters.name: Asauchi
characters.description: Anthropomorphic Personification: Ichigo assumes that their humanoid forms are this to their sword forms but Ouetsu Nimaiya later revealsit's the other way around. Blank Slate: This is what every true Zanpakuto starts out as. Character Development: This is more or less required for Soul Reapers to achieve their fullest potential. A Soul Reaper must understand that their Zanpakuto Spirit is a reflection of themselves and not an independent entity to rely on. By extension this means they must learn everything there is to know about themselves and accept who they are. If they cannot see through to their true selves they cannot attain full power. As such, Soul Reapers who possess little understanding of themselves as people cannot achieve Bankai — the full expression of a Soul Reaper's power and personality. Chekhov's Gun: The first time we learn about the term "Asauchi" is by Old Man Zangetsu during Ichigo's first training with White Ichigo. It's only much later that Ichigo learns about the true nature of Asauchi and that Ichigo never had one to begin with, and that his Zanpakuto wasn't a real one. Empathic Weapon: More so than other types of Zanpakuto as they can bond to anyone with sufficient Soul Reaper powers and becomeanything.

characters.name: Yhwach
characters.description: An autocrat who is as ruthless and heartless as they come, he commits one atrocity after another in his "crusade." Despite claiming to dislike conflict of any kind, he feeds on war and bloodshed itself and always takes the most violent and efficient method to settling matters, even casually disposing of his own men when they are no longer useful. Yhwach holds the letter "A" of "The Almighty", serving as the supreme commander of the Wandenreich's military. Under the usage of the Schrift (or script), he personally bestows a letter upon a member of the Wandenreich, meant to correspond to their particular ability. His Quincy cross — stylized as a military medal bearing the Wandenreich symbol - manifests in the form of a winged, eagle-themed sword. His power "The Almighty" allows him to give and take power, negate every harmful ability, once he understands it, and finally see and change the future. Abnormal Ammo: With a horizontal cutting motion directed at the sky, Yhwach summons a gigantic Spirit Bow which fires a Quincy arrow down to the ground in front of him. The arrow is about as tall as him (and he isverytall), and by gripping it at the base of the shaft, can use it as a broadsword. There are two protrusions that jet out from the broadswords cross-guard which, along with the handle, resemble the insignia of the Wandenreich. Yhwach uses the broadsword to bifurcate Yamamoto. Achilles' Heel: He's got major weaknesses that, when targeted together, help defeat him:Despite Yhwach's phenomenal ability to see and counter any future, he's as vulnerable to Aizen's Kyoka Suigetsu as everyone else. As a result, while he can see futures involving Aizen unfold, he won't be able to tell whether it's Aizen showing him an illusion or not. It's about the only thing that can subvert The Almighty even a little bit and proves instrumental in giving Ichigo and Uryu the chance to get past Yhwach's defences.To kill Quincies, Auswählen involves Yhwach creating a magical substance called S

characters.name: The Sternritter
characters.description: Adaptation Expansion: The anime adaptation of theThousand-Year Blood Warfills in a few gaps that were left unexplained in the original manga regarding the backstory of the Quincies. Two hundred years after his birth, Yhwach formed his own empire—theLicht Reich(German for "Empire of Light") that proceeded to conquer much of the Eurasian continent. In his endeavor to conquer the Soul Society next, he created asecondarmy—the Sternritter, which acted as his new vanguard. The invasion failed and Yhwach was gravely wounded while both the Licht Reich and the old guard Sternritter vanished, with much of their history and existence completely wiped out from the books. Eight hundred years later, Yamamoto would carry out asecondgenocide of the surviving Quincy clans. Only two hundred years after that would Yhwach regain his heartbeat and rebuild his empire in secret. Aerith and Bob: The variety of names is all over the place. For every Bambietta, Liltotto, Meninas, andNaNaNayou have a Robert, Pepe, Gerard, and Jerome. Alliterative Name: Very common but not universal among them. Of these, none of their alliterative letters match their Schrift codenames. Ambiguously Human: Quincies may or may not be human. There are four soul-races, Humans, Soul Reapers, Hollows, and Quincies. Humans and Hollows are opposites, and Soul Reapers and Quincies are opposites. Hollows are opposites to Quincies and possibly Humans and Soul Reapers, but the relationship between Humans and Quincies is unstated, especially as Quincies appear capable ofliving as longas Soul Reapers. The Quincies are initially described by the Soul Reapers as spiritually-aware humans who train their abilities to fight Hollows. However, when Ryuken later mentions the concept of "human power", he puts Ginjo (Substitute Soul Reaper and Fullbringer), Sado (Fullbringer) and Orihime under that umbrella. While he includes his mixed-blood Quincy son, Uryu, he excludes himself (a pure-blood Quincy) and admits he's stretching the def

characters.name: Johan Seydlitz
characters.description: Affably Evil: According to the relationship chart of the original Schutzstaffel, Seydlitz's opinions of his comrades were all fairly positive and he seemed ready to offer praise to them and their abilities. Even Hubert, the biggestJerkassout of them all, was merely considered "green" yet still capable. The Dragon: Was apparently Yhwach’s second in command 1000 years ago, as he’s the first Quincy to know about his idea to form the new combat unit known as the Sternritters. Nakk Le Vaar's omake at the end of the third cour of theThousand-Year Blood Wararc anime confirms via a relationship chart of the four elite members that he was indeed Yhwach's right hand man during that time. Everyone Has Standards: He’s surprised when Yhwach announces to him that he’s going to form a new combat unit, the Sternritter, to conquer Soul Society despite the fact the conquest of the Licht Reich is finally finished, arguing there was no further need to keep expanding their territory. Eyepatch of Power: Wears an elegant white eyepatch in his left eye that combined with his older appearance gives him the image of a seasoned soldier. Inconsistent Spelling: His name has been translated into “Zeidritz” and “Seidlitz”. Eventually, it was officially romanized as “Seydlitz”.

characters.name: Hubert Alexander Kleich
characters.description: Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Based on his relations with his comrades and Bazz-B, Hubert was extremely arrogant and overly confident in his skills, clearly considering himself the best thing since sliced bread. While he certainly had the power and skill to be among Yhwach's original elites, it ultimately didn't matter as Haschwalth was implied to have become much stronger than him following his induction into the Licht Reich, and of course, Yamamoto incinerated him to death. Asshole Victim: Whereas his colleagues all had eitherredeeming qualitiesorprofessional personalities, Hubert stood out as the majorJerkassin the original Schutzstaffel, having negative, haughty opinions of pretty much everyone who wasn't him or Yhwach, and even his most positive one was to consider Argola, his equal in rank, as asubordinate. This is not even going into his animosity with Bazz-B that forced Haschwalth to pull rank and protect his former friend. These traits make it a bit difficult to be too sad in hindsight when Yamamoto killed Hubert with his Bankai. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: Initially appears as a professional soldier, politely telling Bazz-B to keep with his training so he can get chosen as a Sternritter in the future. However, when Bazz-B insists on challenging him to prove his power, Hubert’s expression changes to a sadistic smile, revealing himself as a petty man willing to use lethal force on a foolish teenager. The relationship charts between the original Schutzstaffel likewise confirm him to be a fairly dislikable person, having negative opinions on pretty much everyone who is not him except for Argola, and even that was only because he saw Argola as hissubordinatedespite the two being of equal rank. Even Evil Has Standards:While he’s a bonafide asshole, he’s fiercely loyal to Yhwach and would never dare to question his decisions. When Yhwach decides to take Haschwalth with him and turn him into his right hand man, Hubert obeys without any complaint despite his former antagoni

characters.name: Argola Lallau
characters.description: Affably Evil: While still ruthless when needed, he's shown to care about his comrades and his relationship chart shows that they like him too, with evenHubertpraising him as a loyal subordinate.
